address: Zimbabwe St, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Adam Jano
user_reviews.Description: Came here because of the good reviews. The place itself is 100% simple.. small and the kitchen is open in the middle of the one room restaurant space. Food is great. Straight to the point, spaghetti or pasta this place has delicious food..

user_reviews.Name: tre son
user_reviews.Description: Cute little restaurant with a clean, welcoming atmosphere. I ordered the lasagna, and they brought out this crispy, delicious bread (see pic) with a spicy dip. So good. The lasagna came out right after, super cheesy and flavorful, with a generous portion. I ate half and took the rest to go. Reasonable prices and great food. Highly recommend. Definitely coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Hiwot Borga
user_reviews.Description: We ordered from Ethio Italy for 7 people and were so impressed! The food arrived fresh, well-packaged, and absolutely delicious with amazing taste. Every dish was flavorful and felt freshly made. Delivery was right on time, and the service was polite and professional. We’ll definitely order again—highly recommend!  (እጅ ይባረክ!)

user_reviews.Name: Melody Sois
user_reviews.Description:
A Hidden Gem for Italian and Ethiopian Cuisine!

If you’re looking for a unique dining experience that blends Italian and Ethiopian flavors, this restaurant is a must-visit! From the moment you step in, the cozy ambiance makes you feel at home. The service is excellent—attentive, friendly, and welcoming.

The food is simply delicious! Their Italian dishes, like pasta and pizza, are cooked to perfection, with rich flavors and fresh ingredients. And if you’re in the mood for Ethiopian cuisine, their Habesha dishes, like tebs, are equally amazing—well-seasoned and authentic.

Whether you’re craving a classic Italian meal or a taste of Ethiopia, this restaurant offers the best of both worlds. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Zelalemdesta
user_reviews.Description: Amazing, authentic food, generous portions, great prices, great service, chefs kiss! Ejachu yibarek! I've become a regular be ande.

user_reviews.Name: Ryo Matsumoto
user_reviews.Description:
Love this place. Nice and cozy, and more importantly it’s delicious.
I tried both an Ethiopian traditional dish (Tibs with Injera) and Italian (Pasta Al Pomodoro); both are great!

I went other popular Italian restaurants with good reviews like nearby Sapore Restaurant and Bella Pasta and Pizza.
Those places were more pricey and less tasty.

As a tourist, the friendly owner is another plus point.
She offered me a coffee after the meal, and we had a fun little chat.
I appreciate her kindness and will definitely visit again!

user_reviews.Name: Neftalem fikre
user_reviews.Description:
I FOUND the place by chance. I was hungry, in Bole area and the su. Was so hot..i just dripped by a small cafe/resturant by the road. First the vibe was nice and clean place and the balcony by the road made you feel as if one was in Rome itself.

Then the service by a young lady (Azeb) i think her name was. She was very polite, answered every question we had ( by that time my friend came in). We had pizza

The food was...Amazzzzzing! I always take photo of meals (jst for fun) but i had one bite and by the time i wanted to take a pic..i had finished it all..lol..hahaha. i do mot know abt other meal..but the pizza was sooo gooood...i even ate the crumps (i hate crumps). The cheese was so much and gooood...the sause (yes u do need sause on a pizza which ET places forget) ..the sause home made was sooo goooood.... Amazing

user_reviews.Name: Patrik Janko
user_reviews.Description: I only had pizza here, so I can’t judge the other food. However, their Margherita pizza doesn’t deserve even one star. The dough is dry and tastes as if they were trying to bake cookies, rolled out with a rolling pin. Then they decided to put canned tomato paste on this “cookie” and top it with a tasteless cheese that is nothing like mozzarella. I won’t even mention the “special” pizza — the combination of ingredients is definitely suitable only for the locals. I’m giving three stars for the very friendly service, the fact that the food is edible, and that the place is clean. However calling this place an Italian restaurant is clearly an insult for the Italians.

user_reviews.Name: Hodzic Saud
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been to many of the best restaurants in Addis Ababa, but this one truly stands out. Everything was just perfect – the decor, the atmosphere, the DJ, and the service were all top-notch. And the sushi was honestly one of the best I’ve ever had in my life.

user_reviews.Name: Alex Sole
user_reviews.Description: Went to try the brunch on sunday. Must say I was pleasantly surprised.  Its not the brunch you'd expect, it was more of a set menu lunch. Everything was good. Cocktails were good too. Left feeling very full and satisfied.

user_reviews.Name: Khadijah Brown
user_reviews.Description:
The food is alright and the service is just okay.  Food safety is just NOT it.. A piece of ice fell on the wet bar whilst the bartender was making my drink and he proceeded to sweep it into the glass...I was lucky to see this as I was seated at one of the bar tables! Of course I insisted the drink be remade but this should not have happened at all!
Do better please

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Mulugeta
user_reviews.Description: This fine dining started with a fancy electric shuttle Carriage ride, which brings guests up from the deep deep parking lot in the subbasement to the ground floor elevators.  Inside the restaurant you have huge tables with generous space between tables which gives the place classy vibes. The wait staff have excellent deportment and they seem well trained. In fact since we went in the middle of the afternoon and the place wasn't so crowded, they were having a training session in the back. As for the Sushi and Sashimi boats we ordered, it's nothing to rave about. The sushi rice especially 👎. Unevenly cooked and caked into a block. Miso soup with salmon in it also👎 Dessert was better. Some cake made with dates topped with ice cream - delicious.

user_reviews.Name: Ale Bolale
user_reviews.Description:
As a foodie who enjoys fine dining experiences, I had the pleasure of trying HOTTO, a modern Japanese-inspired Asian fusion restaurant in Addis Ababa. Overall, it was a pleasant experience and a good value for the price, especially considering the unique concept and stylish atmosphere. The location and ambiance were excellent elegant, modern, and inviting.

That said, there were a few areas that could be improved:

1.	Seating for Couples
I visited with my wife and was surprised to find there were no tables specifically arranged for couples. We had to sit at a table meant for four, which slightly diminished the intimate dining experience we were hoping for.

2.	Inconsistent Service
During our visit, four different waitresses attended to our table. This led to some confusion orders were forgotten, and we had to repeat requests as staff rotated. A more consistent service approach would greatly enhance the dining experience.

3.	Order Mistake with the Main Course
I ordered a medium-rare fillet of beef but was initially served a medium. I thought it was a kitchen error, but upon checking the bill, I realized the order was entered incorrectly. To their credit, they corrected it promptly and brought the steak as requested, which I appreciated.

4.	Lipstick on a Tea Glass😾
When we ordered tea, we noticed lipstick on one of the glasses. This was quite disappointing and not acceptable for an establishment of this caliber. Cleanliness and attention to detail in presentation are essential.

5.	Delays Between Courses
There was a significant delay between courses, especially when it came time to order dessert. We had to wait around 30 minutes and call the staff between meals to proceed with the next course.

Final Thoughts:
Despite these issues, HOTTO still stands out as a promising addition to Addis’s dining scene. The fusion menu is creative, and the atmosphere is ideal for special occasions. I especially appreciate the effort the team made to accommodate my special request for my wife it meant a lot😊

Thank you for the experience, and I look forward to seeing how HOTTO continues to grow and improve.

user_reviews.Name: Hilena Tafesse
user_reviews.Description:
We loved the food here.
The service was great and welcoming starting from the gate service.
The staff explained about the food which was fantastic. Everyone was so cooperative.
The place is very classy.  Great ambiance.
We loved the chicken teriyaki and Salmon.
Highly recommend it.

Oh and good coffee as well.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Loved the vibes classy yet cozy. Service is flawless i really really like the service here. food is delicious though the menu’s a bit limited. Still, you come for the fine dining, chic interior, and dreamy ambiance.

user_reviews.Name: Mariam Mohamad

the reopend Dashen Terara Traditional Restaurant around 22 is just perfect! The compound is big (ሲኖ ትራክ ያስጋልባል 😂) , with plenty of parking space, no stress at all. The atmosphere feels warm and welcoming, and the place looks really nice overall.

The staff is very welcoming and the restaurant is super clean. Food is like home M, I would recommend it as the best Ethiopian food I ever tried.

user_reviews.Name: Tarik Afework
user_reviews.Description: We visited their new location and were warmly welcomed by the lovely owner who took our order. There’s plenty of parking and a beautiful outdoor seating area. The staff were attentive, and the food was just as delicious as always. Definitely a place I’d come back to again.

user_reviews.Name: Adam Heiss
user_reviews.Description: Good traditional food but service can improve slightly. The entertainment was very good. The doro wot was a bit disappointing with only one small piece if chicken in a sea of sauce.

user_reviews.Name: Victoria Aadnesgaard
user_reviews.Description: Excellent traditional Ethiopian lunch. We had a vegitarian/fasting and meat platter and delicious ceremonial coffee. The staff were helpful and the owner was welcoming. She also assisted us with a taxi to get home.

user_reviews.Name: Kate Rez
user_reviews.Description:
A place to avoid.
Food is average quality; there are many more tasty places in Addis Ababa.
Prices are higher than other places, more than 2000 ETB for a portion of tibs...
And service is very BAD. Intentionally or not? But they seriously offended us. It is difficult to forget this unpleasant experience.

user_reviews.Name: Nebiyu Kifle
user_reviews.Description:
I came here for their Doro wet, since I was craving for it, and as an Ethiopian I was expecting great things since I have heard great reviews but it was a terrible experience. The doro was sub-par, it lacks spices, and the chicken leg we got was cut in half. We also ordered the Tibs and it was so small it wouldn't be enough for a toddler, let alone an adult. Things are expensive here.

But the interior was very nice, it was very beautiful, very traditional and shows Addis Ababa in its the old era.

title: Kategna Restaurant
address: Cameroon St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Juliana Siapai
user_reviews.Description: I went in for a late lunch and was not disappointed. The food was excellent, and it felt amazing to return to this restaurant after six years and find the same great vibe and consistency in quality. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Ethiopian cuisine. The shiro here is my absolute favorite!

user_reviews.Name: Anas Althami
user_reviews.Description:
Great experience - warm atmosphere and most importantly, delicious food!

Had tibs and don’t remember the name of the second order. Maybe wut.

Owner was so nice and offered a free macchiato on the house. Thanks, Kategna!

user_reviews.Name: Stacey Trock
user_reviews.Description:
Delicious Ethiopian food in a lovely setting. We were treated to dancers who were amazing!

If you're new, try the Katagna Special, which is a selection of dishes and easily feeds 4.

💳 Takes credit card

user_reviews.Name: Nathnael Tekabe
user_reviews.Description:
Kategna is an absolute gem of a restaurant and an experience you won't want to miss. We started with the meat firfir, and every bite was an incredible blend of savory spices and tender injera. The siga wot was equally impressive—the meat was so flavorful and cooked to perfection, with a rich, authentic sauce that truly stood out.
​Beyond the fantastic food, the entire atmosphere of the place is magical. The interior is stunning, filled with beautiful, intricate Ethiopian artifacts and decor that create a warm, inviting, and truly immersive dining environment. It’s clear that so much thought went into every detail.
​What really sealed the deal for us was the service. The staff was incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout our entire meal, making sure we had everything we needed without ever feeling rushed. It was genuinely a top-class experience from start to finish. I can't recommend Kategna enough; it's the perfect spot for delicious, authentic Ethiopian food and a wonderful evening out.

user_reviews.Name: jade P
user_reviews.Description: A specifically came to this restaurant for their doro wat, but what I seem to have been served is a small tiny drumstick of chewy meat in a big bowl of sauce with one egg. I paid a premium price for this. Everything else was fine at the restaurant. But my main dish was minuscule and chewy. I'm definitely not returning to this restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Mehalet Shibre
user_reviews.Description: Very beautiful breakfast experience we ordered 3 items + buna and we paid a little over 3,000birr. The portion size is pretty average but the taste was very nice. The service is amazing and the atmosphere felt welcoming. Only downside is the bathroom had no running water when we visited.

user_reviews.Name: Yafet Mola
user_reviews.Description:
Kategna Restaurant Recommendation!

Wonderful service, very friendly and attentive staff. The food is authentic, fresh, and full of flavor; the injera and the various meat and vegetable dishes are especially outstanding. The drinks are well-chosen, and the traditional Ethiopian coffee is a real highlight. All this in a cozy, warm atmosphere.

A restaurant that I highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: hadil Khalid
user_reviews.Description: Loved the vibe! Everything was perfect—the place, the staff were so friendly and helpful. We came for dinner and the food was super delicious

title: Akotet Restaurant
address: XPRH+XR8 Akotet Restaurant, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Baki Baki
user_reviews.Description: I recently tried Akotet, and it was absolutely delicious! 😋 The flavors were rich and perfectly spiced, with a mix of traditional Ethiopian dishes served on injera. Every bite had that authentic homemade taste from the tender meat to the flavorful sauces. Definitely a must-try for anyone who loves Ethiopian cuisine or wants to experience real, comforting flavors.

user_reviews.Name: Shalom Hailegeorgis
user_reviews.Description: I had a really good time at Akotet. The food tasted fresh and authentic. The place feels warm and cultural, and the staff were kind and welcoming. Simple, good food and a nice atmosphere.

user_reviews.Name: Etsub
user_reviews.Description: I've been to Akotet many times and i have even ordered from the restaurant via Zmall and Beu delivery and they always delivered the freshest food. Because the owner is a health care profressional she knows what it takes to prep and serve healthy but yet tasty meals to her clients as opposed to the already established traditional restaurants in town. Highly recommend this Akotet

user_reviews.Name: Abenezer Alemayehu
user_reviews.Description: I’ve had the pleasure of dining at Akotate three times, and it has quickly become one of my favorite Ethiopian restaurants. The kitfo is truly exceptional—rich in flavor, perfectly seasoned, and consistently delicious. The atmosphere is welcoming, the service is attentive, and the overall dining experience is outstanding. I highly recommend Akotate to anyone looking for authentic and delightful Ethiopian cuisine.

user_reviews.Name: Elsabeth Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description:
Never seen any restaurant in Addis do this before!

I ordered delivery from this restaurant last week and was really disappointed at first – I left an honest review mentioning the issues on Zmall. To my surprise, the owner called me personally the same evening , apologized sincerely, and sent an entirely new order on the house the next morning . The replacement food was excellent: fresh, perfectly spiced, and delicious . Mistakes happen with delivery, but the way they handled it was outstanding. This kind of customer care is rare these days. Changed my review to 5 stars because they truly turned a bad experience into a great one. Thanks for your excellent customer handling.
Will definitely order again!

user_reviews.Name: Teklil Miheret
user_reviews.Description: This is the best food I’ve ever had in a restaurant. It’s the first time I’ve ever found a place that gives me the same taste as my mom’s cooking and that’s saying a lot! It truly feels like home. I highly recommend this place.

user_reviews.Name: Yohannes Haile
user_reviews.Description: The kitfo I received through zmall delivery is very small and I'm disappointed...i've had much better kitfo from other restaurants for 1500 birr. check your cooking stafs! Or do better

user_reviews.Name: Peace Haile
user_reviews.Description: I went to Akotet for dinner and really enjoyed it. The food was tasty and felt very home-style, and the atmosphere made it even better. The staff were friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience feel easy and relaxed.

title: Radha's Indian Restaurant and Bar
address: Bole Japan, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Saraj
user_reviews.Description:
Awesome Atmosphere
This Restaurant is best of all I have seen in the Addis Ababa.
The food was delicious. feeling very good and excited to come next time.

user_reviews.Name: naveen shukla
user_reviews.Description:
Radha Indian Restaurant in Addis is truly a gem for anyone craving authentic Indian flavors. From the moment you step inside, the ambience instantly transports you to a warm, elegant Indian setting. Soft lighting, tasteful décor, and gentle Indian music playing in the background create a relaxing and culturally rich atmosphere perfect for families, friends, or business dinners.

The food quality is exceptional. Every dish is prepared with care, using fresh ingredients and traditional recipes that bring out the authentic taste of India. The flavors are balanced, aromatic, and perfectly spiced—not overpowering, but rich enough to remind you of home. Whether it’s their curries, tandoori items, biryanis, or starters, each plate reflects the chef’s skill and commitment to high standards.

One of the highlights of Radha is the outstanding hospitality. The owner, Mr. Srivastava, personally greets guests with genuine warmth and ensures they have a memorable dining experience. His attention to detail and passion for Indian cuisine truly elevate the restaurant.

Overall, Radha Indian Restaurant is a must-visit in Addis for its delicious food, soothing ambience, soulful Indian music, and exceptional service. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Indian hospitality and taste.

user_reviews.Name: GAURAV GUPTA
user_reviews.Description:
⭐ Radha Indian Restaurant – Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: A Truly Satisfying Indian Culinary Experience

Radha Restaurant stands out as one of Addis Ababa’s finest destinations for authentic Indian cuisine. My recent dining experience showcased their consistency, flavorful dishes, and warm hospitality.

We began with Veg Cream Soup and Chicken Hot & Sour Soup—both comforting and well-balanced in flavor. The appetizers were excellent: Chilly Paneer was perfectly tossed, Hara Bhara Kabab crisp and green with fresh herbs, and the Seekh Kabab, Mutton Galouti Kabab, and Tandoori Chicken delivered that unmistakable smoky tandoor aroma. The Dragon Paneer added a delightful Indo-Chinese kick.

Among the mains, the Paneer Do Pyaza, Dal Tadka, and Dal Khichdi were flavorful and comforting. The Authentic Chicken Curry and Mutton Rogan Josh were rich, aromatic, and cooked to melt-in-the-mouth perfection. Their breads are especially noteworthy—crispy, fresh, and a perfect companion to every curry.

If you visit on a Saturday, do not miss their Hyderabadi Dum Biryani. It is fragrant, well-spiced, and truly one of the highlights of their menu.

Overall, Radha Restaurant offers a wonderful combination of authentic flavors, generous portions, and a welcoming ambiance. Highly recommended for anyone craving quality Indian cuisine in Addis Ababa.
---

user_reviews.Name: Dharmjeet Pandey
user_reviews.Description:
I don’t know why people are giving positive review but to be very honest I found this restaurant not worthy.

One day I visited there and ordered Daal Tadka, Steamed rice and Kadhai mushroom but Kadhai mushroom was not well cooked as mushroom felt like chewy and even I was not able to cut it through spoon for which I complained and they make it again but same thing happen again. I gave them warning that I will return back to your restaurant and then I will share my final review.

Next day I was there with my colleague and ordered Mutton rogan jose, Chicken Biryani, Garlic naan. Food taste was good but mutton was having 4 small pieces but with bones only which I felt bad that even paying such amount we got which we were not expecting.

Finally our bill was for 2,529.71 birr for which I paid 26,00 birr and I didn’t got my change back and after complaining they brought less 10 Birr.

Conclusion: If you want better atmosphere then you can visit but don’t expect satisfactory food from them.

I’m feeling bad while writing this review but I can’t mislead people so better you go for Chilies Addis or Konark Indian restaurant but don’t waste your time and money here.

user_reviews.Name: Abita Alex
user_reviews.Description: Great Indian food with authentic flavors. The dishes are fresh well seasoned and served in good portions. Nice atmosphere and very friendly staff. Service is quick and professional. Definitely one of the best Indian restaurants in Addis Ababa. Highly recommended!!!

user_reviews.Name: Abel Abela
user_reviews.Description:
Great taste, lovable ambiance.
Visited with group of 6 local friends. Everyone enjoyed the place, food and service.
Manager welcomed us like his family. Friendly service staff made our dining experience much more comfortable.
Hat's off to team Radhas.
Would highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Toby Carson
user_reviews.Description:
I dined at Radha’s Kitchen last week with an Indian colleague and, to my surprise, I ended up eating much more than I usually do and still didn’t want to stop! 😄 The food was absolutely lip smacking and not just delicious but also felt fresh and hygienic.
That’s worth mentioning because, during my previous trip to Ethiopia about five months ago, I had some not so great experiences at other places that resulted in a bad stomach. Thankfully, this time it was quite the opposite! Brilliant food, and no after effects.
The ambience was warm and welcoming, and the service was prompt and courteous. Overall, a truly pleasant dining experience.
I m definitely coming back to try the rest of their menu. Keep it up, Radha’s Kitchen! Now I know exactly where to go whenever I crave authentic Indian food during my stay in Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: karan daswani
user_reviews.Description:
Had amazing food with marvelous ambiance.
Food is simply mouth watering, paneer is soft to it's maximum limit. For tandoori chicken have no words. Keep in mouth and feel the taste and fragrance.
No missing of authentic Indian taste and aroma of spices. Music selection is simply awesome..
Place is cozy with perfect blend of indian and Ethiopian cultural touch. Perfect place to enjoy with family and friends.last but not least very comfortable place for karaoke...
Highly recommended....

title: Mesti Restaurant
address: 22 Mazoriya, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Insos Jawa Get Lost Safely
user_reviews.Description: Our guide took us here, a hidden gem! The food choices during lunch we had was incredibly diverse and delicious. It was plant based and full of tastes. I can only recommend this restaurant and will come back when visiting Addis Ababa again in the future.

user_reviews.Name: Nadine A
user_reviews.Description: Excellent food. Big portions. Friendly staff. Indoors and outdoors seating. I had the yummiest and spiciest tuna wrap. Chicken curry was also delicious.Prices are probably a bit higher than other places.

user_reviews.Name: Michael Schienke (VORBILDarchitecture)
user_reviews.Description:
I went to lunch here with a friend and I wish I would have done the movie when the whole buffet was full of people!
Very cool place, clearly popular, and the food is fresh and tasty.

Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Bahre Edred
user_reviews.Description: The service is well oiled. The food is also to die for. But I have to  say something not much as a criticism but having observed some oddities. The place is often frequented by folks of older generation. May be because its close to governmental institution but it feels uncomfortable to bring a date there. All is well besides feeling watched and judged by elders dining there and may be the place needs some incentive to attract youthful spirit. Thank u great place though.

user_reviews.Name: Dayal
user_reviews.Description:
The waiting time for our order was around 30 minutes, which was a bit long considering the restaurant wasn’t very busy. The table cover provided wasn’t particularly clean, which gave us a poor first impression.

As for the food, it was disappointing. The pepper steak was well below average and lacked flavor. The fish cutlet had a nice crispiness, but the accompanying fried chips were overcooked and so hard we could barely bite into them.

Unfortunately, the service didn’t make up for the food quality. The staff seemed indifferent and somewhat impatient, which added to the overall lackluster experience. For the price, we expected better food and more attentive service.

user_reviews.Name: Hilena Tafesse
user_reviews.Description:
Such a lovely place. Great food.
The location is more convenient for a personal vehicle users.

Tried both fasting and none fasting cousins and both were amazing.
They do have a delivery service as well.

user_reviews.Name: Aida A
user_reviews.Description:
A surprising find deep in the heart of the Haya-hulet area. Mesti Restaurant is a family restaurant that serves delicious foods, both traditional and continental.
Tuesday nights are particularly special as a live band plays a jazzy tune reminiscent of a piano bar. This band even has a cellist ... the first I've seen in Addis!
Diners can choose to be seated outdoors or indoors. For those seated outdoors, each chair offers a fleece blanket as evenings do get chilly.
An absolute gem of a place!

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Mulugeta
user_reviews.Description: The compartmentalized space usage in this place makes for a captivating ambiance. Mixed n matched furniture, patio style backyard seating, living room like inside seating and restaurant type rooms combined make sure you won't ever get bored in this place. Fasting buffet looks wonderful although I didn't eat on the occasion I came here with a group. I'll certainly pay this place a visit one day soon.

title: Chillies Addis
address: Addis Ababa ,Bole opp to New Stadium Next to Addissinia Hotel, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: Addis Ababa ,Bole opp to New Stadium Next to Addissinia Hotel

user_reviews.Name: Anandhakumar Sannasi
user_reviews.Description:
Top class Food,Service and Ambiance for Travelers who are desparately looking for Indian food. Options for choosing Chinese, Traditional Ethiopian and Continental Foods are available.

Have enjoyed it thoroughly during my stay in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Dharmjeet Pandey
user_reviews.Description:
This review is in part please read it carefully.

I  tried food 4 days when I was in Addis and I really admired the taste but last day I ordered  thali which really disappointed me. To be very honest never ever try any thali here, it's a trash nothing else. On the top of it menu doesn't say that what will be served in Thali and they serve whatever is remaining at the restaurant.

Thali comes with only one stale chapati which was drg and when I asked for another chapati they brought same previousle cooked chapati and you will be amazed that even that was stale chapati and I was charged for the same.

Try other items here but never ever try their tasteless trash here

Edit after 2 months: I found this restaurant has improved its services and food so I have changed my review

user_reviews.Name: Alex Thiel
user_reviews.Description:
Just went there because of some reviews and my appetite for India cuisine. By walking the greeting a potential paying customer failed completely. Not the best start. Atmosphere is probably as good as on a gas station. Not really great vibes. Maybe because it was empty kind of.
Service showed to a nicer room. Wasn’t really. Menu quiet substantial.
Food came in a good timely manner. Wasn’t bad but not really great either. Chicken tikka masala was the best. Toilet could have get cleaned better. Never really understand when so much staff is around that nobody checks on things like it. What I think what’s missing, is passion.

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: The ambiance is excellent, making it a great spot to socialize. However, the food fell short of expectations. I ordered mutton biryani, but small bone fragments were scattered throughout the fried rice, and I had to pick them out while eating.

user_reviews.Name: Saravanan Mani
user_reviews.Description: Food is very delicious, especially the Idli and Dosa. Better than any other restaurant in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: mariem adem
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely loved the food! Very clean and calming environment. The service was also pleasing. Highly recommend it if you want to try Indian food. I just wished there were more speakers that played Indian melodies. 🙏

user_reviews.Name: Li Hua 丽华
user_reviews.Description: The veg biryani was not good. The rice quality was poor and didn’t taste fresh. The flavors were bland, and the overall dish was disappointing. I expected better.

user_reviews.Name: Mukesh Tailor
user_reviews.Description: Delicious Food - I ordered the butter chicken masala combo . It came with a best nan bread I have eaten - it was nice and fluffy. The butter chicken had enough sauce and chicken pieces. You cannot go wrong with this combo.

title: Te Amo Addis
address: 2Q79+7M Te Amo Addis, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: lidya abebe
user_reviews.Description:
If you are looking for an authentic and heartwarming dining experience in Addis Ababa, look no further. We recently visited this Mexican spot, and it was easily one of the highlights of our week.

The Food

The food is simply amazing. From the freshness of the ingredients to the authentic flavors, every dish exceeded our expectations. Whether you’re a fan of classic burritos or looking for something more substantial, the kitchen here knows exactly what they are doing.

The Service

What truly sets this place apart, however, is the exceptional customer service. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with genuine warmth.

Family-Friendly Atmosphere

We visited with our new born child, and the treatment we received was incredible. The staff went out of their way to make sure our little one was comfortable and happy. It is rare to find a place that manages to be both professional and so deeply personal—we truly felt like we were at home.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Negash
user_reviews.Description: It is one of the best Mexican restaurant in the city. They had a large selection of food which is really tasty with a great service. I highly recommend anyone craving for some delicious food to visit here.

user_reviews.Name: amanuel berhane
user_reviews.Description: We ordered the chicken tacos, which were the day’s special. However, the waiter didn’t ask whether we preferred soft or hard-shell tacos and ended up bringing us the hard ones, which I personally didn’t enjoy. He also didn’t offer the spicy sauce, so we were served the regular one, which again wasn’t to my taste. Overall, the place has a cozy and relaxing atmosphere, but the food was just average.

user_reviews.Name: Gabriela Alberola
user_reviews.Description: I love that they had many vegan options. I ate here several times during my time in Addis. The atmosphere was great. Prices and portion sizes were legit. It's mexican food with an ethiopian twist. I was expecting my tortilla chips to be corn chips but they were flour tortilla chips. The guacamole was really good. I recommend this place if you're craving some tex-mex comfort food.

user_reviews.Name: Dayal
user_reviews.Description: We’ve dined at this restaurant twice. The first time, we had dinner and were very impressed with the food. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, adding to the overall experience. The waitress was polite, and we were able to communicate without any issues. We highly recommend the Fish Tacos – they’re crispy, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. It’s definitely a dish worth trying!

user_reviews.Name: 国弘田
user_reviews.Description:
The food is really good. Rich in flavour and tender.
However, I ordered a cocktail, the waitress told me the tequila is running out so they need to use another tequila. She didn't tell me extra costs were charged. I ended up paying twice of the price on the menu.

user_reviews.Name: Wondwosen Seyoum
user_reviews.Description: We had the fish enchiladas and fish fajitas—both were delicious. The spice level was just right for our taste. Excellent service, and the cocktail was great. Everything was reasonably priced. Highly recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Patrik Janko
user_reviews.Description: Best churros in this location. Quesadilla and Tacos are also delicious. The owner is very kind. Came to wish us a good appetite and wanted to hear our honest opinion. You can definitely tell it's her passion, not only a business 👍

title: Tamem Kitfo(Tradtional Restaurant) Gerji | ቴማም ክትፎ ገርጂ
address: 2R22+FXF Tamem Kitfo(Tradtional Restaurant) Gerji | ቴማም ክትፎ ገርጂ, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Tamem Kitfo(Tradtional Restaurant) Gerji | ቴማም ክትፎ ገርጂ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Simegn Shume
user_reviews.Description: Great authentic Kitifo and great optional Ethiopian foods. Great team !

user_reviews.Name: dereje tsegaye
user_reviews.Description: One of my favorite place to eat kitfo and gomen besega .

user_reviews.Name: Girma Berta
user_reviews.Description: Tamem Kitfo has the best, most authentic kitfo in town!

user_reviews.Name: Boaz Jesus
user_reviews.Description: Such awesome place to have a local ground meat mixed with local spices. A finger licking food anyone can experience here. Tamem, the best place!

user_reviews.Name: Leoul Fasil
user_reviews.Description: Such an excellent service 👏 👌  best wot

user_reviews.Name: Johannes_ M
user_reviews.Description: A really awesome kitfo with a traditional Guraghe touch. I enjoyed it

user_reviews.Name: Biniam G Kebede
user_reviews.Description: Kitfo is a caltural food! Chopped meet mixed with butter. The house specializes in that. But they also have other caltural foods

user_reviews.Name: igwe Daniel
user_reviews.Description: Tasty food, clean environment

title: Fitsum Shiro bet - ፍፁም ሽሮ ቤት
address: XQXP+RF9 Fitsum Shiro bet - ፍፁም ሽሮ ቤት, beside Helzer, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Fitsum Shiro bet - ፍፁም ሽሮ ቤት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Expert Reviewer
user_reviews.Description: I think this is the only fully vegan restaurant in Addis Ababa. Came here about 4 times in my short 3 day visit. You won’t find cheaper food elsewhere. Even the coffee/tea is the best. Honest establishment. One staff member speaks decent English.

user_reviews.Name: Marvin Schönauer
user_reviews.Description: Best vegan restaurant in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Measu Bellay
user_reviews.Description: We had vegan /tsom tibs at this restaurant and it is unbelievably amazing. I couldn’t believe it was tsom food. I highly, highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great fasting options!

user_reviews.Name: lisa z
user_reviews.Description: best local foods I had during my grande Africa tour.

user_reviews.Name: Etsub Tasew
user_reviews.Description: Hidden gem in Addis! We ate shiro, vegan sandwiches, and  fasting Tibes which were really good. Their service was great as well.

user_reviews.Name: Meron Franke
user_reviews.Description: Very cute place with good vegan food

user_reviews.Name: Nathanael Tamirat Getnet
user_reviews.Description: I love this place. It is the best vegan restaurant in Addis Ababa, PERIOD

user_reviews.Name: Namrata Subramanian
user_reviews.Description: Amazing and inexpensive food!!! I highly highly recommend, especially to vegan travelers.

title: Mitmita
address: Millennium Apartment Hotel Rd, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Lewam Salah
user_reviews.Description: This restaurant is truly exceptional. The hospitality is warm and welcoming from the moment you walk in, and the staff treat you with genuine care. The food is fresh, perfectly seasoned, and beautifully presented. Every dish feels thoughtful and flavorful. The atmosphere is clean, comfortable, and inviting. Overall, it’s a wonderful place to relax, enjoy great food, and feel well taken care of. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Fabian Schellhaas
user_reviews.Description: Had a lovely breakfast after arriving in Addis. Food was delicious, staff was super attentive and kind (they even gave us free coffee), and the vibe was very chill and serene. Wonderful first introduction to Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Amelina Carter
user_reviews.Description: Asefa was really great! He answered all of our questions, and was really attentive. The food was excellent. I loved the Awaze tibs and the Kitfo. Would definitely recommend to anyone in Addis

user_reviews.Name: Nuhamin Abera
user_reviews.Description: Me and my friends wanted to grab a home taste food and our number one choice was mitmita. They serve a delicious cultural foods with a chill atmosphere. You should atleast try it out once.

user_reviews.Name: Winta Assefa
user_reviews.Description:
I went here on a weekday and had a lovely dinner with new friends. I was mostly excited about the fact that they had jebena coffee, and I had a warm, delicious dose of it right from the jebena.
Their injera, souf and lentil wett was delicious. I only tasted part of the vegetarian potions and what I had was wonderful.
The waiters were friendly and the place didn't have loud music, so we could all hear each other talk. That was nice.

user_reviews.Name: brhane hailu
user_reviews.Description:
Mitmita restaurant in Bole is an absolute gem located conveniently in front of millennium hall and near Ambassador Hotel. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with traditional Ethiopian decor that sets the perfect tone for an authentic dining experience. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure every guest feels welcomed and well taken care of.

But the real star of the show is the food. The menu offers a wide variety of traditional Ethiopian dishes, all bursting with flavor and expertly prepared. From the tender doro wat to the spicy kitfo, every dish is a culinary delight that will leave your taste buds singing. And don't even get me started on the injera - it's some of the best I've ever had.

Overall, Mitmita restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking to experience the rich flavors of Ethiopian cuisine in a welcoming and cozy setting. I can't recommend it highly enough!

user_reviews.Name: tsegaye woldesemayat
user_reviews.Description: Usually I use to eat traditional food and it's amazing. The service is super for me. I recommend this restaurants for their traditional foods

user_reviews.Name: Saron Dereje
user_reviews.Description: Everything was phenomenal. Food exceptional, atmosphere a vibe, service (Radia) was amazing. Will definitely come again!

title: Belvedere Restaurant
address: NEW STADIUM, Addis Ababa in front of ASHAM TV, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: amanuel berhane
user_reviews.Description: One of the best spots for Italian food in Addis the ravioli with cream and lasagna with pesto are a must-try, so😋. The staff are friendly, and the atmosphere is really nice.

user_reviews.Name: P M
user_reviews.Description:
I have a theory. If you see several groups of elderly people comfortably sitting in a restaurant, taking their time and looking like regulars, then the food must be good. This theory did not fail.

The food was really good, the owner extremely friendly and the waiters always ready to jump to fulfil  requests. I can definitely recommend .

user_reviews.Name: Yanet Eyassu
user_reviews.Description: Went here for a special family occasion and the food and service was more than I expected. I was extremely satisfied and the prices were fair considering the quality we received.

user_reviews.Name: Asayech Bahru
user_reviews.Description: Had lasagna and steak for lunch. The lasagna is delicious, the steak was meh. We found the portions to be too small. The staff are attentive, but come off a bit strong for me personally.

user_reviews.Name: M Martin
user_reviews.Description: Excellent Italian food. We've been here twice with friends and both times had the lasagna. Can't go wrong. One of our friends tried the gnocchi and liked it. Will probably come again.

user_reviews.Name: Mohamed Hamad
user_reviews.Description: One of the best restaurants in Addis, home Italian food. It taste yummy. We had ravioli, lasagna, veal and tiramisu for dessert. Very good service.

user_reviews.Name: Christian M.
user_reviews.Description:
The salad and sparkling water were unfortunately disappointing. The ingredients were very basic — nothing that couldn’t be found at any street vendor, aside from a touch of balsamic vinegar and maybe the one slice of cheese. For the quality offered, it felt overpriced.

The setting also left something to be desired: the tablecloth was worn and frayed, and the chairs were not cushioned, which made the atmosphere less comfortable. Overall, I wouldn’t recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: World Changer
user_reviews.Description: Absolutely wonderful restaurant 🤌🏼 Atmosphere and decor was very nice, service was excellent, and the food was amazing. The lasagna is delicious. I look forward to returning to try their other entrees.

user_reviews.Name: Anne LV
user_reviews.Description: I don't know about the food but the place is beautiful and new. We went there to see a Manchester derby, all the attendees were watching the game in a pleasant atmosphere. I will update my review once i try what the place has to offer!

title: Ethiopian Ta'em Cultural Restaurant
address: XQQQ+6W7 Ethiopian Ta'em Cultural Restaurant, Airport Rd, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Yuen Yee Wan (YY)
user_reviews.Description:
We were transiting and had the buffet lunch here. There was a very large spread of traditional Ethiopian food.

Eden was very patient and explained the dishes to us so we weren’t overwhelmed. We got to try the famous raw beef dishes, and of course the different stews that are more mainstream back in the US where we’ve had Ethiopian food.

Everything was very tasty. Granted, we haven’t had much Ethiopian food before so this was easily the best Ethiopian food we’ve had 🤣 Would recommend trying this if you’re stopping over instead of the European buffet so you get a taste of the local cuisine!

The only strange thing was I think we were the only two people eating the lunch buffet for the whole lunch session. What happens to the rest of the food? 🤔

user_reviews.Name: Marianna Arkoulaki
user_reviews.Description:
I am a transit passenger staying at the Skylight Hotel.
I had dinner and tried the traditional food at the hotel’s traditional restaurant. The food was excellent, and the service was great.
Zelalem was very kind and friendly. I highly recommend it to everyone.

user_reviews.Name: 김진서
user_reviews.Description: It was rly good it was the best Ethiopian food I've ever had in my life! Yehwalashet was so nice and welcoming ! Definitely recommend to come here for the authentic Ethiopian experience

user_reviews.Name: Kellson Marcus
user_reviews.Description:
I was pleasantly surprised with my visit to the restaurant. The space is extremely well decorated with nods to Ethiopia's rich culture and history. The food was simply divine, I ordered one of the "Non-Fasting" platters, and it didn't disappoint. The portion sizes are very generous, and it could have easily fed more than one person. During my visit, there were musical and dance presentations that also furthered my experience and the enjoyment of all people there.

This is definitely one of the best restaurants I have ever been to, and I'll make sure to pay another visit in the future.

user_reviews.Name: Juan Fernandez
user_reviews.Description: Just tried it tonight while in transit. Excellent food and ambience. Highly recommended for Ethiopian food

user_reviews.Name: Harold Gray
user_reviews.Description: Amazing food and staff! Eden and Daniel S. Provided exceptional customer service.  Best food I had during my visit!

user_reviews.Name: Scott Forler
user_reviews.Description: Excellent choice of traditional Ethiopian food. Particularly good attention by my server, Zelalem.

user_reviews.Name: Leandro Galvão
user_reviews.Description: Buffet restaurant with Ethiopian traditional food, with open buffet. Food is mildly spicy but very fresh with plenty of vegetarian options. Staff is very friendly, even Abreham was kind enough to explain me all of the many dishes offered.

title: Hebir Ethiopia Cultural Restaurant | Bole | ህብር ኢትዮጲያ ባህላዊ ሬስቶራንት | ቦሌ

user_reviews.Name: Parin Kothari
user_reviews.Description: Hebir is a cultural experience on a modern main street of Addis Ababa. So easily accessible to foreigners. The place is huge with traditional decor, a small outdoor patio and a glass frontage facing the street for people watching as modern life passes by. The food is good, not the greatest but worth it when you think of the location and decor. The staff is friendly but always in a hurry.

user_reviews.Name: Hussain Almoamen
user_reviews.Description:
Don’t miss the burger in there.
Place is amazing, food is delicious and atmosphere is fantastic.
I like how they have different places to chill, the traditional historical atmosphere, the modern one and the garden too.
They also have their own coffee where they get it done and rosted there.
I highly recommend this place and it deserves 5 starts ⭐

user_reviews.Name: Ibro Man
user_reviews.Description:
Hebir Restaurant, right in the heart of Bole 🔥
It was great before, then for a while it wasn’t hitting the same — but now it’s back and amazing.
The Hibir Burger is back, and it’s really great, totally worth it.
Add the nice view and the Bole vibe, and it’s a solid place to enjoy good food.

user_reviews.Name: Naveen K
user_reviews.Description: Delicious authentic food with a fun and traditional environment!  The service is friendly and kind and quick.  The flavors are top notch!

user_reviews.Name: Tinsae Fetene
user_reviews.Description:
Tasty food with a good portion✌️
The place is a little bit old yet the vibe is still good.

user_reviews.Name: Nimesh Wimalasena
user_reviews.Description: This is my second time in Addis , last year it was so difficult to find a good restaurant for food.I recommend this place to all foreigners as it delivers exceptional services and clean , delicious both western and traditional Ethiopian food.I keep coming next time too.Good vibe, affordable prices ,cozy atmosphere.. Additionally Police is assigned at the entrance ,stress free from troubles.

user_reviews.Name: JHA
user_reviews.Description: The place has been there for am sure more than 20 years after recent improvements the place has had some adjustments to its appearance but still needs improvements especially lightings, but the food is quite amazing. Makes you want to go again, not heavy on the stomach and quite tasty to eat. Service has always been an issue especially on weekends love how they manage their staff same faces for years but they need training and motivation to do their jobs with love and energy. The toilets surprisingly are very clean even after all these years. The view from the window sides is amazing to look at the street life of this vibrant city. Needs more additional TV's especially on weekends to accommodate the young youth of the city.

user_reviews.Name: Ryan Jose Ruiz III
user_reviews.Description:
“Delicious and authentic!”

This place serves incredible Ethiopian food! The injera was soft and tangy, and the lentils and beef tibs were full of flavor. The staff was friendly and the atmosphere cozy.

Menu is mixed with habesha, african and mid-eastern dishes. Alcoholic drinks are also available. Credit card accepted. The resto design is quintessentially Ethiopian.

Great spot for a unique and satisfying meal. Highly recommend!

title: Entoto Restaurant
address: Abyssinia Real Estate Building, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Nuhamin Abera
user_reviews.Description:
I went to Entoto with my little sister for a birthday lunch staring at 6:30 local time. They had strictly business coded outfit rule and kids under the age of 10 is not allowed which we were informed via text message last minute but they let us to enter since it was their fault for delayed delivery of information yet they changed our table set. Overall the place is a fusion of elegance and artistry, every details of each corner is perfectly designed to impress and had a promising dinning experience with a beautifully presented plate yet the feast for the eyes ended when we took a bite. The flavor fails to deliver a satisfaction with poor seasoning and unevenly cooked meals. The staffs tried to enhance our experience, offering a good cup of coffee afterwards unfortunately the hospitality can't compensate the disappointment.
Beside the restaurant the place also have a beautiful art gallery, gift shops with unique items and a coffee shop. They serve amazing pastries and healthy smoothies as well.

user_reviews.Name: Henokabba
user_reviews.Description:
Entoto Restaurant
Bole Japan Embassy

If you're looking for a perfect dining experience in Addis Abeba, Entoto Restaurant is definitely worth a visit. Located conveniently near the Japan Embassy and not far from the airport, it offers an ideal spot for both locals and travelers seeking a relaxed yet refined atmosphere.
The setting is nothing short of impressive. The restaurant features a beautiful gallery that adds a touch of elegance, complemented by luxurious furniture that enhances the overall dining experience. Whether you're there for a casual meal or a special occasion, the ambiance is both calming and inviting, making it a great place to unwind.

When it comes to the food, Entoto doesn’t disappoint. The menu features a variety of fresh and flavorful dishes. The salad is light and crisp, the vegetable soup is comforting and both the spaghetti and gnocchi are cooked to perfection, rich in flavor without being overwhelming. Each dish feels like it’s made with care and attention to detail.

What truly stands out, however, is the attentive staff. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted with warm hospitality. The service is prompt and the staff is more than happy to cater to your needs, making the experience feel personal and memorable.

Whether you’re in the mood for a leisurely meal or need a quiet place to reflect, Entoto Restaurant’s combination of great food, serene environment and exceptional service makes it a standout choice.

Highly recommended

user_reviews.Name: Kirubel Seyoum
user_reviews.Description:
The place has 3 different spots located side by side. The gallary, the cafe and the restaurant. I only got to experience the first two.
The gallery has an eye-catching exterior wall facade design. it's a glass wall with beautiful patterns cut off from beveled squares arranged on a grid. There are also crafts displayed for people passing by. Inside, you'll find delicately made decorations, artworks, accessories and tools all made by talented and creative individuals.  I really loved the whole vibe of it.
And the Cafe was a casual and cozy one, nothing too crazy. It's a great spot to sit and talk. Its a great place overall!

user_reviews.Name: Hiền Kim
user_reviews.Description: On my first visit at 7 PM on a Wednesday, the restaurant said they didn't have a table available if I hadn't made a reservation; I assumed the restaurant must be really good. On my next visit during lunch, there wasn't anything particularly special except for the raw beef dish, which I really enjoyed. If you're famished, I advise against going to this restaurant because the food takes a long time to arrive – almost 30 minutes between the first and second dishes, even though there were only 3 tables of customers at that time. Drinks also took a while. I didn't have enough time to eat the last dish and left it untouched. Overall, the restaurant experience wasn't very positive

user_reviews.Name: anduamlak temesgen
user_reviews.Description:
Entoto Restaurant – Tikur Anbesa Branch (Menged Dar)
The issues I faced were as follows:

Extremely Poor Customer Service:

The staff showed limited attentiveness and hospitality.

We waited a long time before even being acknowledged and attended to.

Customer requests were not handled with courtesy or urgency.

Unreasonably Delayed Food Service:

Our order took an excessively long time to be served, without any explanation or apology.

Other customers also appeared frustrated due to the slow service.

user_reviews.Name: Wengel Alemayehu
user_reviews.Description: We ordered the Arba Minch fish dish, but when it arrived it was very cold, like it had just come out of the fridge. We asked them to remake it properly, but instead they only reheated it in the microwave. Unfortunately, it was still unpleasant and very disappointing.

user_reviews.Name: Rooney Getu
user_reviews.Description:
Expensive!! but the food is really outstanding! Every meal we had was full of flavor and cooked to perfection. I really suggest the "MUKET" dish.

The atmosphere is  great! Cozy atmosphere, soft lighting with stunning art gallery and gift shop.

user_reviews.Name: Andy Turnbull
user_reviews.Description: This is a review of the gift shop, not the restaurant.  This is the perfect place to buy gifts for your loved ones. The staff we're very friendly and very helpful. The shop is a treasure trove of Ethiopian handicrafts, ornaments, clothing, books, coffee, soaps, so much to choose from. All at a very reasonable price. You will also help unprivileged women and those living with HIV by buying products here. It also has a fantastic art gallery, a cafe and a restaurant.

Otherwise the atmosphere is wonderful for either family, or business, or out with friends. They have a little sports bar and great cocktails.

user_reviews.Description: Love this place! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, perfect for breakfast or brunch. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented especially the eggs meals. The staff were kind, attentive, and made us feel right at home. A lovely start to the day highly recommend for anyone looking for a cozy spot with great food and good vibes.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Really like this spot! The interior is stylish and the vibes are great, especially the outdoor seating definitely my favorite. Food is good overall. Service can be a bit slow, but it’s not a dealbreaker. Worth visiting for a chill meal and cozy atmosphere to hangout with friends.

user_reviews.Name: Ayda Belay
user_reviews.Description: We had ordered the Escalope au Vin/Citron and the Lasagna Bolognese for delivery and we were disappointed. The stake came with no sauce, just bare meat (the order had wine/citrus sauce) . And the lasagna was also very dry. Bad food experience overall

I just felt like I needed to say this. The food is great but not fresh. I mean I think you ought to heat it up properly.
I just got really really sick thank god im not in the hospital but please this might be a coincidence never had the lasagna. Will never have it again.

Every other food I've tried was fine. But the breakfast is better since its made to order.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Yilma
user_reviews.Description:
The worst experience!

We were really excited to try their Italian dishes since they had good reviews. Unfortunately,the experience turned into a nightmare! We both ended up with food poisoning and It was shocking to find out that we both called in sick the next morning and spent the entire day in the hospital 🙄

Given the atmosphere of the place, we never expected poor hygiene to be an issue. We even considered reporting this to the Food and Drug Administration.Super disappointed!

user_reviews.Name: Tolosa kebede
user_reviews.Description: We ordered The classic burger and Combo with chicken meat. The meat of the burger is not cooked well. The combo was good especially the pasta with bolognese sauce.

user_reviews.Name: Dave Samuel
user_reviews.Description: I thought this place was a French cafe but found that they do amazing pasta better than some Italian places, I had spaghetti bolognese, carbonara and their Mediterranean burger, the pasta was extraordinary 👌, and their burger was average for me. I also like their place it's very attractive.

user_reviews.Name: aji wijono
user_reviews.Description:
I like this place—it's within walking distance from my apartment.
It has a traditional Ethiopian ambiance, with occasional dance and music performances.
The menu includes goat and beef dishes, and the service is relatively fast.
They also serve traditional wine, “Honey Wine.”
The prices are quite reasonable for the quality of service.

user_reviews.Name: Simon Tefera
user_reviews.Description:
At the time you entered to the restaurant you see true ethiopian spectacle culture.
The music they bump is also traditionally collected.

user_reviews.Name: Ermias Alemayehu
user_reviews.Description:
If you are a kitfo and Ethiopian traditional food lover, this is the place you are looking for. An amazing taste of food with a great service.
There is also a traditional live band and performance which is available after 7:30 PM which makes it even more great to enjoy with friends and family. Team Dessalech 🤗🤗🤗

user_reviews.Name: Biniyam
user_reviews.Description:
Dessalech Kitfo has a very authentic Ethiopian dishes including the traditional Ethiopian music. The food is so tasty and delicious. I really enjoyed the musical performance of different artists performed at the stage. It also helps you to try different traditional dances which helps you to remember various traditional dances from different parts of Ethiopia.

I highly recommend everyone to try and find out the true test of music and food at Dessalech Kitfo. Be aware that, the "Kitfo" is so tasty and delicious.

user_reviews.Name: Hilena Tafesse
user_reviews.Description:
My favorite Kitfo place in town.
I love this Fento combo.
Place is very cultural and they have a good traditional dancing sessions .

user_reviews.Name: Tina F
user_reviews.Description: 10/10 recommended. Visited the place at the last day of my visit in Addis. The food was really amazing, the price is cheaper than most places I have been to for Kitfo and the atmosphere and the people are really kind and welcoming.

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: The cultural food named Kitfo is the best of all, the drink Tej as well. Since the space is small the music is a bit disturbing and too loud. Except that, I recommend it to everyone!

user_reviews.Name: Henok Getachew
user_reviews.Description: The food was great, the service was awesome 👌

user_reviews.Name: hellen amde
user_reviews.Description: One of my favorite places to eat! The food is always fresh and delicious, the service is friendly, and the atmosphere is welcoming. I always enjoy my experience here and highly recommend it to anyone looking for great food and good vibes

user_reviews.Name: Hannah.M
user_reviews.Description: I went here for lunch and the atmosphere is warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed meal. The food was delicious, though it did take a little while to arrive. I really enjoyed the flavors, but I found the lasagna portion a bit small. Overall, it’s a lovely spot worth visiting!

user_reviews.Name: BuffaloSteve
user_reviews.Description: My first restaurant in Ethiopia and it did not disappoint. Minchet Alecha was delicious as was the smooth, silky Shiro Be Kibe. Daggy was our Server and she was fantastic …even teaching us how to eat like a local. Highly recommended !

user_reviews.Name: Michael Getu
user_reviews.Description: A good hidden and quiet plce. The service was great. Food was also good with good portions for a lasagna and salad however pizza was a bit smaller and all the foods lacked some salt but that may be to accommodate different taste. Overall this place was a good one.

user_reviews.Name: Venus Damte
user_reviews.Description: Labrina Restaurant is hands down one of my favourite restaurants and catering services in Addis. Each and every single dish on their menu is absolutely delicious. Also their warm and attentive customer service always makes me feel at home. The restaurant is beautifully designed and their catering service is absolutely exceptional, always on time with delicious food and beautifully presented setups. I highly recommend Labrina to anyone looking for a great place to dine in Addis or an outstanding catering service.

user_reviews.Name: Eyob Abate
user_reviews.Description: I really love coming here specially for lunch, it is quite a gateway from a hot sun. The place is spacious, kid friendly, they have special local food packages and the lasagna is great.

user_reviews.Name: Yonas Me.
user_reviews.Description:
Labrina has a great atmosphere with stunning interior design to match their services. However, in the evening it's too cold and windy. They could have solved it easily.

The foods is okay 👍 We ate lasagna and it cool. The starters are great too. However, we don't like their pepper steak... Sorry 😔

However, the waiter is super helpful and he kindly offered us a replacement food. We kindly declined since we were extremely satisfied with the previous foods that we had.

All in all, the restaurant is great for anyone who wants to have a great food experience with nice atmosphere. I recommend it.

user_reviews.Name: Hablin
user_reviews.Description:
a nice place with nice atmosphere, but unfortunately, the experience was marred by the lack of good service and food. While the ambiance was pleasant and inviting, it was overshadowed by the disappointing aspects of my visit.
the food at this place was far from satisfactory. The quality fell short of expectations. The dishes lacked flavor and were poorly executed. It was evident that little effort went into preparing them, also the food just took about like 1hr and 30 min to arrive which was disappointing considering the potential that could have been achieved with such a nice atmosphere

title: La Mandoline French Restaurant
address: 2QHM+RRR La Mandoline French Restaurant, 17 Côte D'Ivoire St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bruno MARTY
user_reviews.Description:
When I come to Addis, I come to La Mandoline restaurant. In 15 years, they change 3 times of location. Always, not disappointed, delicious. you must come and test that french food. Today we take onion soup (very good), fondue bourguignonne (perfect: good meat with 6 sauces, and absolutely perfectly cooked french fries) and finally a sublime lemon tart. And to accompagny that meal a very good local Gebeta dry red wine. Thank you, an excellent diner.
It's a pity that the new location is not so easy to find: That restaurant needs more customers

user_reviews.Name: Shir Portugez
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing food, best restaurant we found in Addis Ababa . Great atmosphere! Beautiful and cosy design.
Every dish was excellent and the service was great (not the best English, but tried to do their best).
Highly recommended if you are in Addis and want to have a yummy high level meal.

user_reviews.Name: Kal Kassa
user_reviews.Description: These “sausages” were very disappointing. They were ultra processed supermarket hot dogs, not something I expected from a French Restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Zemene Tewodros
user_reviews.Description: Delicious meal, tasty desert, and great service. The place is calm, quiet, and best for romantic dinners.

user_reviews.Name: Dori Travels
user_reviews.Description:
Lovely restaurant with great atmosphere. The food was very good. It is well balanced in terms of taste. I loved the mash potatoes.
Daily specials on the menu.
Service is very good. English is not spoken very well but good enough for ordering.

user_reviews.Name: wanson luk
user_reviews.Description: One of the best restaurants in the country - read this tagline doubted but now I confirm it is true. The bread is warm and crunchy. The dipping was great. Ordered foie gras and beef tartare both up to 1st world standard. The food portion is very big so I couldn’t finish the food. It is quite an expensive restaurant in local standard too

user_reviews.Name: alyaa abuelhassan
user_reviews.Description: Such a nice place, very elegant and cozy, the food is on point, brava for the chef 🙌🙌♥️😍

user_reviews.Name: Nick J
user_reviews.Description: Lovely comfortable restaurant with a pleasantly surprising menu unlike any other in Addis. Sat outside for lunch. The staff was attentive (not searching for a waitress for more napkins or salt), but checked in often enough to feel like they took pride in the service they were giving. Food was amazing.  Just a little confusion with the bill but an over all great experience!
