user_reviews.Description: Went there at 9PM for a late dinner. It was a Wednesday so we were mainly looking for fasting food and  we settled for a tuna salad and some fish with greens. The food was nice and tasty and the place was busy for after 9PM. One thing about the service was that we weren’t asked for what we wanted to drink the whole time we were there!

user_reviews.Name: Henok Alemu
user_reviews.Description: I ordered deep fried Nile perch. they served with lemon it was incredible. I really enjoyed it. it softens was something make it enjoyable. however there service wasn’t good.

user_reviews.Name: Abdulkerim Nursefa
user_reviews.Description: In the debrebrhan  city it's best and good place for recreation wow

user_reviews.Name: Natnail Aberra
user_reviews.Description: I love the food here. It is located in a good location. I also like the staff and the atmosphere there.

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
They've quite the way with any type of customers.
With a variety of meals, from European to local, much less Ethiopian traditional ones. So I read the menu minutes... minutely.
The quality is not necessarily an unqualified triumph. A narrow escape, I say, but the woman manager took care of the way how to grill, which is rarely seen, I appreciate her careful attention with trying to make sure.

user_reviews.Name: Afom F Kinfe
user_reviews.Description:
Some how I find it a bit expensive...but I have tested their fasting foods ('Beyaynet' and 'Shiro') and was delicious.
Their service is excellent. I'm looking forward to trying the other foods I haven't tested.

user_reviews.Name: Mike Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description: Nice place and view

user_reviews.Name: Ezra Sedestu
user_reviews.Description:
The indoor restaurant and the drive in café is one to visit. I prefer the drive in, to privately chat, and eat their famous Fry Dough with Tea. Service might be in a rush after the afternoon.
worth my time.

title: ሮዲዮ ምግብ ቤት/ Rodeo Addis Restaurant
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: ሮዲዮ ምግብ ቤት/ Rodeo Addis Restaurant (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Chris Rivers
user_reviews.Description: The atmosphere reminded me of a steak house back home in the United States! The food was fantastic and I really like the house “Kochkoch.” I would have never found this place if it wasn’t for the locals!

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: A great place to spend the evening.  It has good music, and a range of drinks. I have had the Ethiopian food here which is good. Last time I went there, I had the Cow Boy Steak which was cooked fine, but the choice of meat wasn’t great: it had a chewy bits in it. I had the Asa kitfo, grilled fish (with spaghetti) and Hilina tibs on other days and these were good. Besides that service was good, and I will be going again.

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
Get yourself a little something. Because there's only so much love to go around.
Let's not be gloomy here, but it's going to get a bit spooky on the way to the restaurant at night.
Once inside the Rodeo Gate, the threat neutralized.
The grilled fish was excellent.
Those fingers in the kitchen are divine.

user_reviews.Name: Netsanet Belhu
user_reviews.Description:
I absolutely love this place, except for Saturday nights. It’s honestly a shame because the atmosphere and the food are incredible, but the service completely tarnishes the experience. The restaurant is always understaffed, and the waitstaff seems unfit for handling the busy crowds. There's this one particular guy, a tall figure with a cowboy hat who stands at the entrance, who honestly gives off a vibe that doesn't match the restaurant's image at all. He actually sells tables to people he perceives as 'well off,' completely disregarding the other patrons who might not have the same financial appearance.
It’s incredibly off putting to be turned away when there are clearly tables available especially when it feels like they’re making up new reservations for others, who aren’t even on the books. It’s especially intimidating when you're denied seating and made to feel like you don’t belong, while others are let in, with no regard for fairness. This behavior is so frustrating because it not only makes you feel excluded, but it damages the reputation of a place that could be so much more."

user_reviews.Name: Christina Ospina
user_reviews.Description: A smidge more on the pricey side, but the flavors and fun decor help make up for it! Really tasty and flavorful food (we ordered shiro and tibs - arguably the best of both I've tried so far in ET). The inside area was more intimate, and I hope to come back to check out the bar scene! Also bathrooms were clean and nice which is always a plus.

user_reviews.Name: Abdalla Khalil (BIBOLICIOUS)
user_reviews.Description: Amazing atmosphere beautiful set up and lovely staff. The food is finger licking good, you need to try the barbecued fish is out of this word. For drinks I can say I had the best margaritas in Addis Ababa so far. They even have a little play area for kids. The only negative thing I think is the location or maybe just the roads taking to it are bad cause of lots of construction going on, but I’m sure it’s worth it.

user_reviews.Name: Selam Shimelash
user_reviews.Description: … nice decor and music except 1) the expensive combo dish that came with a steak that is tough to chew, he took it back, warmed up the same steak as new and brought it back. 2) I was also told not to photograph the menu, as if their recipe is on it. A person, a restaurant or anything with confidence has nothing to hide! 3) rest room is outside the restaurant, on my way back the guy with a cowboy hat opened the door for me, I was pleased and thanked him, then he said I open doors for tips! It’s disappointing to eat horrible overpriced dinner and feel obligated to tip a door man just because … greed will not get you anywhere, you will lose it all. And diasporas don’t grow money on trees!! Never again.

user_reviews.Name: Abel Tilahun
user_reviews.Description: I can without any doubt say they have the best steak in all of Addis. The atmosphere is amazing to watch football or enjoy good music!

title: Kokoro Addis | Bole | ኮኮሮ ሬስቶራንት | ቦሌ
address: Namibia St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Kokoro Addis | Bole | ኮኮሮ ሬስቶራንት | ቦሌ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Khadijah Brown
user_reviews.Description:
I got here without a reservation on a weekday..my fault, I didn't know I needed one. The front staff didn't speak English and I had to wait for some minutes to be seated (in a nearly empty restaurant to be honest) by an English speaker. I ordered a few dishes for takeout and was told it would take an hour for my food to be ready. At this point, I was sceptical but I wasn't about to risk another delay going elsewhere.  My food arrived in about an hour and half but the chef came out with a profuse apology and half a loaf of multigrain bread as peace offering..lol.
I was then told I couldn't pay by card but then the story changed later when it became apparent there was just no way I could pay with cash
The food was good especially the short rib and salmon and I really enjoyed the bread...thank you. Please do something about the wait time and training staff to communicate effectively.
Tldr; best short rib, long wait time, meh service

user_reviews.Name: Bethelhem Assefa
user_reviews.Description:
Amazing food, vibes and Tea.real hidden gem.Chef how do you make that chicken Katsu. just wow.
We loved every second of our experience.will be coming back often.

user_reviews.Name: Deshan Naidoo
user_reviews.Description: What an an experience for the first night in Ethiopia! Really loved the Japanese food, the local wine and the amazing jazz!! Highly recommend

user_reviews.Name: Denise Musat
user_reviews.Description: Very nice restaurant - a hidden gem of Addis Ababa! The chef is very sociable and comes always to talk and explain his dishes. We tried the ramen and he told us is a very big portion so he split in 2 little ones in order we could share it ☺️ everything is very tasty !

user_reviews.Name: Dayal
user_reviews.Description:
We searched for a Japanese restaurant nearby, and this place came up on Google. Hoping for an authentic experience, we decided to give it a try. We ordered ‘Yodofu’ (tofu) and ‘Chicken Ramen’ (noodles). While the presentation was decent, the portions were disappointingly small.

The total cost came to 1,710 Birr (around 13 Euros), which felt overpriced, especially considering the portion size and quality. Based on our experience dining in Addis Ababa, this restaurant falls on the expensive side. To make matters worse, the food lacked authenticity, failing to capture the true flavours of Japanese cuisine.

For the price, we had higher expectations, and unfortunately, this restaurant didn’t deliver. If you’re looking for genuine Japanese food or good value for money, this might not be the best option.

user_reviews.Name: Adyam Solomon
user_reviews.Description:
Kokoro is 😘
Their food is fantastic, bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. The atmosphere has always been indescribable every time I visit the place.
The service- perfect 10/10—attentive and friendly throughout the evening.
A special shoutout to the wonderful chef and owner, Seife!

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Kassa
user_reviews.Description: It is a beautiful place with an amazing sushi. It's always difficult to get a good quality sushi in Addis, and I must say this is one of the few places where you can find a very well prepared, authentic, and tasty sushi. They also have other options like steak and pasta, but we only tried the ramen and sushi. Friendly staff, great service, and the chef is really nice, passionate about his food, which is amazing. Beautifully decorated, sitting with the option to sit outside and a classy restaurant inside. Enjoyable and relaxing atmosphere. Great options of drinks, wine, and beer, as well as hot drinks, a tasty ginger tea. 😊😊

user_reviews.Name: Yohannes Yilma
user_reviews.Description: A little on the expensive side, but the staff is really attentive and responsive. We had a moment where we weren’t sure about an ingredient in one of the dishes, and they actually brought out the chef himself, holding clear proof. He was super friendly and polite, with a great sense of humor. You can tell he really understands and respects the dishes he creates, there’s a personal touch that runs through the whole place. Turns out he lived in Japan, and it definitely shows in how the whole restaurant is set up. I’d recommend asking to meet the chef, who’s also the owner, he’s genuinely a pleasure to talk to.

title: Mamma Mia Italian Restaurant & Bar
address: beside the old tobacco factory, Close to the African Union Headquarters, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: beside the old tobacco factory, Close to the African Union Headquarters

user_reviews.Name: Sona Dadi
user_reviews.Description: Incredible atmosphere...I felt like I was stepping into a secluded historic place, with an "old Ethiopia" vibe... found with so much warmth, sophistication but also effortless elegance. This place felt intimate and cosy but also made me travel across the world to Italy. The chef is really passionate about what he does and the food speaks volumes. Prices are simple to understand. Highly recommend this place for family get togethers or a romantic dinner.

user_reviews.Name: Bethlehem Abera
user_reviews.Description: This place offers an incredible experience with its top-notch ambiance, simplicity, and seclusion. The setting is beautiful, and the chef's hospitality is exceptional. The homemade Italian pasta and sauces are truly delicious, and the tiramisu is a must-try. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Semhal Guesh
user_reviews.Description: Mamma Mia is an amazing place with excellent food and a beautiful ambiance. It’s one of those spots you go to not just to eat, but to truly enjoy the whole experience!

user_reviews.Name: Dave Samuel
user_reviews.Description:
I have come across to check out this fancy Italian restaurant which serves very authentic dishes, the place has got an extremely old villa which is very classic and attractive for me and I went there at night for dinner and most of the customers are foreigners, especially US embassy workers. When it comes to the food it’s worth trying their food if you are a fan of Italian foods and also don't forget to try their tiramisu probably one of the best in this city. Last but not least, the place is very suitable for a night date with your loved one with dim light and a candle on each table will create an unforgettable experience.

Notice:- the restaurant has only got one waiter who can serve you drinks only and to order food you need to get the head chef who gives a brief explanation for each food on the menu and you need to be patient.

user_reviews.Name: BP CG
user_reviews.Description: Some of the food I had here was better than in Italy. The host is so passionate and very friendly. I could taste that all this food was homemade with love. Well done ! Will be back again if I revisit Ethiopia.

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Food is very tasty if h know what your ordering. Dessert ✅

user_reviews.Name: Mekonnen Gebretekle
user_reviews.Description: Delicious Italian food. The Ravioli, steak with teramiso desert was so nice. the house is a traditional old Ethiopian house made of mud which reminds the old days. It is absolutely lovely. The location is also ideal as it is few minilutes drive from Kazanchis. Bruno (the owner) assists what to eat and helped us to have the good mix. Please take care, it is over priced!

user_reviews.Name: Yonas tesfazion
user_reviews.Description: The food is absolutely delicious and the staff are very friendly. It has a home like vibe, very spacious outdoor area. Just like a mother’s home cooked meal, this place will satisfy your visit. I look forward to visiting again :)

title: Hailu Bar and Restaurant
address: Sheger Building, bole behind, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Connie O'Dell
user_reviews.Description: We don’t speak the language, but we easily ordered beer and dinner (the waiter called it “meat” but that was good enough for us). It ended up being a dish called “tibes ”, 1/2 kilo, with injera for serving, and it was perfect for hubs and I to share.  Very reasonably priced.

user_reviews.Name: Allen K
user_reviews.Description: Really delicious and good quality food. The fried fish and spiced minced veggies were really special. Top 3 meal in 3 weeks in Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Yonathan Fikru
user_reviews.Description: Was good but you know some times they are not giving us the right service some of the meet for tre sega were so hard to chew up.

user_reviews.Name: kalkidan zerihun
user_reviews.Description: It was crowded since it was Sunday and day before orthodox religion followers start their fast. Other wise the service was good and the food delicious 😋 👌

user_reviews.Name: Nolawi
user_reviews.Description: i have no words to express its an amazing Restaurant i ever seen in Addis Ababa hailu Bar and Restorant😍❤ 🙏

user_reviews.Name: Christina Birhan
user_reviews.Description: My favorite place to go when I go back home. Beautiful service!

user_reviews.Name: Henok K.
user_reviews.Description: Wow

user_reviews.Name: Leoul Fasil
user_reviews.Description: Really good  food

title: La Maison French Cuisine
address: 38.7800830, 9.0050927, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bete Aberra
user_reviews.Description: The restaurant has a warm and cozy atmosphere, making it an inviting spot to settle in for a meal. We began with the Forest Tagliatelle, which was excellent, the pasta was well-cooked, and the earthy flavors came together beautifully. The Beef Bourguignon, however, was less consistent. While the sauce was rich and flavorful, capturing the classic depth of the dish, the beef itself was unfortunately too chewy, which distracted from the overall experience. With more tender meat, it could have been a standout.

user_reviews.Name: Steve C
user_reviews.Description:
Charming little restaurant on quiet side street. Indoor dining with atmosphere, or casual outdoor dining to enjoy the breeze.

Highly recommend the steak with blue cheese sauce.

Very reasonably priced with friendly wait staff.

user_reviews.Name: Bethlehem Abera
user_reviews.Description: I had a pleasant experience at this French cuisine restaurant. The space was nicely arranged, offering both indoor and outdoor seating, which added to the comfortable atmosphere. The food was tasty and made with good-quality ingredients, with each dish prepared well. Overall, it was an enjoyable meal, and I’d recommend it to anyone looking for a solid French dining option.

user_reviews.Name: Insos Jawa Get Lost Safely
user_reviews.Description: The food was really delicious, tender meat and tasty. I like the vibe and overall design of the restaurant and bar. Indoor and outdoor seating were available. Kind and friendly staffs who also speak English. I recommend 💫

user_reviews.Name: WinDee
user_reviews.Description:
La Maison French Cuisine has an amazing aura that makes you feel special the moment you walk in.
The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with elegant décor and soft, good music that enhances the dining experience.
The staff is absolutely lovely—friendly, attentive, and always ready to help.
If you're looking for a place with great food, a wonderful ambiance, and excellent service, La Maison is the good choice.

user_reviews.Name: Ez
user_reviews.Description:
Ordered the La Maison salad (decent), blue cheese pepper steak {medium rare} (also decent but the side of roasted potatoes was inedible), and two macchiatos (below average) with a lemon pie (lil bit too tart).

Service was great, and the outdoor seating was pleasant. Would recommend based on the atmosphere and novelty.

user_reviews.Name: Awo Adem
user_reviews.Description: This is one of the best hotels I have ever been to. The owner and the waiter there ( I am really sorry that I forgot his name) are both lovely, welcoming and helpful people. Food and deserts are amazing, so is the atmosphere of the hotel. I recommend this hundred percent 👌 💯 if you ever come to Addis don't leave without eating there 😉

user_reviews.Name: Biruk wubneh
user_reviews.Description:
The place itself is cozy, with good vibes and great music. The outdoor area has a really nice atmosphere, and the staff are friendly and welcoming.

Now, about the food. We ordered the steak and cheese sandwich and the Forest tagliatelle. The sandwich was honestly below basic. “Caramelized onions” turned out to be just thinly sliced onions, and the bread was the biggest disappointment, it was basically "ye suk dabo". The house sauce was undetectable, and overall it tasted more like local Ethiopian tibs shoved inside bread. On top of that, the portion was tiny and definitely not worth the price.

The tagliatelle was a bit better. The portion size was fair, and the flavor wasn’t bad, though it could definitely use improvement. What bothered me was the lack of customization, you have to eat the dish exactly as served, with no option to remove or adjust ingredients. They also grated cheese on top, which could’ve been a nice touch, but why provolone? It smelled off and didn’t complement the dish.

Pricing, portion sizes, and overall flavor need work. On the bright side, the Coca-Cola was perfect.

For now, I wouldn’t recommend this place for food. But if you’re looking for drinks and a good vibe, it’s worth visiting.

title: Bait Al Mandi
address: 2Q4J+FM2 Bait Al Mandi, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bella Al
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Bait Al Mandi……. Simply the Best!

We’re visitors from Australia and the United Kingdom, and during our stay in Ethiopia, Bait Al Mandi has become our absolute favorite spot. We’ve been coming here throughout our entire visit, and every single time, the experience has been nothing short of amazing.

The service quality and efficiency are beyond words, genuinely unmatched. The staff are always kind, attentive, and deserving of every tip. The owner himself is one of a kind: warm, welcoming, and always willing to go above and beyond to help in any way possible. You can truly feel the baraqah in this place.

The food, the hospitality, the atmosphere everything comes together perfectly. It’s rare to find a place that makes you feel so cared for and satisfied every single time. Without a doubt, this is a five star experience, and we can’t wait to come back again.

Bait Al Mandi isn’t just a restaurant; it’s a beautiful experience. The best of the best!

user_reviews.Name: Mr oga
user_reviews.Description: Very clean, service is respectful, the manager Mr. Ahmed; professional, friendly and kind. The food can be served as you wish. Criticisms, the meat was not sufficiently spice for me and a bit too crispy but everyone has their own preference. The Hummus was good.

user_reviews.Name: Tigs Chadder
user_reviews.Description:
Extremely disappointing:

Why do some restaurants in Ethiopia feel
A “delivery and takeaway” services deserves to be treated with the worst cut of meat? The portions, selection of the meat cut “there is a big difference between lamb and mutton”

For the past few months,  we were told about the food at this restaurant and we decided to order for delivers.

Meant to have 1/4 chicken, 2 x Lamb vegetable, rice etc . The only thing that was correct from the order was the amount of rice sent to us.

The “lamb bone” was actually old mutton then the 1/4 checkin had the worst (no chicken meat) side of the Chicken which was not edible at all! A quarter of a chicken means “you divide the chicken into four equal parts” not sell of the side of the chicken that should be thrown out or used for “stoke” purposes only …

This was a meal for two costing (in the local market terms) a substantial amount.

Not ordering from here again and we suggest those who do, ask for a proper ration of the portions not be given the cast offs!

user_reviews.Name: imran naik
user_reviews.Description: Good Arabic Restaurant in Addis. Enjoyed the Tasty food. Its hardly 20 mins from Bole International Airport.

user_reviews.Name: M B
user_reviews.Description: The food was ok, I wish they served with salad. Shout-out to the delivery guy Aaron he was awesome

user_reviews.Name: Isayas wudneh
user_reviews.Description:
I recently dined at bet al mendi and unfortunately, my experience was less than satisfactory. From the outset, I was disappointed by the portion sizes. The servings were surprisingly small. To make matters worse, the meat appeared to be leftover, lacking the freshness and appeal one would expect from a dining establishment.
When I addressed my concerns with the manager, rather than offering a solution or an apology, he attempted to justify these shortcomings. This approach felt dismissive and did not align with the level of service I anticipated. Overall, I hoped for a more enjoyable dining experience but left feeling let down.

user_reviews.Name: kalid seid
user_reviews.Description: Very clean and organized. The foods are very good and the service is also excellent. There are wide variety of foods to choose from and a few drinks. There are complimentary soups and tea. If u r looking for Mediterranean foods in addis this is one of the good places to check out.

user_reviews.Name: Abdul Taleb
user_reviews.Description:
⭐ 1/5 — Very disappointing experience
I ordered the special Mandi and Fahsa, but both were poorly prepared. The Mandi tasted old and dry, and the Fahsa was served cold. The food quality didn’t match the price at all. I expected authentic Yemeni flavor, but this was one of the worst experiences I’ve had.

title: Trattoria Gusto
address: 572 Guinea Conakry St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mehari Tesfamichael
user_reviews.Description:
A Total Letdown at Trattoria Gusto
Went to Trattoria Gusto and honestly, it was a mess from start to finish. The waiter couldn’t keep track of orders and kept confusing our table with another one.
The food? Terrible. The lamb roast was the worst I’ve ever tasted, and the steak was just… sheat — no other word for it. Dry, flavorless, and badly cooked. The only thing I actually enjoyed was the starter (chicken soup and Caprese), which was decent.
And here’s the funny part: the best thing about the place? The draft beer — because they don’t make it! 😁
If you value your time, money, and taste buds — avoid this place.
If flavour had a funeral, it would be catered by Trattoria Gusto.
To be fair, they didn’t charge us for the food we couldn’t eat — merciful, really 🤔

user_reviews.Name: Woldeamlak “Wolde” Woldegiorgis
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at this hidden gem of a restaurant that offers a limited selection of buffets with incredible food and an amazing vibe. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by the cozy and inviting atmosphere that gave me comfort.

The buffet selection may be small, but let me tell you, the dishes they have were very tasty. The food feels fresh and flavorful. Each bite was a delight for the taste buds, and I couldn't get enough of the delectable dishes on offer.

What truly sets this restaurant apart is its incredible vibe. The ambiance is warm and welcoming, with stylish decor and comfortable seating that creates the perfect setting for a relaxing meal. The staff were friendly and attentive, adding to the overall fantastic experience.

Despite the limited buffet options, the quality of the food more than makes up for it. Every dish was thoughtfully crafted and bursting with delicious flavors.

If you're looking for a restaurant with great food, a cozy atmosphere, and a unique dining experience, look no further. This restaurant has it all.

user_reviews.Name: Mikiyas Melkamu
user_reviews.Description: I recently had the pleasure of enjoying lunch at Trattoria Gusto, and I must say, it was a delightful experience. The moment I stepped in, I was greeted with a warm ambiance that set the tone for a great meal. I opted for the Steak with mushroom sauce, and it did not disappoint. The steak was cooked to perfection, tender and flavorful. The mushroom sauce added a rich and savory element that complemented the steak beautifully. Additionally, I also indulged in their lasagna, which was equally delightful. The layers of pasta, cheese, and sauce came together in a harmonious medley of flavors that left me craving for more. Not only was the food impressive, but the service was also top-notch. The attentive staff made sure that every need was met, contributing to an overall enjoyable dining experience. The fact that the price was reasonable for the quality of food and service provided was definitely a plus. I was pleased to find out that the restaurant is kids-friendly, making it a great option for families. The availability of parking also added to the convenience of the visit. In conclusion, I wholeheartedly recommend Trattoria Gusto to anyone seeking a delectable dining experience. The combination of delicious food, excellent service, reasonable pricing, and family-friendly environment makes it a must-visit. So, if you're looking for a place to enjoy a mouthwatering steak and pasta, Trattoria Gusto should be at the top of your list.

user_reviews.Name: Lina
user_reviews.Description: The taste of the food is pretty good. HOWEVER the portion size will make you cry. It's so small especially if you do half and half of a meal. The half lasagna was just two layers 😭.

user_reviews.Name: Senit Abreha
user_reviews.Description: This place has totally gone downhill this past year. We ordered the Alfredo and lasagna which used to be our favourite but they served us tiny food with burnt flavor.

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: Delicious dishes and amazing customer care. I enjoy coming here. Today, I wanted to give a review to suggest fixing the roof. It was bothering us while it was raining. Other than that, everything is good.

user_reviews.Name: Redwan Jemal
user_reviews.Description: A place to find variety of delicious and tasty Ethiopian traditional as well as European food with relatively fair and affordable price, at a perfect location. Excellent and friendly customer service. Recommended to visit with family and friends. Safe parking space available.

user_reviews.Name: Kidist Amedie
user_reviews.Description: Ordered lasagna takeaway and it was just three layers of pasta socked in oil , and burnt ,when I called to complain they didn't do anything about it.  This is my second time being ripped off by their delivery service,never again

title: Olympiacos restaurant
address: 2Q59+C82 Olympiacos restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mihai Ignat
user_reviews.Description:
I wish that I could say so many good things about this restaurant but unfortunately the food is very bad, the place looks like is from the 60s and there are not Greeks anymore around…

They need serious renovations and a complete make over of the menu!
Besides, if they have some Ethiopian recipes as they do, they should have have the traditional coffee until the restaurant closes.

I’m giving 2 stars to encourage the owner to do something because is the only Greek restaurant around and it has a very strong name to itself! So please don’t ruin it completely.

user_reviews.Name: Woldeamlak “Wolde” Woldegiorgis
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at this classic historical restaurant. I must say, it was an experience to remember. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by the warm and inviting atmosphere.

But the real star of the show was the food. The menu featured a tempting array of dishes that are interesting to choose from. This place has an array of food from traditional Greek dish to traditional Ethiopian dishes that are interested to order. While the menu contains big arrangements of foods, most foods tend to be unavailable for that moment or time.

The servers were attentive and friendly, always ready with a smile and a helpful recommendation.

Overall, dining here was a delightful experience that I enjoyed very much.

user_reviews.Name: anastasios doukas
user_reviews.Description:
The food was excellent
The building so old, but with many memories
Too bad will be removed at a new place

user_reviews.Name: Beck Balcha
user_reviews.Description:
fabulous place
1)Nice food(souvlaki and thesalonki pizza
2) friendly staff
3) spacious place for family and event
4)good sporting arena(basketball court, multiple ground tennis courts, foot ball quater
5) nice cosy little gallery at the gate and even a TV room to watch football
6) spacious parking, green surrounds , an oasis in downtown Addis
7) a museum feel with so many historical portraits and photoes on the walls
8) hosts bazaars from time to time
Cheers to Zobras Olympiakos club

user_reviews.Name: Kidus Dagnachew
user_reviews.Description: Nice food and cool people

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Teshome
user_reviews.Description: Vey quality and quite place

user_reviews.Name: Lemma Seifu
user_reviews.Description: Happy

user_reviews.Name: Melkamu
user_reviews.Description: Excellent restaurant

title: Tian Tian Chinese Restaurant
address: XQXP+W4W Tian Tian Chinese Restaurant, Namibia St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Jj Jj
user_reviews.Description:
Portions are very small for the cost. Quite expensive and the same price as in Europe.
I small plate tofu
1 tiny bowl of cheap broken grain rice that had been cooked at least one day ago and reheated. Before ordering rice, i asked if it were fresh. It was lumpy, partially cold, all broken grains, and hard around edges from reheating.
Tofu was pleasant. Chilli oil added flavour.
Annoying that everything was served on plates that were chipped on top and underneath.
Should not serve food on chipped plates, its unhygienic and unsightly

user_reviews.Name: Tigs Chadder
user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: Petros Wondmu
user_reviews.Description:
Restaurant Review: Disappointing Experience at Tian Tian

As someone who has dined at numerous Chinese restaurants both locally and internationally, I had certain expectations when visiting Tian Tian in Addis Ababa. Unfortunately, the experience fell short on multiple fronts, leaving much to be desired.

Beef Hotpot Disappointment

We ordered a beef hotpot, expecting a rich, flavorful dish with a generous portion of beef. Instead, what arrived was a soupy mixture dominated by vegetables, with barely any beef to be found. When we inquired, the waitress informed us that this was the “Ethiopian version” of the dish. While I appreciate local adaptations, this explanation did not justify the lack of key ingredients that are fundamental to a hotpot. The dish was more akin to a vegetable stew than the hearty, beef-laden hotpot we were expecting.

Noodle Dish with Sparse Meat

The noodles we ordered also came with a promise of meat, but once again, the dish was lacking. The few pieces of meat that were present were overwhelmed by an overly soy-sauced broth, which detracted from the overall flavor. Given my extensive experience with Chinese cuisine, this dish did not live up to the standard I would expect from a reputable Chinese restaurant.

Service and Ambiance

Adding to the disappointing food was the unprofessional service. Our waitress seemed disengaged, at one point resting her leg on a chair while taking our order. This casual attitude, combined with the subpar food, left a negative impression. Dining out is not just about the food but the overall experience, and the service here did not meet even basic expectations of professionalism.

Sizzling Beef - Small Portions, High Price

To round off the meal, we ordered a sizzling beef dish, hoping for a final redeeming plate. Unfortunately, the portion was surprisingly small, especially considering the price. The dish did little to improve our experience, reinforcing the feeling that the meal was overpriced and not worth the money.

Conclusion

Tian Tian does not deliver the authentic Chinese dining experience one might hope for. The food lacks key ingredients, is over-reliant on soy sauce, and is not prepared to the standard expected from a Chinese restaurant. Coupled with unprofessional service and small portions for high prices, this restaurant fails to offer value for money. I would recommend considering other options in Addis Ababa, such as Little China, where the experience is more in line with what one expects from Chinese cuisine.

user_reviews.Name: Tanish
user_reviews.Description:
Relatively an young Indian restaurant in Addis. It's cosy place for fne dining. So prices are in the upper side. Note the menu states prices without tax, which means there is still 20% waiting for you in bill.
The restaurant is located in the main road, but if you are trying to spot it by the name vraj, you would definitely miss it, for no where in the board vraj is prominent. The have only the vraj logo. So, if you are trying to spot, keep in mind to search not for vraj, but for Indian bar and restaurant.
The atmosphere is very nice and lit well and soft.
They do have a good collection of drinks. Tried draft beer, surprisingly it came in a glass like a mini version of Collins glass, unlike the usual Oktoberfest mug, popular over here in Ethiopia.
Pepper chicken was good ( they have some other fancy name) and served hot. Would recommend it for others.
The jeera chicken ( again they have some other fancy name) was ok.
Garlic naan was the hooking deal.  They have priced Indian breads so low, as equal to prices in India. However the quantity and quality is not compromised. Bet, you cannot get such excellent naans in this price anywhere in entire eithiopia, in a fine dine restaurant.
Naan and jeera chicken were not hot when served. May be they cooked it and left it without keeping it warm, till served.
Spiciness/pungency is subtle to cater for Ethiopian. But, you can ask them to cook as per your scoville scale.
Service was excellent.
Main course was served after we completed the starters. That hardly happens in restaurants over here.
As the crowd descended they were kind to play the instrumental music that I had in my mobile.
When we were about to leave they came with a suggestion to take their gulab jamun (sweet) as compliment. Declined it politely. (Restaurant) starters love.
The service excelled when, without any request, a person came with umbrella to protect us from rain, till we entered our cab.
Definitely not a place for cheap boozers.
Good enough for couples and families. Sufficient space available for road parking.

user_reviews.Name: tsi tsi
user_reviews.Description:
Visited on July 29, 2025

I had dinner at this traditional restaurant with five family members — we were six in total (my child didn’t eat). The place is beautifully designed and has a classic atmosphere that really reflects Ethiopian culture.

We ordered traditional food and Tej (honey wine). While the first round of Tej arrived normally, the second order came very late. The waiter told us it had run out and a new batch had to be prepared.

Unfortunately, shortly after returning home, I and the family members I live with began vomiting. The next day, I called my other relatives and they confirmed they also experienced the same symptoms.

Today is day two. While the rest of my family (who live here in Ethiopia) are feeling better, I’ve been in bed all day, weak and unwell. I live abroad and this experience has been very upsetting.

It’s really unfortunate, especially coming from such a respected and beautiful establishment. I’m sharing this not out of anger, but as a warning: please be careful with food and drink hygiene, especially with items like ‘Teji’.

I hope the restaurant takes this feedback seriously

user_reviews.Name: Soffonias
user_reviews.Description:
We visited Totot as a large group — three families, several kids, and most of us diaspora who came excited to enjoy a nice meal together in our home country. The restaurant is very spacious, almost like a wedding venue, so we truly believed it would be a comfortable place for families to dine.

Unfortunately, what happened there left us shocked and deeply disappointed.

From the beginning, we waited an unusually long time for our food. Naturally, the kids became bored — as any kids would — and they started walking and running around in the huge open space. We were watching them, and in a place that big, it didn’t seem like they were bothering anyone. We were simply trying to keep them occupied while waiting and had no intention of disturbing anyone.

But then a manager approached us and told us to “hold our kids” because they were disturbing the white people in the restaurant. Hearing that was extremely hurtful — especially coming from staff in our own country. As diaspora, we always try to support local businesses, and that day we were spending just as much, if not more, than any other customers. To be singled out and spoken to like that was not only disrespectful, but also discriminatory.

Instead of acknowledging the long wait time or speaking to us respectfully, the manager chose to prioritize certain guests over others and make us feel unwelcome and inferior in a place we were supporting with our money. That comment alone ruined the entire experience. We immediately got up and left because no family deserves to be spoken to that way.

We didn’t complain or raise our voices; we simply removed ourselves from a situation that made us feel small and disrespected.

Totot needs to understand that every customer — local or foreign — deserves equal respect. No parent should be made to feel embarrassed for their children simply being kids, and no one should ever be told their presence is less important than someone else’s.

Our experience was painful, disappointing, and unacceptable. We will not be returning, and we sincerely hope management reflects on this incident and learns to treat all guests with fairness and dignity moving forward.
