As a child, my family and I often visited Anatic, and I have fond memories of the place. Recently, feeling nostalgic, I decided to try it again. While the food was decent overall, I was disappointed with the lasagna, which I used to love but didn’t enjoy this time around. On a brighter note, the "Teff Kita" paired with the chicken salad was absolutely delightful. Although I remember the "Teff Kita" being free in the past.
Anatic remains a cozy spot for catching up with friends, though the prices are slightly on the higher side.

user_reviews.Name: Ewnet Reviews
user_reviews.Description: This place used to be really good years ago, but the last time we ordered pizza with meat, the taste wasn't good. I am not sure if it needs seasoning but it was bland. The service was OK, the atmosphere wasn't bad. I want to go back ans try other dishes.

user_reviews.Name: kalid seid
user_reviews.Description: The place is located right at the main road and u can easily find it. Spacious place with different services for like exclusive ceremonies. They offer mainly three types of food: pizza, BBQs and pastas. The place is beautiful but the service could be a bit faster and improved a bit. Different drinks are also available.

user_reviews.Name: Hannah
user_reviews.Description:
I was very happy to find this chilling place. Food was normal but they had an amazing atmosphere. Normally, the portion of dishes was quite large for me.

One of my favorites is Teff bread👌

title: Velvet restaurant & Lounge
address: 9th floor T.K building Bole infront of Ethiopian Skylight Hotel, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: 9th floor T.K building Bole infront of Ethiopian Skylight Hotel

user_reviews.Name: Nathnael Tekabe
user_reviews.Description: Velvet Restaurant, located on the rooftop of the TK building, is a fantastic spot for a relaxed get-together. The atmosphere is sophisticated yet welcoming, making it a great option for a casual date or a hangout with friends. While the views are modest, offering a decent look over the Bole area, the generous pricing for the quality of the food and drinks makes it an excellent value. It's the perfect place to enjoy a good meal and conversation without a hefty price tag, though it's worth noting they close relatively early in the evening.

user_reviews.Name: Bisrat Belayneh
user_reviews.Description: This place still has a stunning view. The food wasn't the best, but it was okay. The prices were fair. It feels like the place is up for some maintenance. The roofs at the corners were leaking in rain. If this place can get some face lift, it can reclaim its status as a wonderful restaurant with ease.

user_reviews.Name: Deresse Asrat
user_reviews.Description: I ordered pizza and offered free starter soup and salad that I appreciated. The staff is very friendly and liked the place clean inside out. Food was delicious made to satisfy and professionally made.great view from the top to the airport.

user_reviews.Name: Markus Mayer
user_reviews.Description:
Great view over the city, especially the airport with its lights at night.
Entrance a bifficult to find, take elevator to 8th floor and one more flight of stairs up

user_reviews.Name: Hannah.M
user_reviews.Description: It was a nice place! Good service

user_reviews.Name: Mikias Muluneh
user_reviews.Description: A place where you can create your own vibe, whether dinning, dating, drinking, or having a lone time.

title: Entoto Road Side
address: Abyssinia Real Estate Building, Airport Rd, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: Abyssinia Real Estate Building, Airport Rd

user_reviews.Name: Eman Issa
user_reviews.Description: Roadside Entoto was great! The service was nice, the place felt cozy, and it had this vintage, homey vibe that I really liked. My friends and I ordered the fasting pizza it tasted really good and the food overall was nice. The only downside was that the food took quite a while to be prepared. Still, it’s a great hangout spot! Just note that the place can get a bit crowded and it’s on the smaller side.

user_reviews.Name: RC
user_reviews.Description: My wife and I went here at the recommendation of a friend. Our overall experience was good, but some changes would make it better. The chicken salad was good and worth getting although we would probably ask for the dressing in the side next time. The chicken sandwich wasn’t bad, but it had way too much bread and also had thick skin on part of the patty. I wasn’t expecting that! My double cheeseburger, though the texture wasn’t my favorite, turned out to be pretty good. Some attention should be given tot eh accompanying fried potatoes whose skin was too tough. The Entoto special drink was wonderful. Service started off excellent, but our server disappeared after our food was delivered and never returned. Beautiful decorations inside. So, 3.5 is my score for the whole experience, but since Google Reviews doesn’t allow for 1/2 stars, I’ll be kind and round up to a 4.

user_reviews.Name: The Advisor
user_reviews.Description:
I tried the double cheese burger and chicken salad: the burger was very good, the salad just good.
The service was excellent, a very nice and kind staff taking care about the visitors of the restaurant.
The atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing, especially when it is with music.
Didn't like one fact only: in the menu, it is written that prices include the tax, but actually they are not.
In my other visit, I tried pizza and tuna salad, and the pizza wasn't cheesy enough.

user_reviews.Name: Cheena Mohammed
user_reviews.Description: A charming spot by the road with a wonderful atmosphere. I love their pizza and highly recommend the chicken salad. I have visited several times and will definitely return.

user_reviews.Name: Tesfaye Beyene
user_reviews.Description: Great place, good vibes, busy. Most importantly they have cleaner restrooms

user_reviews.Name: Barney F
user_reviews.Description:
I loved every single thing about the place except the double sheese burger try not to order it cause I was a little disappointed, Everything else was great!
Thank you for the service
The greatest thing was, they don't even try to deceive you by excluding tax and service charge... It was all included with our orders. AMAZING 👏  😁

user_reviews.Name: Afrah S
user_reviews.Description: Cute casual spot for pizza . Nice for group hangouts but not that spacious. Had the tuna salad and Margherita pizza. They have a wide selection of pizzas.Their juices are good too.

user_reviews.Name: Den94life
user_reviews.Description: The most authentic pizza we have found in Addis! Quick service, fresh food, and friendly staff.

title: Korma Grill
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bahjat Alirani
user_reviews.Description: I came at a quiet time so it was nice and chill. I got the BBQ beef ribs and mashed potatoes. The meat was especially delicious. Nice, hot and tender. Staff were very friendly and nice.

user_reviews.Name: Medehanit simon
user_reviews.Description: We was at Korma grill this evening  to have a dinner. To my surprise no service staff was able to serve us. They have a good number of staffs but they seems like not wanting to serve we sat there for almost 30 minutes and we left when we realised that they won't serve us. I think it's good for Korma Grill to improve the service and work on training its service staff. It is very annoying to have a good review online and totally different from what we see when we visit. This experience turns me off and I wouldn't suggest it to anyone else

user_reviews.Name: Hodzic Saud
user_reviews.Description: The best grill restaurant in Addis-Abeba with fair price and nice service.

user_reviews.Name: Jacobine Amutenya
user_reviews.Description: If you appreciate meat and ever find yourself in Ethiopia, you must check out this grill – the meat is unbelievably tender, practically falling off the bone. The mashed potatoes were delicious, the vegetables had a delightful smokiness, and don't even get me started on the rice.

user_reviews.Name: Afom F Kinfe
user_reviews.Description:
The sauce on the steak was BAD!!! Please do something about it. The meat was all a waste because of the sauce on top of it.
The burger was amazingly delicious compared to the rest of the food we ordered.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum teklemichael
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Excellent food and service.
We tried the Tomahawk steak and smoked beef—my God, they were incredibly tasty and well prepared. Great flavors and very good value for money. The service was also excellent: professional, attentive, and welcoming.
Highly recommended. Please come and visit!

user_reviews.Name: henok tsegaye
user_reviews.Description: They ignored the side dish that we ordered and brought their own preference instead. The barbecue sauce they served was good.

user_reviews.Name: Chloe Jeong
user_reviews.Description:
Enjoyed the meal! Meatlovers’ place for sure. Wknd special(smoked brisket) and pulled beef are quite similar but definitely prefer/recommend wknd special.
Combo was just soso - more than a half left at the end. Side dishes were okay but portion was too small.
As for the portion of main menu, we were a group of 5 (females & males) and I guess 2-3 mains without combo is still more than enough. With a combo, we left quite a lot.
Staffs were very kind:) will visit again!

title: Pepper And Spice Restaurant
address: 2Q68+32J Pepper And Spice Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mark Henderson
user_reviews.Description: A very nice restaurant in Addis Ababa. They featured a wide selection of foods , including some of the standard fare such as pizza and burgers, but also fancier menu items too. Service was a little slow, but friendly. And they did get our order is correct. So that is good. The restaurant has cloth napkins and wine glasses, so on the fancy or side. I enjoyed the Ethiopian Burger, with spicy ground beef.

user_reviews.Name: Tin Tin Dinh
user_reviews.Description: Price is higher than other places but food is average.  Steak was a little dry.  Food experience was below Hyatt’s restaurant for similar prices.

user_reviews.Name: Ibsa Abdella
user_reviews.Description: Good

user_reviews.Name: Charlie Scalliet
user_reviews.Description: Interesting eatery

title: EROS BY LEWI
address: Rakan Building, Cape Verde St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Sawsane Lionne
user_reviews.Description: A wonderful dining experience at Eros by Lewi. The service was impeccable, with kind, attentive, and very professional staff. The international dishes were of outstanding quality, flavorful, and beautifully presented. An elegant place where every detail is carefully thought out. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a refined culinary experience. ✨🍽️

user_reviews.Name: Roman
user_reviews.Description: A truly fine dining experience 😋 with a beautiful and welcoming atmosphere. Recommended for all size gatherings and quality dinner. Loved the food, the vibe, and the service was just wow!

user_reviews.Name: Adrian
user_reviews.Description: Lovely place. Fantastic food. An absolute must when visiting Addis!

user_reviews.Name: Eyerus Alem
user_reviews.Description: amazing service , good atmosphere , great location , and also really good price for such a good food idk why it’s not that famous yet? The place looks so good and it’s a great place to be with ur friends and for a date. The staff are the nicest and it has a bar where you can order drinks. And also a VIP section it needs a good marketing such a hidden gem💕

user_reviews.Name: Nathan Baheru
user_reviews.Description:
Perfect place for group, privet and family dining time. The interior craters a Cousy, elegant and relaxing environment. Best food test with wonderful customer service including parking.

Check it out.

user_reviews.Name: Jun Amano
user_reviews.Description: If you look for stylish and descent restaurant where you can even use for business dinner in Addis Ababa, this is the place I would highly recommend. The place is dim and the volume of the music is a little loud but still the served meals here are fantastic without exception.

user_reviews.Name: Amanuel Fikru
user_reviews.Description: Their food is beyond excellent! The service was amazing as well. My fiancé and I came to celebrate Christmas Eve. We had the tomato bisque starter and it was delicious, but it could use some bread on the side to dip with. For the main course we had the chicken breast dish that was so soft and yummy!! The stracceti di manzo was amazing as well, but it has a lot of sauce and could use some thick bread. You can request bread though. For dessert we had the tiramisu and ice cream, the perfect combo together! What a way to end the night! Love it love it love it!!!! Will definitely be back.

user_reviews.Name: aref helal
user_reviews.Description:
The vibe and the food are great.
Just there is little bit delay to get your food.
The waitress are so friendly and helpful.
Recommended!

title: Naija Kitchen - Addis Ababa
address: opposite African Union, Sodere Hotel, Roosevelt St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

complete_address.street: opposite African Union, Sodere Hotel, Roosevelt St

user_reviews.Name: Hiwot M_ab
user_reviews.Description: Great taste of Naija. Humble Naijan chef. A must visit place.

user_reviews.Name: Joyviva Nation
user_reviews.Description:
I met a buffet service, but with limited food. Met the Chef and restaurant owner/manager: very polite and a gentleman. I think he was not having a prim and proper day, as the food was not actually his best yet.

You pay 600Birr per person and serve yourself to your hearts content. NO TAKE OUTS on buffet days.

There had rice, stew, peppersoup, okra soup with vegetable, fish sauce and semo.

Also, there’s appetizers in form of puff-puff (dumplings) for those who fancied it.

The refrigerators can be disposed or moved if not working, instead of making it seem as though part of the restaurant is a dumping ground.

Nonetheless, I’d like to give it another try before I leave, as I was not really impressed.

The environment is not so 5 star, but calm; and the location is quite inward. The restaurant could be really better in so many ways, if the right resources are put in.

The toilets are just basic.

No parking space allotted for customers; you have to park on the street.

Follow me for more reviews. 🥂

user_reviews.Name: Chido Mushaninga
user_reviews.Description:
The best Nigerian food in Addis. The chef is very kind, welcoming and patient. His food is full of love and delicious! He can take orders per request, they deliver and if any delays he calls to notify. They have an affordable buffet every Tue and Thur. You will never go wrong.
I am from Zimbabwe and this is the place to be if you want to have a taste of Nigeria. Keep it up👏👌🏻🔥

user_reviews.Name: Fasola Bolaji Hassan
user_reviews.Description: Great place to be and enjoy your quality Nigeria Food in Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: Ibraheem Adebayo
user_reviews.Description: Eat the best of naija dishes - excellent service  and great tasty foods - With Naija kitchen in Addis Ababa, you never miss Naija delicacies.

user_reviews.Name: YOMI MAYA
user_reviews.Description: Try to visit us.

title: Zegeye Kurit, Bar and Restaurant
address: XQQP+5XG Zegeye Kurit, Bar and Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Honestly the food was good. We had the raw meat and kitfo especially was so nice but the tibs was disappointing really so disappointing didnt even care to take a pic of it. The service is so slow. The atmosphere is alright.

user_reviews.Name: Eyob Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description: If you're a raw meat enthusiast, you must check out Zegeye (ዘገየ) Kurt! This haven for raw meat lovers offers an impressive selection of organic meats, all top-quality and ethically sourced. The atmosphere is vibrant, with a stylish bar boasting a fantastic range of local (አረቄ) and international drinks. Plus, with multiple TVs showcasing live soccer matches, it’s the perfect spot to enjoy a meal while cheering for your favorite team. Tsegaye is a must-visit for a unique dining experience!

user_reviews.Name: Endalkachew Girma
user_reviews.Description: Good place to eat Raw Meat

user_reviews.Name: Juanita Yeheyes
user_reviews.Description: Food was not as fresh as I had hoped for. Visit before was amazing, this time was very dry. Had great vegetarian and normal meals. A bit spendy.

user_reviews.Name: Jens Lion
user_reviews.Description: Do not go here. A lot of fake reviews (we found out after being here). Food was OK (tibs on a sizzling hot plate. No other option were available.). A big hall with NO customers except us two. We would usually have gone to another place, but we had taken a taxi solely to visit this place, so we felt we had to give it a shot.

user_reviews.Name: Tina j
user_reviews.Description: Stay away from this restaurant. Ok food, empty place except from us, no menu, just came with the food. Did not tell us the price before bringing out the food. Seems like there are a lote of fake reveiws here. Would not recomend.

user_reviews.Name: Ebrahim Segid
user_reviews.Description: It us a good place to eat meat in various forms.

user_reviews.Name: Amanuel Berhanu
user_reviews.Description: A bit loud

title: Reem Restaurant | Hayahulet | ሪም ሬስቶራንት | ሃያሁለት
address: 2Q8V+JG8 Reem Restaurant | Hayahulet | ሪም ሬስቶራንት | ሃያሁለት, Equatorial Guinea St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Reem Restaurant | Hayahulet | ሪም ሬስቶራንት | ሃያሁለት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Cynthia okello
user_reviews.Description:
The food and service is ever time amazing!
They never disappointed us. Looking forward to next time.

user_reviews.Name: Andy McLoughlin
user_reviews.Description: I went to Reem to try something different. I ordered the Meat Kebab with Naan and Rice.  What then followed can only be described as an episode of "Man vs Food", with a rack of lamb ribs buried under 40kgs of rice and a naan bread big enough to sleep under.  No, I didn't finish it all. And No, I won't need to eat again this week.

user_reviews.Name: Surafel Chanie
user_reviews.Description: Just perfect 👏👏👏👏 can’t wait to come back again

user_reviews.Name: Adem Jemal
user_reviews.Description: The foods are not affordable they're expensive

user_reviews.Name: habiba ali
user_reviews.Description: Worst.food with very high price i will never recomend this for anyone so annoyed

user_reviews.Name: Karsten Hammerstad
user_reviews.Description:
This is so quiet . And a nice restaurant for a meal or just coffee 👍
If you want a break go here ☺️

user_reviews.Name: Aman Muhammed
user_reviews.Description: Delicious food, specially the mendi. Also have extra rooms where people can eat on the floor next to a praying place.

user_reviews.Name: Mela ExpressTM
user_reviews.Description: We had a chance to visit this restaurant during Ramadan iftar and no meal served even after 30 min after Maghreb. Unpleasant experience!

title: እንሰት ባህላዊ ምግብ ቤት / Enset Cultural Restaurant
address: XQR8+29R እንሰት ባህላዊ ምግብ ቤት / Enset Cultural Restaurant, Gabon St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: እንሰት ባህላዊ ምግብ ቤት / Enset Cultural Restaurant (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Hiruy Yimam
user_reviews.Description: Amazing food and atmosphere. This is the real Enset on Meskel Flower Rd - not the one in Wollo Sefer which is rated lower.

user_reviews.Name: Andrea Rizzo
user_reviews.Description: Great restaurant inside the Best Western hotel. Staff attentive and courteous. They offer Ethiopian food, Indian food and some Italian and French food. It all tasted delicious and prices are fair compared to restaurant of the same type.

user_reviews.Name: Eyoel Tiztaw
user_reviews.Description: A nostalgic venue adorned with decorations that resonate with the memories of senior residents in Addis Ababa, including disappearing foods from the heart of the city.

user_reviews.Name: David Millar
user_reviews.Description: Really tasty lamb tibs!

user_reviews.Name: Polo
user_reviews.Description: Very nice place to have Ethiopian food and drinks

user_reviews.Name: ליאב יחיא
user_reviews.Description: רקדו לי פרות סודניות על השלוחן וצ'וצ'ות סודניות

title: مطعم النخله/Nekhla Restaurant
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: aji wijono
user_reviews.Description:
A very attractive place that appears to have been around for quite some time.
The interior could benefit from renovation to enhance the dining experience.
Excellent food and service at reasonable prices.

user_reviews.Name: Ahlam
user_reviews.Description: They have delicious food the meat is my favorite, overall excellent but they should take a nice place because the atmosphere was not really good its kind of old place they have to renew it and add more decorations 😊

user_reviews.Name: kalid seid
user_reviews.Description: Its a nice Arabian restaurant with multiple food choices and a good service. Their hummus is very good especially with salad and the thin bread. The smoked meat are so good and some hot beverages can also be found. Definitely recommend.

user_reviews.Name: The Advisor
user_reviews.Description:
The food is good for a Yemeni restaurant out of Yemen... there is a space for improvement.
I liked the kind staff (the person who served me was calm and positive, I liked that so much).
The atmosphere is the weakest part of the restaurant... the owner need to think about some changes, not necessarily expensive ones, just to make things look nice, the only beautiful part is the pictures, the colour of walls creating depression 😅

user_reviews.Name: Awol Ahmed
user_reviews.Description: We arrived early for Iftar an hour early, the place was empty, after 30 minutes it was packed. It is the best Iftar in town service was good the food is delicious. You need to try the biscuit so delicious. My only complain is the date, it could be a better quality.

user_reviews.Name: Usman Sethi
user_reviews.Description: Excellent food. Never had a lamb mandi with that much tender meat before. Portion was more than two persons. Quick service and very friendly staff.

user_reviews.Name: Yousuf Salih
user_reviews.Description: Traditional restaurant They serve delicious food, as my last trip to Addis Ababa I went to this place and I liked the food also they have a Yemeni dessert called Ma'sob so delicious, but you have to be patient with the servant as they have the slowest service ever

user_reviews.Name: yeri
user_reviews.Description: No fuss, delicious and authentic Yemeni food, big portions! For the sweet-tooths out there, try the Fattah Mooz for dessert

title: Top View Restaurant | ቶፕ ቪው ሬስቶራንት
address: Megenaga, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Top View Restaurant | ቶፕ ቪው ሬስቶራንት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: Kimo the DJ is best at his welcoming face, and very well aware of the hospitality industry. The overall service is quite nice, I expected to see the beautiful viewed of Addis Ababa in general, unfortunately a new building is built, blocking that marvelous view. Anyhow I enjoyed my time, the compound has a lot of plants and outdoor space for a nice fresh air. I highly recommend this place, especially for a night life!!

user_reviews.Name: Ayehu
user_reviews.Description: Despite the name change - dok, and not any more Top View -, it is still a very good Italian restaurant in #Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Selamawit Zewdu
user_reviews.Description: The food wasn't bad but the service was kinda questionable love the vibe tho

user_reviews.Name: David Fenech
user_reviews.Description: Situated away from the chaos of the city, you can enjoy fresh air and open space at this restaurant. Good food, but not special. Was also greatly assisted by a man from the restaurant when it was pouring cats and dogs and he accompanied me with an umbrella up to our car

user_reviews.Name: Kidan Abayneh
user_reviews.Description: Great food, great service and a nice atmosphere. For those who want to walk there- it’s a bit of a steep slope.

user_reviews.Name: Lemi Werkneh
user_reviews.Description: They have very talented hosts and talented chefs, and the cleanliness is top notch. Their food is also very delicious. I really enjoyed it. Thank you.

user_reviews.Name: M C. (Maly)
user_reviews.Description: This is one of signiture restaurant in Megenena(Most of the Addis ababa Taxi drivers know the place) The view is now a bit hidden by other buildings But space of the restaurant is quite big. There is a outdoor playground for kids. Foods are mostly good(it was quite salty sometimes). Mostly Italian but they serve nice traditional dishies like Torowat(Spicy Chicken stew with Injera).

user_reviews.Name: A Anderson
user_reviews.Description: Sadly it’s now the “No View” restaurant since a huge hotel has been built totally blocking the view. Now it’s average food with a decent outdoor space, but no view at all.

title: Checheho Cultural Restaurant and Hall
address: 2Q3W+W64 Checheho Cultural Restaurant and Hall, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Hitomi Sarah Naito
user_reviews.Description: Wonderful excellent performance! What a skilled dancers and musicians. I enjoyed very much also they took audience volunteered dancers together which was fantastic.

user_reviews.Name: Fikir A
user_reviews.Description: Wide open space with live cultural music show everyday except Wednesdays. Good local food too.  You can enjoy the combo specials for a group that comes in a vegetarian and non vegetarian options if you are in groups. And for a meat lovers try the kitfo. A bit loud music on the downside though where it gets difficult to discuss with each other during the performances.

user_reviews.Name: Radim Cejnar
user_reviews.Description: The worst food I had in Ethiopia during my 1 month long stay. Meat was tasting funny and I hope I’m not going to get sick tomorrow. Also the restaurant is nearly empty and I have been waiting 30 min for check.

user_reviews.Name: Noah Teklu
user_reviews.Description: The worst place to be we waited for food for more than an hour but we went out after paying for the drinks they were out of enjera. Place is not clean it has a bad smell there was only two soaps to wash hands in the toilet for the entire people.

user_reviews.Name: Abraham Abraham
user_reviews.Description: Great place to entertain guests. Really talented singers and dancers. Bathroom is acceptable. Their tibs is amazing.

user_reviews.Name: Christine Assouad
user_reviews.Description: Very nice place to get a sample of Ethiopian food & culture!

user_reviews.Name: Julia Stanton
user_reviews.Description: The restaurant is beautifully decorated and the food is good with live cultural music and dancing. However it was almost empty and I was wondering why. Well maybe it’s the service. The waitress when we arrived was telling us we had booked the buffet when we hadn’t. She finally brought one menu and we ordered food. When the food arrived she didn’t arrange correctly as to how people were eating. Halfway through the meal she asked if we wanted some more of the lentil dish which was part of the plate. We said yes but she didn’t tell us it was going to cost extra money. We didn’t really need it as we had another plate of food waiting. She put 2 spoonfuls of the dish on our plate and then took it away. When the bill came, we saw we had been charged for one extra dish and all we had was two spoonfuls. The manager wasn’t around - only the cashier. The cashier said the waitress was stupid and demanded the money.

user_reviews.Name: Leoul Fasil
user_reviews.Description: Very  great dancers but long wait

title: Sambusa-Ga
address: XQR8+C2Q Sambusa-Ga, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Debebe
user_reviews.Description: They have a variety of Sambusa that I haven't seen anywhere... Food is good. Atmosphere is okay, except for the chaos while parking. I was disappointed when I saw how much they charge for a take away box and cup. Why would you want to make a profit out of it? There is no way one bix costs 60 birr....and one small cup costs 30 or 40 birr. Isn't it enough to make profit on the food and drink you provide? Just charge us the exact amount you paid for the item or just include it in your food cost.

user_reviews.Name: Buka A.
user_reviews.Description: Food is good, probably too much cheese for me but it has a variety of offerings.

user_reviews.Name: zi ying
user_reviews.Description: This is our canteen. The food is quite tasty, but many items are out of stock. The serving time is especially slow, with the usual African-style service attitude.

user_reviews.Name: Hablin
user_reviews.Description:
The atmosphere was tastefully decorated with cozy seating arrangements,the service was prompt and attentive but i do recommend you to go in less jammed hours.the portion size was generous,leaving me satisfied but not overly full.
The combination of great ambiance,delicious food,and excellent service made it a place I would gladly visit again.

And ps: you have to try the “chekena tibs” if you go there

user_reviews.Name: Frezer Mengstie
user_reviews.Description: The best restaurant in addis I highly recommend sambusa and concrete rice the service is good waiting time is more than 10 min and the interior is also looks good

user_reviews.Name: Nurhusen kedir
user_reviews.Description: Their foods tastes nice and their atmosphere is cozy and visually appealing.

user_reviews.Name: Daniel Alemu
user_reviews.Description: This is the most overrated place. The worst service ever. We had to go to the cashier ourselves to order a food. After waiting an hour, they gave us a sambusa with 9 French fries. And they even forgot to bring a cafe latte. Worst experience.

user_reviews.Name: etsub mengistu
user_reviews.Description: A must visit for sambusa lovers.  I am obsessed with their food "concrete". Also i had their shakshuka with a beef and cheese sambusa and its good. The only thing i hate about this place is when they say we are out of chicken.

title: Aladdin Restaurant
address: XPQG+VWC Aladdin Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Bonny Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description:
The Warq enab lacked the pomegranate sauce according to my friend that knows and loves the dish. We also had the tabbouleh and hummus which tasted divine but forgot to take photos.
Might be the best pizza in town.

user_reviews.Name: RC
user_reviews.Description:
My family and I visited the old location 2 or 3 times over the past few years and made some good memories. The waitstaff was always engaging, and the food was good. Yesterday I learned from another business owner that Aladdin moved closer to my home, so I figured I’d take my wife there for our date night. We passed the restaurant twice expecting a stand-alone location, so we asked some guards where to find it. FYI, the restaurant is at the lower level of the building that has Daily Mini Market and Arosci Spa.
The entry makes it feel like you’re entered whole new world. The ambience was nice. We chose to sit outside. I recognized one of the servers. She and the other guys have been with Aladdin for nearly a decade. It was clear throughout the night that they were seasoned staff and knew how to interact with both local and ferenji clientele.
My wife and I ordered a number of things, and all of them were perfect. I can’t think of a negative thing about our evening. Once the word gets out that the Bisrate Gebriel area has another quality dining experience, I expect this place to be packed.

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
No wonder I was surprised to find how this restaurant tucked away on the main road to the international airport. The genre name of the restaurant reminded me of one of my favourite teachers.
I had little idea what 'Armenian cuisine' was, but it seemed to be somehow Lebanese.
More than 95% of the customers are European and most of them are travellers. The food was quite good but the service was a bit poor, unfortunately, due to the crowds.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: Restaurant has now moved to a new location, in the basement of a building located near Lafto Mall. I must say that the new place has a warm and cosy feel, even if part of it is outside the building. There are two other parts: a bar and restaurant, which are designed very well. The food is as good as usual, and the service is excellent.

user_reviews.Name: Emnet Sebhatu
user_reviews.Description: Kind of hard to find as it is at the basement level of the mall. The space is very peaceful, good dining environment, and the food was delicious. We ordered the falafel and the Tabouleh. Draft beer was fresh and the pita bread was excellent.

user_reviews.Name: Chloe Jeong
user_reviews.Description: Nice outdoor tables under shades and good service! Tried chicken Kebab and mixed one. And we liked the chicken better: super tender and beef had some smells which I dont like. Portion is not big for guys and enough for ladies. Will definitely come back and try their pizza and other menus:)

user_reviews.Name: Maricha MartinezSosa
user_reviews.Description: Extensive menu with Arabian/Armenian  gastronomy as well as many pizza options. They have lots of vegetarian plates all properly identified. The food was good: falafels were freshly fried, meat was fresh and the baklava was really juicy... The staff is very polite and they have a small parking area available for the clients.

user_reviews.Name: Changsu Siris Woo
user_reviews.Description:
This is a quite atmospheric Lebanese restaurant. While the food quality is not outstanding, the service from the staff is excellent, and the prices are reasonable.

There are plenty of sittings.

When I visited in the evening, there were continuous power outages, but they were resolved through the use of generators.

The restaurant has a mix of half foreigners and half locals, making it a recommended place for those who like Middle Eastern cuisine. The quatrofomagio pizza and hummus were decent, and the falafel was okay, but the shish kebab was a bit lackluster.

title: Kaku Mame Restaurant | Lideta | ካኩ ማሜ ሬስቶራንት | ልደታ
address: 2P6P+M96 Kaku Mame Restaurant | Lideta | ካኩ ማሜ ሬስቶራንት | ልደታ, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Kaku Mame Restaurant | Lideta | ካኩ ማሜ ሬስቶራንት | ልደታ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Lotus Wellness
user_reviews.Description: It is in big space they make it in four different partitions setup which is cafe style on the corridor, traditional coffee ceremony in the other corridor, normal restaurant, traditional restaurant and bar. Food and service is OK. When I ordered tea after lunch the Waiter said we only serve traditional coffee. For tea she told me to go 4th floor, it is in the same management.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Jula
user_reviews.Description: Delicious Oromo cuisine are available, and the restaurant's interior is filled with cultural artifacts. I really enjoyed vegetables pizza and Itittuu. Next time I will come back for chororsa.

user_reviews.Name: Yared Gudeta
user_reviews.Description: If you are looking for a traditional Oromo food Kaku Mame is the place, enjoyed both the anchote and afagne.

user_reviews.Name: Mesay Shanka
user_reviews.Description: You can find authentic Oromo cousins here. The restaurant is on the fifth floor. The ambiance is fantastic. The food is delicious. The price is reasonable. Try it. You'll not regret it.

user_reviews.Name: Abdi Degaga
user_reviews.Description: Kaku mame serves main Oromo traditional dishes  with international services. I tasted chumbo (Cuumboo) and kochkoch (Qocqocaa) traditional foods for the first time without the need to gravel  300+ KM to taste the food. I really thank them for serving me the quality foods with international standard service.

user_reviews.Name: Kiya Tolcha
user_reviews.Description: Loved it.

user_reviews.Name: Girma B.
user_reviews.Description: One of the best restaurants in Addis worth a visit. Maginificient setting and excellent Oromo traditional food which probably everyone would love. Thank you!

user_reviews.Name: Yisihak Abraham
user_reviews.Description: 🏠 The Oromo culture house is a hidden gem. #Amazing

title: Arbaminch Asa Resturant - አርባ ምንጭ አሳ ቤት
address: XQV3+44M Arbaminch Asa Resturant - አርባ ምንጭ አሳ ቤት, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Arbaminch Asa Resturant - አርባ ምንጭ አሳ ቤት (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Great fish spot with tasty asa tibs and asa leb leb packed with flavor. Food comes out fast, which is a plus, but the service struggles with the crowd. Flies are definitely a problem that needs fixing. Still, if you can overlook that, it’s a solid place with really good food.

user_reviews.Name: Omo Culture Ethiopian Tours
user_reviews.Description:
Specialty: Seafood-focused, especially fish dishes (asa = fish in Amharic). For example: “fried fish that is delivered daily from the source”.

Hours: One source says Monday–Saturday 8 AM–10 PM.

Review score: Google cited 4.2 stars from 141 reviews.

What’s Good

The freshness of the fish is highlighted: “best fried fish… the fish was fresh and tasty.”

A wide variety of fish-based dishes: “asa tibs and asa leb leb packed with flavor.”

Good value: reviewers mention that portions are generous.

Things to Note

Service issues: Some diners note the staff was “extremely rude” or service was slow due to crowding.

Cleanliness/fly problem: One review says “flies are definitely a problem” in certain seating areas.

Crowded at peak times: It can get busy, so maybe go a bit earlier or for takeaway

user_reviews.Name: Gedion g
user_reviews.Description:
was quite disappointing. The service was slow, unorganized, and at times unfriendly. It also felt like the staff wasn’t paying much attention to customers. I expected better communication and professionalism, but unfortunately, that wasn’t the case.

On a positive note, the Shorba was amazing — flavorful and well-prepared. Hopefully, management takes this feedback seriously and improves the overall quality of service for future guests, because the food truly has potentia

user_reviews.Name: Henok Garedew (Henny breezy)
user_reviews.Description:
Of course, they have the best fried fish, the fish was fresh and testy. The restaurant is huge have indoor and outdoor sitting. The waiter/server was extremely rude/ ባለጌ. Am sure the restaurant doesn't have manager on duty. I really like the food, but service was  extremely bad, did't leave a Penny for tip.
I recommended If you order and pick up!

user_reviews.Name: Fanuel Haile
user_reviews.Description: One of the famous places in Addis for fried fish. But the fish wasn't as tastefull as expected. Service was weak. And the place hasn't been kept very well. Shabby indoors. Out doors is better considering it's open air vibes.

user_reviews.Name: Yared Ablanios
user_reviews.Description:
They serve just a normal fish fry & taste less  vegi salad .
Poor customer service and no cleanliness at all
And they don't accept mobile banking

user_reviews.Name: Geta Hailu (ጌታ)
user_reviews.Description: The waiters seemed preoccupied with their phones, resulting in poor service. It was difficult to find a waiter when we wanted to place an additional order. One waiter appeared to be waiting for our order but was distracted by his phone.

user_reviews.Name: Michael Getachew
user_reviews.Description:
the fried fish taste could vary from one another so some may be tasty others not, plus when it comes to payment the way they harass you to pay only on Awash Bank is very annoying
this will be my last time dining at this establishment

title: TABLE 5 RESTAURANT
address: 2Q69+JJQ TABLE 5 RESTAURANT, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: sjwithers
user_reviews.Description:
Really nice little bar/restaurant that became my local while saying in Addis for a long weekend. I didn't eat there but just popped in for a couple of beers before going out each evening. The staff were friendly, the ambience was pleasant and the customers who were eating seemed happy.

If you are staying at the Grand Palace Suites right opposite here, you should definitely drop in during your stay.

user_reviews.Name: Ato EB
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been a loyal customer, going almost daily and spending around 2,000 birr per visit, leaving 200-300 birr in tips every time even for take-away orders. On my last visit, they ran out of take-away boxes and used aluminum foil instead — yet still charged me extra for box take-away for each meal.

When I called the next day, they admitted the mistake but still insisted on charging me again, all over 40 birr. It’s not about the money — it’s the principle. They ended up losing a loyal customer over something so trivial.

Very poor customer care. Will not recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description:
This is a new place located in the middle of town, mainly serving Ethiopian food. The interior is decorated well and boasts an open kitchen - you can see the chefs in action if you want to. There is also a bar area.

Went on a Thursday and it was quiet - ours was one of two tables that was occupied. The five or so staff that were on duty left the restaurant as soon as we left at 21:30.

The food was good. We started with the table 5 special for two, something we (three guys), thought would satisfy us. It was a good choice and every dish was tasty. We particularly enjoyed the dirkosh firfir (with quanta) and ordered one more.  It was definite one dish too much for the three of us and we couldn’t finish it. It was also berbere heavy unlike what was included in the table 5 special - so I advise you to say that you don’t want it to be berbere heavy if you can’t handle it 😃

A good place and experience all together!

user_reviews.Name: Ruth Yitbarek
user_reviews.Description: The places looks good but the food is really bad and the staff is very unprofessional! The live music was too much for the space!

user_reviews.Name: Kidus Debebe
user_reviews.Description: I ordered a chicken sandwich and after one bite I regretted it very much. It was the worst food ever!

user_reviews.Name: Michael Schienke (VORBILDarchitecture)
user_reviews.Description:
The coffee is good so that’s all that you need to know :-)

It’s nicely located, with lots of space for calm conversations and good food.

user_reviews.Name: Betty's Organic
user_reviews.Description:
The food at your establishment was excellent, and we enjoyed it thoroughly. However, we had an issue with the service. Despite multiple requests for spoons, it took a considerable amount of time to receive them, and even then, they were brought out one at a time. The server mentioned that they had to retrieve them from the store, which added to the delay.

Additionally, while the manager was present, they did not address the situation and appeared unprofessional, chewing gum during service.

We truly appreciate the quality of the food and look forward to dining with you again. However, we hope the service experience will be smoother and more attentive next time.

user_reviews.Name: Nate
user_reviews.Description: However pleasing the place might be, the food was really bad. And it takes forever to make. I did not expect this at all because the place looks good. They could do so much better if they had a good cook.

title: Zipotle Mexican Restorant Addis Ababa
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mic Jr
user_reviews.Description: Chill and quiet spot, perfect if you’re not in a rush. The food is good, not amazing, but definitely enjoyable. Service is a bit slow, and the food takes a while to come out, so it’s best to head there before you’re starving. Staff is fine, just not the fastest. The atmosphere is okay it’s peaceful and relaxing, great for low-key dates or chill.

user_reviews.Name: Mikias Haile
user_reviews.Description: Great food and hospitality. Really enjoyed the authentic Mexican flavors here in Addis. The food is consistently tasty and fresh, with friendly and attentive service that makes you feel welcome. It’s a cozy spot where every meal feels like a little trip to Mexico. And perfect for family or a relaxed evening out. I highly recommend trying their tacos and burgeritos.

user_reviews.Name: Laura McMillan
user_reviews.Description: Excellent Tex- Mex food in Addis, they have lots of vegan (fasting) vegetarian options that are absolutely delicious, and this is coming from an American who really loves Tex Mex food. The food comes out fast, and is well spiced, I will absolutely be back again.

user_reviews.Name: Habtamu Dagmawi
user_reviews.Description: By far this the best Mexican food I ever tested, I tried it with my American wife and she usually histate to try new foods in Addis specially American food. The service was great and it didn't take long for the food to arrive. Forgot to take picture but we ordered California burrito, Bowel and Burgerrito. We rate it 10/10. Trust me you won't be disappointed:):)

user_reviews.Name: feven ayichew
user_reviews.Description: This is by far great mexican restaurant In Addis Abeba. I tried California Burrito, Burrgerito and Bowel. It didn't take long for the food to arrive and the restaurant vibe is relaxing, peaceful. Forgot to take pic, I was hungry lol :):) compared to Chipotle I tried in the states, I would give this 10/10. Give it try you won't get disappointed♡♡

user_reviews.Name: Hannah.M
user_reviews.Description: Hands down the best Mexican restaurant in town. We ordered the half special combo and enchiladas. It was just amazing. Totally in love with the enchiladas. Loved the atmosphere, and the very friendly staffs. Definitely coming back.

user_reviews.Name: Zaka
user_reviews.Description: Dining here is a wonderful experience, especially with the excellent service. The taco features a soft shell, and the meat is incredibly tender. The starter is fantastic, bursting with flavor and the sauce is crafted perfectly.

user_reviews.Name: Titi GIRMA
user_reviews.Description: I have never experienced such beautiful hospitality in Ethiopia like I did at Zipotle Restaurant. My son was feeling unwell, and we stopped by for dinner. The way the staff treated us—with so much kindness, care, and warmth—made me feel as if my son wasn’t even sick for a moment. They went above and beyond, and I’ll never forget how they made us feel that night. Thank you for your compassion and exceptional service. ❤️

title: Gize Bar & Restaurant
address: XQX9+C8G Gize Bar & Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Kassa
user_reviews.Description: This place is ok but the service was disappointing. We were a group of friends and ordered drinks and 5 or 6 plates of food. It was over an hour late and the place was not even that busy. But the most annoying part was they served another table that came after us and they were served immediately. We had vegetable pizza, fish goulash and fish  combo. The food was good. The atmosphere is ok but the music is too loud to hold a conversation. Overall its ok but can be improved especially with their service.

user_reviews.Name: The City’s Spots
user_reviews.Description: It is average. The service is a little slow but the food counters that....it can also host some programs apparently. And the gym is great. The place is packed with historical things so you won’t get bored waiting.

user_reviews.Name: Tigs Chadder
user_reviews.Description:
Our first time to this gem of a place from the old era of the music (Roha Band) were playing live with the two original members including Govanni. What an amazing exhibition of the sax playing.

The simply delicious and probably the best shiro wot I have had in a long time.

It is one place in Addis Ababa that has recognised the need for efficient and attentive service without overwhelming guests with too many untrained and intrusive waiting staff.

Well done to the team.

user_reviews.Name: Tegegne Molla
user_reviews.Description: It is a very nice bar and restaurant located at bole near Getu commercial.

user_reviews.Name: Matthias Görner
user_reviews.Description:
Everything was good, especially the Band performed well.
But every time during the breaks, horrible trash music was played at such a deafening volume that it sounded like the gentle sound of the sea as the jet took off and you stood next to it. I have never experienced anything like this in my life and can only hope that I don't have any permanent hearing loss. Thank God I escaped in time. Never again!

Today the Roha Band was supposed to play there, which we would have loved to see and hear, and that would have been the last opportunity before we left. But with this DJ guy we saved ourselves and went somewhere else, which is a shame.

user_reviews.Name: Sertse Wolday
user_reviews.Description: I will never go to this bar again. One day we went to this place to have a good time with family's during the live band time. Once the band done they start a DJ service and then one of my family member went to the Dj and asked him to play tigrigna music. Unfortunately the Dj said the owner of this bar will not allow me to play such musics. We all shocked by his response. What a racist owner he is?

user_reviews.Name: Michael Kiboi
user_reviews.Description: I loved the ambiance of the restaurant, the staff are very courteous, helpful and professional. The restaurant has a great setting with an assortment of drinks and with cool music playing in the background giving you the essence of Ethiopia. The service and food are just excellent. I definitely recommended it to anyone visiting Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: Helen Zeray
user_reviews.Description: Good ambience. Unfortunately they are very unsensentive to other cultures. They played two tigrinya songs half way.(very insulting). It would have been best that they didn't play any at all. So if you want a place that respects all cultures, this definitely is not one

title: Zaika
address: Gabon St, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Nikhil Tilwani
user_reviews.Description:
Had Dinner in this Indian restaurant which was walking distance away from the hotel I was staying in.
Ordered Chicken 🍗 Tikka Masala and Butter Naan 🫓
Portion size was very good enough for 2 people and the price is also decent (10 USD / Person).
Chef is very nice person and explained me all the dishes and also guided me to be safe while walking back to hotel.

Overall Five star ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ experience and a must visit for Indians having transit stay in Addis ababa

If

user_reviews.Name: girish joshi.
user_reviews.Description: If you are Asian and visiting Addis Abba capital of Ethiopia, You should not miss this eating place. Excellent food, neat & clean ambiance and very courteous staff.

user_reviews.Name: Timon Lau
user_reviews.Description: We had an amazing time here, impeccable service and nice atmosphere - the bar is a nice spot. Food was quite authentic, well seasoned and presented. Lots of options as well. Be prepared to spend about 2000 birr per person. Definite recommend!

user_reviews.Name: Sylvester Chapotera
user_reviews.Description: Excellent indian dish. They exceeded my expectations! Try it if you love indian cuisine. Its real👌

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: Located inside a hotel, Zaika is set across two floors and features a bar (although almost everyone was sat down). They had a cocktail menu too.  The waitresses were ok, but can do a bit better at explaining the dishes on the menu, with naan and plain rice. We tried three dishes and they were all nice and tasty. I felt that the prices were on the expensive side but that is it. Worth going when you fancy some spicy food.

user_reviews.Name: Ednya Amanuel
user_reviews.Description: The best Indian restaurant in addis and they have amazing customer service and they are very polite

user_reviews.Name: Nalini Nayak
user_reviews.Description: The food serving is very professional and on time. Ambience and food quality is very good. The staff like Friemelkam service is very good and hospitality is very good.

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description: Next to the hotel, connected with the luxury hotel. Looks gorgeous, cozy, and homey, the lady on the service well trained, in a way her absence of emotion is a blessing... The quality of the biliyani was quite authentic, even the price a bit higher, but worth paying the price.

title: Munchies
address: 2Q39+4RX Munchies, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Zaka
user_reviews.Description:
A quick summary for anyone visiting:
​The Good: Very friendly service and the bread is fresh, homemade, and delicious.
​The Bad: The sandwich was cold and the side of chips was very small.
​The Vibe: Not a place for a sit-down dinner; it’s tiny and best for takeout.
​Value: 400 Birr.
​They have the basics right with the bread and service, but they could easily improve the experience by serving the food hot!

user_reviews.Name: Afom F Kinfe
user_reviews.Description:
I ordered thier shawarma from online delivery site to my work place and it was just delicious!
The hot sauce, the French fries all the ingredients were professionally presented.
Keep up the good work really!!!
I hope to visit the place in person one day.

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
I really like the # shawarma, and I also like the people inside the shops who try to adapt the taste to the locals.
The shop is small inside, but the kitchen is open to the street and full of the seriousness that I could feel.
It was unpretentious, which was one of the best points that these street food shops ever had.　# Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: Kidus Kidane
user_reviews.Description:
Munchies is a very small restaurant that serves delicious shawarma. The portion size is small but very delicious also the chips that comes with the shawarma is crispy and tasty. I recommend getting take out or delivery since since it's a small shop
Update: I just want to let the owners know the food quality is as good as it used to be. The spicy sauce is no more and meat is way overcooked and dry. Even the wrapping technique is bad now. I think you guys have changed cooks and it shows

user_reviews.Name: Abdulhamid Mhd
user_reviews.Description: The chicken shawarma is too greasy & full of garlic sauce. it's a big hustle to consume. Don't try it unless love these.

user_reviews.Name: Joseph Tsedeke
user_reviews.Description: I have contact them through phone but I got Very bad communication and service.also they have no delivery.

user_reviews.Name: Eyerusalem G
user_reviews.Description: Good portion for the crispy chicken and tasty shawarma. Nice music too.

user_reviews.Name: Brook Abebayehu
user_reviews.Description: Their shawarma tastes so good !!!

title: Awaze Restaurant
address: 2Q6J+J68 Awaze Restaurant, Mickey Leland St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Ayehu
user_reviews.Description:
Awaze Restaurant

If you’re looking for an authentic Ethiopian dining experience, Awaze Restaurant is the place to be. Chef Z is the one making the food with love and passion, and it shows in every dish. Chef Z is also a famous TV producer, so you might even spot him while you’re there!

The restaurant’s signature dish, tibes, is a must-try. It’s cooked to perfection and is hands down the best in town. The menu also features a variety of other Ethiopian dishes that are equally delicious.

The atmosphere at Awaze is cozy and inviting, making it the perfect place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. The customer service is amazing, with friendly staff who are always ready to help.

Overall, Awaze Restaurant is a great choice for anyone looking for an authentic Ethiopian dining experience in Addis Ababa. Highly recommended! 🍴

user_reviews.Name: etsub mengistu
user_reviews.Description:
I recently visited Awaze restaurant and had the pleasure of trying their vegetable combo with Injera firfir, which was incredibly delicious. The atmosphere of the restaurant is both cozy and spacious, offering a 360-degree view of the surrounding area. I highly recommend trying the chef's signature dish, the "Awaze Tibs."

One point of improvement I would suggest is addressing the unpleasant smell in the restroom. Overall, my dining experience at Awaze was delightful, and I encourage everyone to visit and enjoy the fantastic food and ambiance.

user_reviews.Name: Birhanu Mesele
user_reviews.Description: I went to this place with my friend. It was a highly recommended restaurant by my friend. We had fasting dish. Beyayentu. It was delicious. Great service and amazing. I can’t wait to try the Tibes. Highly recommended. The view is amazing.

user_reviews.Name: kegetaneh Tarekegn
user_reviews.Description: The food is tasty; I tried the chef's signature tibs, and it was amazing. The atmosphere is good. As a suggestion, it would be better to have an interior design that complements the view. Overall, the experience was great.

user_reviews.Name: Nebiyu Elias
user_reviews.Description: It's on the 7th floor and the elevator only goes to the 6th. Overall good atmosphere and good service.

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Teklu
user_reviews.Description: Place is new and people don’t know about it.  Owned by the TV chef Z, it serves up some fantastic tibs - never had meat so soft.

user_reviews.Name: ZEMEN
user_reviews.Description: The chef special tibs is a must try. Very nice atmosphere and view.

user_reviews.Name: Eskender Gebremariam
user_reviews.Description: The atmosphere and decor was modern. The food was amazing. It’s a must try.

title: Grand Kubi Turkish Restaurant
address: Cameroon St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Sebrin Redi
user_reviews.Description: Had an amazing experience at this restaurant food was fresh and very delicious. Desserts were amazing and had authentic Turkish taste, service was exceptional as well.

user_reviews.Name: Eyob Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Grand Kubi Turkish Restaurant, and I can confidently say it was one of the best culinary experiences I've had in a long time. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with traditional Turkish decor that instantly transported me to the heart of Turkey.

I ordered the kebab, and it was nothing short of spectacular. The meat was perfectly grilled, tender, and bursting with flavor. Each bite was infused with aromatic spices that danced on my palate. The accompanying sides, including fluffy rice and fresh salad, complemented the kebab beautifully.

The service was attentive and friendly, enhancing the overall experience.

user_reviews.Name: M Martin
user_reviews.Description: Wow. Quite surprised how good it was. We didn't order so I'm not sure what we had but it was a large group platter with various kinds of meat items. So good. Had some bread and salad items before the main dish arrived. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Hidayah Muhammed
user_reviews.Description: The food is nice but too expencive

user_reviews.Name: Haru Sliw
user_reviews.Description: One of the rare restaurants where I found the food good and halal, some dishes even delicious

user_reviews.Name: Hoor Suhail
user_reviews.Description: The starter platter was good but other than that everything was mid. And the turkish chai was okay. But the food was super dryy. title: Makseyo Restaurant
address: XQXP+62M Makseyo Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Mikiyas Melkamu
user_reviews.Description:
While the pricing remained affordably moderate, I observed a significant decrease in both taste and overall food quality, particularly in their once renowned dish, the Makseyo special.
Previously, Makseyo Restaurant had established a reputation for delivering delectable and satisfying meals at reasonable prices. However, it seems that as the cost has remained relatively stable, compromises have been made in terms of ingredient quality and flavor profiles. This has resulted in a noticeable decline in taste and the overall culinary experience. Specifically, the Makseyo special that used to be a standout dish has lost its allure. The distinct flavors that made it a favorite among customers seem to have diminished, leaving the dish lacking in its once delightful taste. This change was a major disappointment, as I had high expectations based on previous positive experiences. On a more positive note, I must acknowledge the pleasant environment within the restaurant. The ambiance was enjoyable, providing a comfortable setting for dining and socializing. The interior design and overall atmosphere contributed to a pleasant experience, despite the letdown in food quality. It is my hope that Makseyo takes the necessary steps to restore the quality and taste of their dishes, particularly the Makseyo special, in order to once again deliver a satisfying dining experience to customers.

user_reviews.Name: angeline musakwa
user_reviews.Description:
I dined at Jade Restaurant in Addis Ababa last night and had a mixed experience. Making a reservation and getting a table was easy and efficient. However, our waiter was not very helpful or attentive. We ended up ordering more food than we needed because he failed to inform us that the large platter we ordered was sufficient for 2 people, especially after starters. Additionally, he didn't clarify that some of the extra dishes we ordered were already included in the platter, despite my attempts to ask.

What was even more disappointing was that our waiter seemed to disappear after taking our order and serving us drinks. We were then served by two or three different waiters, which made us feel like our table was not a priority. Throughout the meal, no one checked in to see if we wanted refills on our drinks despite the fact that when we made our order I requested for wine menu but it never came.

On a positive note, the food was delicious! The dumplings were the best I've ever had. However, the service could be greatly improved. We had to ask for our dessert and takeaway order after paying, which was a bit frustrating. It was also noticeable that other tables, received more attentive service and were given their takeaway order before they even settled their bill.

Overall, I would recommend Jade Restaurant for their delicious food, but hope that they will work on improving their service to provide a more consistent and welcoming experience for all customers.

**Food & Drinks:**
The menu at Amiire Cafe is diverse, catering to a variety of tastes. On my first visit,which was flavorful and authentic. The coffee, a must-try in Addis Ababa, was rich and aromatic, showcasing Ethiopia’s renowned coffee culture. During my second visit, I which was equally satisfying. user_reviews.Description:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at this interesting cafe that promises a great experience that was somewhat enjoyable. I wasn't expecting much from this place but it shows potential for being a great cafe.

The atmosphere of this place tends to give off a cozy vibe. While the interior design of the cafe seems basic, the outside sitting area tends to be a more comfortable and nicer atmosphere if there is good weather to go with.

I wouldn't say the food here extraordinary but it is a wonderful food and comforting dish.

The service here was nice. I had a great time.

user_reviews.Name: Hablin
user_reviews.Description:
I recently visited this place and it  left me utterly disappointed and disgusted. From the moment I walked in, the place had a musty smell that made me question their cleanliness standards. The tables were sticky and covered in crumbs, clearly not having been properly wiped down .

We decided to order a rice with chicken,salad and a chicken wrap , hoping it would redeem the cafe's reputation, but boy was I wrong. The chicken was dry and tasteless, and they add oyster oil and barbecue  Sause even though I told them NOT to. It felt like they just threw random burnt vegies together without any thought or care.

Overall, this cafe was a complete disaster. The lack of cleanliness, unappetizing food, terrible service, made it an incredibly unpleasant experience. I would strongly advise anyone to steer clear of this place unless they enjoy disappointment and regret.

user_reviews.Name: Cassandra Tesch
user_reviews.Description: I enjoyed my meal here, and the service was good. I had a macchiato and French toast. The French toast was well done and I did not even need to put syrup on it and had a perfect level of sweetness. My daughter had the steak Panini, which she really loved, and my partner had an egg omelette with bread. The special tea here is particularly delightful.  However, the bathroom facilities, leave something to be desired.

user_reviews.Name: Marben Solania
user_reviews.Description:
Good food at a reasonable price. Wide selection from pasta, sandwiches, main courses, and beverages. I believe their healthy juices differentiate them from other nearby restaurants. Also proximate to several hotels and fromcity centre.

Ambience is refreshing, with both indoor and outdoor seating surrounded by greenery. Service is quite fast.

user_reviews.Name: KKG
user_reviews.Description:
Lime tree restaurant may be good for a specific target audience, but as a south Asian, the food more or less failed to please me. One good thing was that the proportions were really big. We ordered a full roasted chicken, and you can see in the image how much there was. Aside from the fact that it was oily, cold, and (at least for me) the food wasn't good, the service was good. They offered to reheat the food, and did a quick delivery. We could finish all of it, so we asked to pack it for take away (100 birr for take away). But, as soon as we got out in the street, the bottom of the plastic gave away and all of it dropped :(
Luckily, there were some hungry looking dogs who swooped right in and cleaned the chicken faster than a vacuum cleaner.
