user_reviews.Description: Długo szukałem takiej lokalnej, tradycyjnej restauracji etiopskiej. Piękna stylizacja domu. Domowa kuchnia z perfekcyjnym daniemn kioto. Do tego tradycyjna muzyka. Wspaniale, że pielęgnuje się takie miejsca.

title: Tena Adam Restaurant
address: XQPQ+852 Tena Adam Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Hailu
user_reviews.Description: Health keto Diet

title: TinyTalian
address: XQPQ+VPF TinyTalian, 2, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Nuhamin Abera
user_reviews.Description: TinyTalian is such a comfort place for me & my sister. It has a beautiful aesthetic, lighting and layout that perfectly balances a welcoming atmosphere. On top of the artwork of the interior they serve great food with flavors worth every bite every time we visit. Adding up to the magical experience of having staff attentive and genuinely passionate to ensure a memorable time with a thoughtful recommendations to try out new foods and drinks. The gate opens at 12:30 pm. It has an inclusive environment to all age ranges. Reservation is required to secure a good seat since it can be a little occupied most times. And plates are ordered per person and there has been a little bit of price adjustment recently. It is an absolute must-visit place for any occasions.

user_reviews.Name: Sena K Kera
user_reviews.Description:
We had a wonderful dining experience here — the place has a warm, relaxed atmosphere and serves truly delicious food. We ordered the carbonara, homemade lasagna, and ravioli. The ravioli was the standout — absolutely delicious and bursting with flavor. I’d highly recommend trying it. The lasagna was also excellent, rich and comforting with great depth. The carbonara was a bit on the dry side, but the staff explained that it can be made creamier if you ask when ordering. Dessert was also a highlight — beautifully presented and tasted amazing. Partway through our meal, the chef, 'Sara', came out to greet us. It was such a thoughtful and personal touch that made the experience even more memorable.
Just a heads up — reservations are required, so be sure to book in advance.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Kassa
user_reviews.Description: It's an Italian restaurant at the old building of Skylight Hotel. I really enjoyed the ambient of the restaurant, table setting, the sitting arrangements, and the neatness of the cutlery and crockery. The service was good, but at times, there was a delay in hitting the server, and in the end, it took a long time to get us coffee. The food was ok as some of the dishes lacked some spices and appeared a bit blunt. We tried chicken alfrefo, seemed a bit dry, smoked salmon spaghetti, that lacked spices, the inside of the eggplant parmigiana was dry, and the lasagna was good. Overall, the place is good if they can improve a little on some of their dishes.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet A.
user_reviews.Description:
Yesterday, my sisters and I visited the restaurant located in the beautiful Skylight Hotel, hoping for a pleasant dining experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be quite the opposite. The food was not delicious, and to make matters worse, we ended up with food poisoning afterward.

The table was not properly set up, and the service did not meet the standards one would expect from such a reputable restaurant. Although we ate what we ordered because we were hungry, we left feeling disappointed by both the service and the quality of the food. Overall, it was not worth the money, and we hope the management takes steps to improve food safety, service, and overall dining quality.

user_reviews.Name: Mcimagin
user_reviews.Description: As a crew, we had a very good time in this restaurant, the food is absolutely delicious, I do recommend.  We were hosted by Selmawit, she is amazing 🤩 , very friendly and always ready to help.

user_reviews.Name: Ваня Пусев
user_reviews.Description: We came here for lunch and loved it! 🍝 Super cozy place with great vibes and friendly staff. The pasta was fresh and really tasty — especially the lasagna! Definitely a 5/5 spot ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

user_reviews.Name: Salem Gizachew
user_reviews.Description: From your staff Mr Getenet was the one responsible for the management at the time “Oct 16,2025” time” 7:15 pm up to 10:30pm”. He was so unprofessional, disrespectful and humiliated us, it felt like he had a personal hate towards us. This not only disturbed our atmosphere but made us reconsider the reputation the hotel has had. i suggest the hotel should act responsible and take the necessary measures.

user_reviews.Name: Jerry Aboneh
user_reviews.Description: The service was amazing and @meaza she was soo sweet. We’re definitely coming back. Thankyou meaza and tiny italy for having us

title: Addis Ababa Restaurant | Piassa |
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Juanita Yeheyes
user_reviews.Description: Excellent service, excellent food, the atmosphere was absolutely gorgeous and so comfortable and relaxing. It felt like home. Would definitely recommend anyone who wants a beautiful setting with amazing traditional food and delicious filtered tej to try this place out. They have been in Piassa for many many years.

user_reviews.Name: Pooja Patel
user_reviews.Description:
Stopped here for lunch as part of our tour and enjoyed authentic Ethiopian food!
They made a special vegan dish for us with varying spice levels - fresh and flavorful. The Tej (honey wine) was also the right balance of sweet and refreshing.

user_reviews.Name: Jaila P.
user_reviews.Description: Loved the ambiance. Great vegan food. I don't drink coffee, but I had some and enjoyed their traditional ceremony.

user_reviews.Name: Henok Garedew (Henny breezy)
user_reviews.Description:
This place is the best cultural restaurant in Addis owned and operated by the Addis Ababa city administration. The food is fresh clean and original Ethiopian traditional taste, price is very affordable comparing with other similar restaurants. very professional staff and the place is very clean and  inviting. It's perfect for families, events and groups.
I  haighly recommend for every one.

user_reviews.Name: Lindsay Harkness
user_reviews.Description: English menu, good prices, very old historical building with lots of history. Food was delicious.

user_reviews.Name: Henok Alemu
user_reviews.Description: I had a fabulous lunch with client a vegan dish in a legendary Addis Ababa restaurant it was really fabulous we enjoyed it. And also the honey wine was also quite tasty.

user_reviews.Name: Jumana K
user_reviews.Description: Stopped for lunch at this historic and authentic Ethiopian Restaurant as part of a city tour. Really enjoyed the food and architecture of the place.

user_reviews.Name: Cibi Boovendran
user_reviews.Description:
Was here for a 1 day layover trip and absolutely loved the ambience food and honey wine .
I definitely would recommend this place if you are a tourist or probably a local . Very polite staff and friendly people all around

title: Meskott Culinary Experience
address: 2QP7+63Q Meskott Culinary Experience, 4 kilo, King George VI St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Yared GebreMichael
user_reviews.Description: I’ve been to Meskot a couple of times and always enjoyed it. The food is tasty and the service is friendly. Prices feel a bit on the high side for me, so it’s not a spot I’d go to all the time. I liked the beef steak and roasted chicken, even if the portions are smaller. It’s a nice place for a small group or a date night.

user_reviews.Name: SUNNY
user_reviews.Description: I love it here it feels so cozy the service was marvellous they are always checking up on you with out even being called. It's suitable for couples, families or if you decided to done in group they have place for all I personally ordered steak and I was obsessed with it. It was amazing experience from the entrance to the exist.

user_reviews.Name: Philip Ian Butler
user_reviews.Description:
Fantastic lunch!  First time visiting this place as I used to frequent Romina (closed for refurbishment).
Excellent service and really perfectly cooked food; it was delicious.
As a tourist the price was very reasonable but probably pricey for locals, but definitely recommend to try.

user_reviews.Name: Eyob Abate
user_reviews.Description: I really enjoyed the atmosphere, availability of parking space and the service but down side is the limited menu options mainly European dishes no Ethiopian variety. The price also is a bit toomuch. I paid more than a thousand birr for a regular pasta ...pricy

user_reviews.Name: Bruk Aklilu
user_reviews.Description:
Great Atmosphere and Amazing Food!

This restaurant is a hidden gem! The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot for both romantic dates and business meetings, especially at night when the atmosphere is even more charming. The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish prepared to perfection. Service was friendly and efficient, adding to the overall great experience.

The only minor downside is that parking can be a bit tricky, but it’s definitely worth the effort. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great dining experience!

user_reviews.Name: Maria Achilleia
user_reviews.Description: I really liked Meskott Culinary Experience restaurant as it had live music, a violin 🎻and harmonium. The music was calm but happy. The food was very good too, I had the beef ribs with corn and pineapple 🍍 and I really liked it. Totally recommend it! The service was super polite and fast, I have informed by my sweet waitress that there is a live on Thurs and Saturdays too. The cheesecake was too sour for my taste. But overall staff and atmosphere was amazing. The place is very spacious with different levels. Totally recommend it!

user_reviews.Name: Birhanu Mesele
user_reviews.Description:
⭐⭐⭐ Mixed Experience at Meskott Culinary – Great Atmosphere but Overpriced

I visited Meskott with friends for lunch, and while the atmosphere was lovely and the service was excellent, the prices were extremely expensive. We ordered fasting dishes (since it was a fasting day), and the bill was surprisingly high for what we got. The food was good, but not outstanding enough to justify the cost.

If you’re looking for a nice ambiance and don’t mind splurging, Meskott is a decent choice. However, for the price, I expected a more exceptional dining experience.

user_reviews.Name: Mohd Hashim El-Tahir
user_reviews.Description:
Ordered the mixed grill which was cooked perfectly, well seasoned and was easily sufficient for 3 people as the main course.
With that we had Chicken alfredo pasta and Beef Lasagne. The alfredo was very tasty and creamy. The lasagne was fine, a bit on the flat side and could have used some more spices.
The sitting and atmosphere of the place was cozy with sofistcation and the staff made the entire experience feel warm and pleasant.
Kudos for the super fast meal preparation time.

title: Village Cafe
address: Menilik II Ave, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Ahadu Yeshitela
user_reviews.Description: By far the best Mexican food. The receipts are authentic and love the taco varieties and burrito. They also have good cocktails and mocktails. Highly recommend.

user_reviews.Name: Afom F Kinfe
user_reviews.Description:
Located right next to 'Laba wings'. They are under the same roof. It's confusing I know. But I was told that this is the cafe as the name says it, and it is just for tea,coffee or some cakes.
The cakes were all not attractive for the eyes. They were all dry like they've been out there for days. As you can see on the picture. Sad experience I swear 😅

user_reviews.Name: Embassy of Tacos
user_reviews.Description: The corn tortillas were great, and the flour tortillas were better than most I have had outside of SW USA/ NW Mex. Seriously, they should be proud. The beans were delicious and plenty of vegetarian options.  Their salsas have been adapted for Ethiopia, but they were excellent. Very spicy 🔥 (which we ❤️)

user_reviews.Name: Vemund Brune Hareide
user_reviews.Description:
Quality tacos, excellent nachos and wonderful overall.
Sweet and soulful atmosphere and music🇪🇹♥️
Really surprised there was few people here..

user_reviews.Name: Feben Abrham
user_reviews.Description:
Like most people, I was very delighted to hear that the Village has reopened. I know I missed their frozen peach margaritas! Even as one of the oldest Mexican restaurants in the city, Village has been able to keep the consistency of their food and service. I love that they have sour cream option (which is not something you get everywhere). They also offer vegan/fasting options.. I recommend their bean tacos!!! I love getting the quesadillas as it has the perfect combination of cheese and meat.

Pro tip: Not everyone likes Mexican  food.. and that ok! You can always order from Laba Wings, and get drinks made from Upscale Kitchen.

user_reviews.Name: R. Waller
user_reviews.Description: This place is absolute rip off to the point it insults your intelligence. I walk in there order chicken tacos and it doesn’t specify that it only comes with 2 very tiny tacos for 520 birr. When it shows four tacos on the picture. I could’ve ordered more but it took them over 25-30 min for the very small order the gave me in the first. This is just another place where they take advantage of foreigners. The money may small but I personally I don’t want to be taken advantage of. 2 bites size tacos for 520 birr. It’s suppose to come with  four.

user_reviews.Name: Chelsea Clough
user_reviews.Description:
I’m from California so came here with my expectations very much in check, so am extra happy to report back how tasty my meal was. The chips were a tiny bit stale but were legit chips and the salsa served with them was fresh and delicious.   I had the steak quesadilla and was super impressed. Heavy on the flavorful steak, served with fresh guacamole, diced tomatoes, and sour cream. Add in the proper fresh pineapple margarita and my injera and tins saturated stomach was in heaven. Highly recommend and will be back to try other things on the menu!

(Service great and good ambience too!)

user_reviews.Name: kana travel
user_reviews.Description:
Tacos cost between 300 and 400 ETB each, and rice bowls were 1,000 to 1,500 ETB.
With service charge and tax added, it ended up being quite expensive.
The food was decent, but the atmosphere wasn’t very relaxing, so I don’t think I’ll go back.

title: Ruby'z Cafe' and Restaurant
address: 2Q57+4PM Ruby'z Cafe' and Restaurant, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Classy Decor
user_reviews.Description: Such a gem of a spot! This small, cozy café instantly feels like home. The service is top-notch—everyone is welcoming and kind, making the experience even better. I had their chechebsa before, and it was absolutely delicious—flavorful, perfectly spiced, and satisfying. But what really stole the show were their desserts—seriously amazing! You can tell everything is made with love. Definitely coming back for more!

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
This latest cafe is quite something.
The girl has been a great sport. But I'm willing to give her the benefit of the doubt.
I can't help admiring his detail and ingenuity.
I hope they will concentrate on what they should go on in light of this.
# Addis Ababa　# shawarma

user_reviews.Name: Afom F Kinfe
user_reviews.Description:
Located behind Flamingo restaurant, very classy and peaceful restaurant. Since there are not many options around this area I was glad to have found this place.
It was fasting season so I didn't try other foods, yet the pasta with arrabita sauce was delicious. Recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Kaleb Deribe
user_reviews.Description: The place was small and cozy, but our salad unfortunately contained pieces of eggshell. When we brought this to their attention, they refused to rectify the situation, which left me disappointed.

user_reviews.Name: Sam- Tar
user_reviews.Description:
Vibrant little cafe behind flamingo.
I didn’t get anything as I was just passing through
But will surely come back to check out their food.

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: A casual but amazing spot.

user_reviews.Name: Benioni X
user_reviews.Description: I like their salad 🥗

user_reviews.Name: Mulugeta Workye
user_reviews.Description: What a delicious spaghetti with tomato sauce

title: SAQ Restaurant
address: 2Q3V+XR6 SAQ Restaurant, Unnamed Road, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Solomon Dawit
user_reviews.Description: This restaurant boasts an incredible team that delivers impeccable service. The ambiance is neat and inviting. The food is not only delicious but also reasonably priced, making it a great value for the quality offered. A fantastic choice for anyone seeking a memorable dining experience!

user_reviews.Name: Birhanu Mesele
user_reviews.Description: A great place for Ethiopian Food. The meat combo ( የፍስክ ኮምቦ) is so tasty. Fair price 👌🏾

user_reviews.Name: Bruk Alemu
user_reviews.Description: Food was great,service was great,cozy environment,10 out of 10

user_reviews.Name: Michel Damite
user_reviews.Description: Delicious and fresh Ethiopian food and the service are exceptional. Perfect location and the are also available for delivery on all the major delivery apps... 👌

user_reviews.Name: Yisakor Markos
user_reviews.Description: I can  say good things about this hotel. From the stunning views to the comfortable service and, every aspect of my stay was exceptional. I was feeling relaxed, and eager to return. Thank you for a truly memorable service.

user_reviews.Name: Phillip Jengwa
user_reviews.Description:
tasty food with fair price
higly recommend their agelgil too👌🏾👍🏾

user_reviews.Name: Orotin Remie Jimmy
user_reviews.Description: Didn't try their food, but the various assorted drinks will keep you asking for more with the DJ sampling in on a variety of tunes!

user_reviews.Name: Musse Tesfaye
user_reviews.Description: Food is great but sometimes they mess your order if it's oddly specific, but overall it's a good spot

title: Allebnany Restaurant
address: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

user_reviews.Name: Hussain Almoamen
user_reviews.Description:
I thought I will enjoy my food there but unfortunately didn’t.
I came for shawarma but she said we don’t have it now and instead she offered me Shish Tawooq sandwich. I accepted coz I was already there.
The sandwich looked fine but didn’t taste good, it has more fries inside than chicken and has nothing from vegetables like at least onions. Costed 700br.
I think they have better dishes but I don’t think I will come back.

The restaurant is at the back side and the one you see in the street is the coffee shop

user_reviews.Name: Letera Asfaw
user_reviews.Description: They have good foods and cakes, specially I enjoy their cake and baklava. However, the service is poor. The waitress are not welcoming. Sometime the place is crowded and noisy with people and hard to find table.

user_reviews.Name: bini abe
user_reviews.Description:
Allebnany Restaurant offers a remarkable  dining experience. The food is exceptional; every dish we tried was bursting with flavor. A standout for me was their dessert—simply amazing! It was the perfect sweet ending to our meal, and I still find myself craving it days later.

The service team at Alebnany deserves high praise as well.

One suggestion I have is to consider expanding the vegetarian options during fasting times. If they could incorporate more vegetarian dishes into their menu, I would definitely find myself visiting more frequently!

Overall, Allebnany Restaurant is a fantastic choice for anyone looking for delicious food, great service, and a lovely atmosphere. I can't wait to return, especially for that incredible dessert!

user_reviews.Name: Roseau Trading co
user_reviews.Description:
Great place for authentic Arabian desserts

I came back here for dinner few days back and here are few photos of what I had it was the best hummus that I had  and a great arrais meat wonderful taste

Will come again

user_reviews.Name: Mihai Ignat
user_reviews.Description:
Splendid restaurant with very tasty foods!
I wish that I knew earlier that they have a buffet for Ramadan period which started at 6 pm, I would have come then! But I got there at 8 and they were just cleaning the buffet.

However the menu is very simple yet the food is very raffinate!
I had some kebab which was very tasty and appetisers!

I would love to give 5 starts however they need to improve the waiters…
I ordered for Coca-Cola and she just brought the bottle without the opener. I asked for an opener or if she could open it for me and she never brought it, so I had to open the bottle with my lighter 😂

Then I asked for chips for my kebab and she brought rice.

Then her English was very very poor.

It’s pity because the restaurant is amazing and the food is delicious! You guys need to improve on your waiters.

Otherwise I’m happy to come back again soon!

user_reviews.Name: T. GeBrim
user_reviews.Description:
Wow! This is the real Lebanese style of # shawarma in # Addis Ababa that I finally found out.
The long, thin, and crispy baked bread contains the chicken meat and french fries, which is my favourite.

It seems to be mainly busy at dinnertime, but they are also open in the mornings and at lunchtime.
I was told by a waitress that the live music show and dancing attraction starts at 10 pm every night for 3 hours, and that they no longer have a sheesha service.

​I realised that it would be more economical to order two chicken shawarma sandwiches than one chicken shawarma plate, considering the volume and taste.

Unfortunately, I heard that their belly dancing show has been suspended for the time being.
They have also stopped accepting credit​ cards for some unknown reason.

# shawarma　# Addis Ababa

user_reviews.Name: Meklit Bekele
user_reviews.Description: I truly appreciate Mario's wonderful suggestion to try out this restaurant. The shawarma was absolutely delicious, and this spot has now earned a place on my list of top favorites. Thank you so much!

user_reviews.Name: Fadi Iskandarani
user_reviews.Description:
I was surprised to find a Lebanese restaurant and sweet shop in Addis Ababa… went in with local friend and enjoyed the sweet

I was lucky to meet chef Elie.. who welcomed us very warmly

Next day went for lunch with friends, food was very delicious and portions are big

It was a very pleasant experience… next time in Addis Ababa I know where to go for food

title: Berlin Bar & Restaurant | Atlas | በርሊን ባርና ሬስቶራንት | አትላስ
address: 2Q3J+9C7 Berlin Bar & Restaurant | Atlas | በርሊን ባርና ሬስቶራንት | አትላስ, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

owner.name: Berlin Bar & Restaurant | Atlas | በርሊን ባርና ሬስቶራንት | አትላስ (Owner)

user_reviews.Name: Insos Jawa Get Lost Safely
user_reviews.Description: Came here to find Schnitzel for our son, but unfortunately they do not have it. We ended up getting Döner, Döner wrap, and Margarits Pizza. The food was really delicious. The pizza was the best we tasted after about 2 weeks being in Addis Ababa. They also served draft heineken beer here. The staffs were also really friendly. The downside was that it was difficult to find the place. There was no sign around. It is though located on the first floor above a laundry service. The glass window showing the street need cleaning.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Kassa
user_reviews.Description: Being a huge fun of burgers, I really enjoyed the burger and fries. They do have other options, like pizza, soup, salad, chicken, fish, and pasta dishes. I only tried the cheese burger. It was enjoyable and tasty. The sauce was great, and the french fries were amazing. The only thing I would suggest for next time would be the meat was a bit called and the bread seemed a little soaked in oil. Other than that, it was really, really good. I will definitely go again to give it another try. They serve beers, and the place looked fun to hang out with friends.

user_reviews.Name: yabi tegene
user_reviews.Description: Ordered online for beef wrap and beef sandwiches which came as chicken. When I called back and notified them they got the order wrong they said they’ll replace it so they took the wrong order but only replaced the chicken with beef pieces with the same bread and all. The taste was a mix of chicken and beef, horrible! Plus, when opening the box, it had a bleach kind of smell and taste. Terrible!

user_reviews.Name: Feben Abrham
user_reviews.Description: It’s always a great feeling to find a nice burger joint in Addis! Berlin is a great vibe if you decide to dine in, but also if you get delivery. Note that the fries taste way better when consumed there than delivered. It becomes a little rubbery and I don’t like that. I recommend their cheese burgers! The taste is very consistent and they also have nice mayonnaise. The best part is that they’re open 24/6 (closed on Mondays) so you can get a delicious burger after a night out. Not pictured is their tenders. A little oily, but still pretty good. Parking can be a hassle since it’s on Atlas road.

user_reviews.Name: Aida A
user_reviews.Description:
Berlin Addis has been able to consistently serve the best quality food in any restaurant in Addis for its price range. It has, hands down, the best chicken wings. The fries are served hot and crispy. The sandwiches, the wraps, the pizzas, dessert, and other German inspired items on the menu are created with love and pride. The chef, also co-owner, has an unwavering, unflinching, uncompromising stand on the quality of ingredients, the mise en place, and the plating. Despite all this and the generous portions, the price remains fair. By day, Berlin Addis is a restaurant. At night, the bar, the DJ, and the lighting ensure that the restaurant ambiance has the distinct feel of a nightclub ... the kitchen remains open 24 hours a day.
The perfect place for a midnight burger.

user_reviews.Name: Peter Weber
user_reviews.Description: On the first floor, a cozy pub with friendly service. The chicken burger was okay, but the fries were hard, too greasy, simply inedible. No attempt to accommodate the complaint.

user_reviews.Name: B Man
user_reviews.Description: Had a terrible experience with this restaurant here. Ordered 3 meals and even two hours later the food was still being prepared. They made us starve for those two hours while we waited for the order. They say it was a communication issue and that they didn’t get a clear order but they also have a responsibility to be proactive and double check things so as to avoid issues like this. We ended up cancelling the order.

user_reviews.Name: Dawit Mulugeta
user_reviews.Description: The Cheeseburger came looking real fine, had pickles even. But, the party was neither juicy not was it seasoned properly. If only they adjusted their fat to red meat ratio and sprinkled a bit more salt while preparing their hamburger patty, it could turn out really well. The chicken wings were ok but same issue with salt. They admitted they don't salt their wings when we asked what happened. Place is nothing fancy but it's nice and clean.

title: Hilton Addis Ababa
address: Menelik II Ave, Addis Ababa 1164, Ethiopia
description: Airy quarters, some with mountain views, in a premium hotel offering 3 eateries & a geothermal pool.

user_reviews.Name: Yonas Isaak Tekle
user_reviews.Description:
Hilton Addis Ababa is an amazing place to stay and relax. It is a historic property that beautifully blends rich tradition with modern facilities. I had a wonderful stay and highly recommend it. All the staff I have had an opportunity to interact with were amazing but I would also like to give a special shout-out to Dawit Fikade, Alemayehu T. Markos, Hailu Abreham and Jerry Gedamu, who hosted me at the breakfast restaurant. They treated me like a family member and attended to all my needs. Their professionalism and kindness go beyond words.
In addition, I had access to the Executive Lounge and the opportunity to experience exquisite dining on the top floor, featuring breathtaking views and delicious food. The staff there, including Bizu Getahun and Tensaiy Seyoum as well as Hanna from executive lounge operator, were outstanding in their service and exceptional care.
I am truly grateful for the warmth, attention, and exceptional service I received from these individuals. Thank you for making my stay so memorable!

user_reviews.Name: Fanuel Teklegiorgis
user_reviews.Description:
At Hilton Addis Ababa and was truly impressed by the overall quality of service, comfort, and hospitality. The hotel offers a relaxing atmosphere, well-maintained facilities, and a sense of professionalism that makes every stay enjoyable.

A special shout-out to the Gazebo team, whose service was consistently excellent throughout my stay. Tarik, Bereket, and Berkayew deserve particular recognition for their attentiveness, warmth, and dedication. They went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect, always serving with a smile and genuine care. Their constant presence and professionalism made a real difference and elevated the entire experience.

Hilton Addis Ababa is a place where you truly feel valued as a guest. Thanks to the outstanding Gazebo service team.

user_reviews.Name: Karolina Pearl
user_reviews.Description:
I had an excellent 10-day stay at the Hilton Addis Ababa. The highlight of my experience was the incredible staff, especially during breakfast every morning. They consistently went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and well taken care of. Their warm hospitality, kindness, and attention to detail truly made our stay unforgettable. 🩵💙💜

Thank you to the wonderful breakfast team—you made our mornings so much brighter. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Heyab Addisu
user_reviews.Description:
I regularly come to Hilton’s Gazebo Restaurant, and every visit is consistently amazing. From the moment I walk in, the atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff always make me feel at home. Samuel, the manager, is truly outstanding, he’s  friendly, attentive, and genuinely cares about the guests, which makes a huge difference.

The hotel is very nice , I have enjoyed the wide breakfast selection, the staff is very friendly and ready to help,  the pastry corner is literal heaven , shoutout to the Baker.

Alex has a passion for his job.

The entire team made our Christmas holiday worth it !

God bless Ethiopia.

Merci.

user_reviews.Description:
I am not a guest at Hilton Hotel but I am a member of Hilton's remarkable and intriguing gym.
While working out at the gym, I am always impressed by the diligence and responsiveness of the gym attendants and the remarkable recreational manager named Meklit Keflie is a person with an exceptional leadership experience and ability . Her professionalism, kindness, and hospitality have improved the hotel's service profoundly.

She is constantly demonstrating outstanding leadership, ensuring both guests and staffs feel valued and supported inorder to ensure smooth flow of operations.

The other person that I can not help noticing while I am at the gym is a guy named Biruk Shewadeg. Every time I see him, he is always working voluntarily and happily to keep the fitness area exceptionally clean, organized, and well-stocked with towels and water.

Nebyat from Hilton gym.

title: Hilton Addis Ababa
address: Menelik II Ave, Addis Ababa 1164, Ethiopia
description: Airy quarters, some with mountain views, in a premium hotel offering 3 eateries & a geothermal pool.

user_reviews.Name: Yonas Isaak Tekle
user_reviews.Description:
Hilton Addis Ababa is an amazing place to stay and relax. It is a historic property that beautifully blends rich tradition with modern facilities. I had a wonderful stay and highly recommend it. All the staff I have had an opportunity to interact with were amazing but I would also like to give a special shout-out to Dawit Fikade, Alemayehu T. user_reviews.Name: fitse wako
user_reviews.Description:
Nega Bonger Hotel in Addis Ababa is a comfortable and welcoming destination that blends modern hospitality with traditional Ethiopian warmth. Conveniently located, it’s a good choice for both business travelers and leisure guests looking for easy access to the city.

The rooms are clean, spacious, and well-furnished, offering guests a pleasant stay with all the necessary amenities. Many visitors appreciate the calm and cozy atmosphere, which makes it a great place to unwind after a busy day in Addis.

The hotel also offers a restaurant that serves both Ethiopian and international dishes, along with a bar and lounge for more relaxed moments. Its event and meeting facilities make it suitable for gatherings, conferences, or social occasions.

Service is consistently friendly and attentive, with staff members going out of their way to ensure guests feel at home.

Overall, Nega Bonger Hotel is a solid mid-range option in Addis Ababa, providing comfort, good food, and reliable service at reasonable value

user_reviews.Name: Robel Mebrhatom
user_reviews.Description: The swimming pool was great we had such a good time. The price is 660birr

user_reviews.Name: Yaphet Samson
user_reviews.Description:
The staff was incredibly welcoming and attentive, making sure all my needs were met. The rooms were clean, spacious, and well-equipped with all the necessary amenities.

The hotel's location is convenient, providing easy access to local attractions. I especially enjoyed the cuisine served at their restaurant with a variety of both Ethiopian and international dishes that were delicious and beautifully presented.

user_reviews.Name: Lidia
user_reviews.Description: The room is spacious with traditional Ethiopian elements of interior design. The staff is friendly & a good breakfast with all sorts of choices. The chickina tibs at dinner was amazing. Recommend it especially for family gatherings & it is child friendly with a backyard & swimming pool. Who knew there is a skating there? & fair priced! Enjoyed my stay there.

user_reviews.Description: We stayed there 2 night and it was a good experience over all. The #breakfast #buffet was excellent , it had local delicacies and also foreign cuisine. user_reviews.Description: Exceptional property - well managed and maintained, great facilities and excellent, attentive people.  Ethiopians are friendly by nature but the team at the at the Sheraton is over the top. ||Everything about my stay was first class starting with the check-in process which was handled by Mariamawit Yimer. She thinks like a guest, was very friendly / funny and has a contagious, positive attitude.  I made a point of telling the front desk manager, Zelalem, about Mariamawit. user_reviews.Name: RakeshWahi
user_reviews.Description: The Sheraton Addis Ababa is the best hotel in the city. It’s a sprawling estate with a great walking track and outside gym. The pool and SPA are exceptional. Restaurants at the hotel are very diverse in cuisine. The staff was very well trained and courteous. A fantastic stay. 👏👏

user_reviews.Name: 343howardr
user_reviews.Description: The Sheraton Addis was an excellent hotel. The hotel sits up on a small hill overlooking part of Addis. The approach to the hotel from side is very impressive.  The quality and ambiance of the hotel was more than what I was expecting. Addis and Ethiopia are nice in places but certainly has its rough spots as well. The Sheraton will make you feel well cared for while you are there. The doormen out front and reception staff were always very helpful. |All of the dining venues we ate in were very good.  The food, drinks, whether coffee or wine were exceptional. Our favorite restaurant was Stagioni Italian Restaurant. We ate there for dinner with a nice view out the back overlooking a lit up skyline of Addis Ababa.(see Photo) We tried the local Ethiopian wine, Castel Rift Valley, Cabernet Sauvignon, which we thought was very good and much cheaper than the imported wines from South Africa or France.    Also, we had very nice drinks and snacks before our city tour at the Fountain Court bar in the lounge area. |We booked some tours before hand but probably could have waited to book at the Sheraton.|Did not have any qualms about security and no issues with noise or crowds. On Saturday night it was very popular with nice groups of locals enjoying this lovely hotel.

user_reviews.Name: Cosmin Pavel
user_reviews.Description: I’ve stayed here five times now, and it’s honestly one of the best places you can stay in Addis. Some of the amenities are a bit older and show some use, but everything is always very clean and comfortable. A little renovation in a few rooms could make it even better, but overall it’s a great place.

user_reviews.Name: 135jamr
user_reviews.Description: Service is good - but rooms are very old, with old furniture and not thought for the business traveler. It took me forever to understand how the old lighting system works, with all the writings being gone by usage, and in the room there was not a single USB plug! That should be a bare minimum nowadays. There are definitely better options in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Taylor Kidd
user_reviews.Description: Overall a very nice hotel with excellent staff and luxurious rooms. Beddings and linens are clean and comfortable. Gym is well-equipped and the pool is also enjoyable. I must say, I've been here 3 times and I've gotten sick each time just eating hotel food only. Not acceptable for a chain like this. Hotel is also located in a rough area so don't walk around with any valuables or they will be removed from you.

user_reviews.Name: Tsega Fanta
user_reviews.Description:
Sheraton Addis is amazing — I love the ambience, the service, the cleanliness, the spa, and the entertainment. Everything feels top-notch and welcoming.

Just a small note: at the big coffee ceremony, a warmer smile would make the experience even better. On both visits, the hostess seemed less welcoming compared to the outstanding service everywhere else.

Still, Sheraton Addis is an exceptional place I’d highly recommend!

Meron - The Kitchen

Kulani on behalf of Zami Collective

When you complain to management, all he can say was this is Africa and that my expectations should be lowered. I meat with this mentality from management, it explains the behaviour of the rest of the staff. ||I have stayed in many hotels in Addis Ababa and I have never experienced such a terrible situation. This hotel needs to be closed, renovated and their staff retrained.

user_reviews.Name: tinao202
user_reviews.Description: Not even sure how to write this without being too negative.  Just let me say I was so disappointed.  I think I expected more from this hotel based on its location

user_reviews.Name: TheDesertsweeper
user_reviews.Description: When reviewing things in different countries you need to adjust your expectations and reviews accordingly. For example a 4-Star hotel in Dubai on the Palm cannot be directly compared to a 4-Star hotel in downtown Dhaka. So when I say the Ambassador Hotel in Addis does not deserve even one star, that assessment is already adjusted for the level of hotels I have personally experienced in Addis on my visits. It is nothing short of terrible. Do not believe the many glowing reviews here – pay attention and you will find they are local “reviewers” with few if any other reviews. Sift through and you will find the REAL reviews, like mine, that tell the horror story as it is. This is no hotel. It is a kind of dirty squalid apartment with absolutely no service at all. Literally your room will not be cleaned. Ever. In fact it was clear that it had not been cleaned from the person who was there before me. I was greeted with a pillow that had a bright yellow dirty stain on it – facing the door. Given that I had booked this place for 2 weeks through Agoda I knew I would not get my money back so I had to make do. What did I get in this filthy smelly apartment? One roll of toilet-paper and one towel. And that is it. No water bottles. No glass or cup or plate or spoon. No kettle. No tea or coffee. Zero. And the food downstairs in the restaurant is shockingly poor. In fact I landed up eating breakfast next door at the Reliance Hotel – which, by the way, is vastly superior in every way, for almost the same money AND includes a decent breakfast. I went out and bought a kettle and tea and a cup and toilet-paper and some pillows. And then for the next 6 days I never heard or saw a single person come to check if I needed anything or to clean and service the apartment. They literally just took my money and dumped in a room which looks NOTHING like the one’s you see in Agoda or other booking sites. Oh and be sure to bring an eye-mask as your bedroom will be blasted by a bright light from next door – since you must leave the door open as there is no air-conditioning in the small bedroom. You will suffocate quickly with it closed. There are no curtains in the adjoining kitchen, so its full bright-light all night. And the whole property is dilapidated and falling to pieces. The bathroom stinks, as other real reviews point out. Even the water smells. This is a place you should avoid at all costs as there is just WAY better available, very close by, for equal or less money. The Ethiopian Authorities need to visit this place and strip it of its rating – it is no hotel at all. Disgraceful. Unfortunately one cannot post a review without allocating one star at least but be very sure it is not worth even that.

Special thanks goes to house keeping manager Workeye and Mitke. They are  exceptional & truly professional, words can’t explain them. My room was meticulously clean. Their hard work will promote them for higher positions

" የጅ ውሀ ለአዛውንት በማስታጠብ ክብር በመስጡት የሚያደርህገው መስተንግዶ እጅግ ያስመሰግነዋል"
We appreciate the efforts of all staff they put into making our stay enjoyable. Keep up the good work!
“Sky light hotel is Numero 1”
Thank all staff❤️❤️❤️
Biruk
B722

user_reviews.Name: Toby Rao
user_reviews.Description:
My stay at Skylight Hotel was really good.
Super clean, and well maintained.

My room was very nice and had a very good view! Very high standards!

The staff is fantastic! Amazing hospitality!

The lunch buffet was amazing.
Much better than my expectations.
The chicken stew, lentil salad and Injira bread were exceptional.
Aman Yasin at Runway restaurant was very helpful and provided very professional service!

user_reviews.Name: Christopher Walters
user_reviews.Description: The buffet lunch was delicious! The stews in particular were really good, eaten with a lentil bread. Desserts had a great selection, and vegetarian options as well. The chef Aman can to check on us personally and made us feel very welcome.

user_reviews.Name: Duncan Mwesige
user_reviews.Description: Fekadu and Habib at baboon bar. The two gentlemen are true legends with impeccable service. They will make you feel at home, enjoy the drink to the point you almost forget you should go home. Friendly but respectful at the same time. Your glass will never run empty. I commend them for the excellent service they are offering to us as customers. Many of my friends have expressed the same level of satisfaction with thier service.

user_reviews.Name: Farshid Tavakoli
user_reviews.Description:
Great experience in Baboon bar, getting the best service and the best taste couple of draft 👍 ever.
I want to say thanks to Ms Mihert for her kind hospitality.
Don't miss the chance of good vibe and friendly, warm temper there.

title: Radisson Blu Hotel, Addis Ababa
address: 17/18, Kazanchis Business District Kirkos Subcity, 1000, Ethiopia
description: Contemporary pick with free Wi-Fi & breakfast, plus brasserie-style dining, a gym & spa services.

user_reviews.Name: youssefk643
user_reviews.Description: The experience was good in total. |Selamawit who shares with us the Ethiopian Coffee at the main terrace, was absolutely amazing. |She came with us after her working hours to visit and grab some souvenirs.|She didn’t grab any tipp for that, she was genuinely helpful and really welcoming. |She made our stay better and it was an amazing encounter to meet her. |Hope to see Selamawit again in our next business trip

user_reviews.Name: Nadia Olson
user_reviews.Description: We had a wonderful stay in between our in country trips. The staff were helpful, friendly and very accomodating. It was wonderful to be able to use the SPA, great therapists,.good treatment and wonderful staff. Would definitely stay again.

user_reviews.Name: Zani Ethiopia
user_reviews.Description:
I had an amazing experience at this hotel! From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, welcoming very professional. The check-in process was smooth, and I was pleasantly surprised by how clean and spacious the room was.

The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the room had all the amenities I needed — fast Wi-Fi, complimentary water, and a beautiful view. Housekeeping did an excellent job every day.

user_reviews.Name: Melanie Mchinzi
user_reviews.Description: I had a great stay, friendly staff from housekeeping all the way to the porters. Good breakfast and lunch and very clean rooms. Azarias at reception exceeded my expectations at checkout and went out of his way to ensure my shuttle pick ups were settled. I will definitely stay there again. Good corporate space if you have meetings in Addis.

user_reviews.Name: Jaubert Yelkouni
user_reviews.Description:
I was truly impressed with my stay at the Radisson Blu in Addis Ababa.
I would like to express my deepest appreciation to Yegle from the restaurant team for his outstanding professionalism, kindness, and courtesy.
My sincere thanks also go to Tesfeye, the driver, for his constant availability and warm attitude.
A big shout-out to all the staff!

user_reviews.Name: Fitsum Getachew
user_reviews.Description: I had an amazing experience at the Radisson Blu thanks to Lidiya at the reception. She was warm, professional, and incredibly attentive. From the moment I arrived, she made me feel welcomed and valued. Her friendly attitude and efficient service truly elevated my stay. Thank you, Lidiya, for your outstanding hospitality!

user_reviews.Name: Sthe Ntlhabane
user_reviews.Description:
I had an extremely distressing experience at the Radisson Blu Hotel at Addis Ababa. During our stay, my friends wallet  was stolen, and what was most disappointing was the complete lack of empathy, concern, or willingness from the hotel staff to assist us during this traumatic incident.

In addition, the handling of our airport shuttle arrangements was highly unprofessional. Our travel agent requested a payment link for the shuttle, but the hotel failed to respond. On the night before our departure, we approached reception to confirm the payment, only to be told that our agent had not paid and that the payment link is not working because there is no network

The situation escalated further when hotel staff requested our agent’s credit card details, which we clearly stated would be illegal and inappropriate to share. When we asked for the hotel’s bank account details to make payment, we were told that they were not allowed to share them and that we should instead swipe a card on site to pay for the shuttle as they are doing us favor by asking for our credit card details. The name of the person at the reception is Lidiya

Overall, the experience was chaotic, poorly managed, and deeply unsettling. At no point did we feel supported or cared for as guests. Instead, we were made to feel like outsiders, left to navigate a stressful and unsafe situation on our own. This fell far below the standard of service one would expect from a hotel of this calibre.

user_reviews.Name: Subhash Gunatilaka
user_reviews.Description: I went to Addis Ababa on holiday for one week and stayed at the Raddison Blu. The accommodation was excellent and I cannot speak highly enough of the staff  who made me feel at home with their incredibly warm nature. Every morning I received the warmest welcome from Etsegenet and Haymanot at breakfast, which was always a great start to the day. I would also like to say a special thank you to Ketema and his team for their kindness and perfect hospitality. Namely David, Habtamu, Mintesinot, Yaregal and many others.

title: Ghion Hotel | Stadium
address: 2Q76+F3H Ghion Hotel | Stadium, Ras Desta Damtew St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Unassuming rooms in a laid-back hotel offering gardens, 3 eateries & an Olympic-size outdoor pool.

user_reviews.Name: Honey ta D
user_reviews.Description:
The hotel has abundant area but the food service quality varies on a daily basis. The restrooms inaddition to being inadequate in number, have shortage & absence of water most of the time.
On the bright side, most of the facilitators/waiters/waitresses/technicians are very cooperative, sweet and kind. They should be given a raise for keeping the place going with their warmth even with all the maintenance required but give due attention to the kitchen lagging to serve meals. The waiters "supervisor" needs training to be able to work under stress/pressure/rush hour so she can influence the staffs positively. Prepare special curtains for trainings using projector so the notes can be viewed properly during the room's exposure to sunlight. Waiting to see you excel during my next visit. Good Luck!

user_reviews.Name: Alpha Omega
user_reviews.Description: I know this hotel build 50 to 60 years ago the service mentality old not inviting or bad communication. This is one place government it should not be in hotel business at all. The employ watching YouTube behind the counter and we have to yel for service. I heard a customer eating lunch he ask for Wifi PW they told him only for room gust and he walked away from customer rudely. They should learn from surrounding hotels. BAD service👎 the natural setup and location is very good. Not coming up for sure.

user_reviews.Name: Mahlet Kassa
user_reviews.Description: A hotel that was established during the emperor's time but still intact. We have tried the traditional restaurant, tekul. We tried two types of tibs and a beef steak. Everything was delicious. The service was great and the staff were quite attentive. The place has traditional vibes and is suitable for large groups. Although the place is quiet, the food is great, the place is clean and the service is great. The price is also fair for the quality of food they serve. I don't think people have the right perception of this place. I think it is worth a try and definitely a beautiful experience.

user_reviews.Name: Amsale Michael
user_reviews.Description:
We would like to say thank you to the manager, Bereket, if it wasn't for your pleasant approach and assistance, we wouldn't have stayed for 45 days. The entire reception staff, Asnake, the house keeping crew, thank you for everything.
While the hotel is in central location to the airport and other destinations, it needs an overhaul renovation, and updated bathroom and rooms.  The outside gardens are still well kept except for the water fountains.  The location of the rooms away from Addis Ababa's traffic and noise is a plus. Again we thank everyone who's involved during our stay.

user_reviews.Name: Sunrise Driving School Mez (Mez)
user_reviews.Description: Extremely poor hospitality & service at the Tukul/traditional dinning hall. We took our seat in dinning hall and waited for about 20 min, there’s no one to ask us, and we changed our table and moved outside at the veranda, another 10 minutes passed, no one showed up; and finally we should call this lady standing little away who was staring at us. She brought us the menu and ordered one from the list; she didn’t even turn her face to us to say “we don’t have that meal”, leave alone to accompany her words with “sorry” and/or give us other options. Honestly speaking, I was so very happy that that specific Tibs we ordered wasn’t available, as her facial expression and gesture was very disturbing and don’t think I would eat that food comfortably. Terrible!

user_reviews.Name: Kerim Fedlu
user_reviews.Description:
An Oldies but Goodies Hotel with a balance between charm and functionality. The lush garden, swimming pool, and spa services offer a serene escape amidst the city bustle. While the accommodations maintain a classic vibe, they're clean and comfortable. The affordability is a definite plus, making it accessible to budget-conscious travelers.
The highlight of this establishment is undoubtedly its picturesque garden, providing a tranquil setting for relaxation and leisurely strolls. The swimming pool offers a refreshing dip on hot days, and the spa services provide a touch of luxury without breaking the bank.
However, there are areas for improvement. Some aspects of the hotel could benefit from modernization to enhance the overall guest experience. Additionally, while the staff is friendly, there's room for improvement in terms of efficiency and responsiveness.
Overall, Oldies but Goodies Hotel offers good value for the price, with its beautiful garden, swimming pool, and affordable spa services. It's a solid option for those seeking a peaceful retreat without sacrificing too much on comfort.

user_reviews.Name: Tamirat Alemu
user_reviews.Description: Ghion Hotel offers a unique blend of comfort and culture in the heart of Addis Ababa. The hotel features spacious rooms that are clean and well-maintained, providing a relaxing atmosphere for both business and leisure travelers. Guests appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, always ready to assist with any needs. The on-site restaurant serves a variety of local and international dishes, showcasing Ethiopian cuisine, which is a highlight for many visitors. The beautiful gardens surrounding the hotel create a peaceful retreat from the city's hustle and bustle. Additionally, its convenient location near major attractions and business districts makes it an ideal choice for travelers. While the hotel may benefit from some modern updates, its charm and hospitality make it a worthwhile stay. Overall, Ghion Hotel is a great option for anyone looking to experience genuine Ethiopian hospitality in a comfortable setting.

user_reviews.Name: Samuel Debebe
user_reviews.Description:
The Ghion Cottage restaurant is just amazing... Great traditional food with very attentive staff.
One of their specialities is call ENFELE... The taste is our of this world. Please try it.

title: Harmony Hotel
address: XQWP+FFR Harmony Hotel, 104 Namibia St, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
description: Unfussy rooms & suites in a laid-back hotel offering 2 restaurants, an indoor pool & a spa.

user_reviews.Name: sumita maharaj
user_reviews.Description:
Review (⭐ 3/5):
Ethiopian Airlines kindly arranged overnight accommodation for me after I missed my connection.

The front desk staff were warm and welcoming, and the rooms were neat and comfortable.

There are, however, a few areas where the experience could be improved. The shower would benefit from a deeper clean, and unfortunately, there was no hot water during my stay despite reporting it. At the buffet, some of the food was served cold, the chicken was a bit overcooked, and there were no labels on the dishes, which made it difficult to know what was being served without asking for assistance.

I appreciate that this accommodation was complimentary, but even small improvements in cleanliness, food quality, and responsiveness would go a long way in making the stay more pleasant for future guests.

user_reviews.Name: Mehmet Güme
user_reviews.Description:
On my first day at the hotel, I was very tired. After resting for two hours, I went outside, and upon returning, I took a shower as I had been sweating. I requested that the bed sheets and towels be changed, as the sheets were damp and I had placed the used towels on the bathroom floor. Initially, the staff confirmed they would handle it. However, 45 minutes later, I was informed that guests are only entitled to one towel and one bedsheet per day. I found this policy absurd and even offered to pay extra if necessary. They then agreed to proceed.

I had also reported that the window in my room would not close properly. After another thirty minutes, I was told the room was ready, but when I went back, the towels were still on the bathroom floor and the bed sheets had not been changed—only straightened, still carrying the scent of my own perfume. After complaining again, they reassured me it would be fixed. Ten minutes later, they claimed the matter was resolved, but when I returned, housekeeping was still in the room. Once finished, I reminded them again about the window, but they were unable to repair it. It was only when I insisted that I would call the police that they upgraded me to a suite.

On my third day, at 11:30 PM, I called to order cake, only to be told that they do not serve cake after 10:00 PM. Having stayed at many hotels worldwide, I had never encountered such a rule. Ten minutes later, I went to the reception and spoke with the night manager. He laughed and said he would “take care of it,” yet no one at the bar assisted me in the meantime. Eventually, the night manager confirmed the cake would be sent. I paid and returned to my room, but after thirty minutes, nothing had arrived. When I called the reception again to follow up, no one answered. Finally, I went back downstairs, only to find that they pretended as though the cake had just been prepared.

I strongly advise against staying at this hotel. It was by far the most disappointing experience I have ever had.

user_reviews.Name: Daydream39442430192
user_reviews.Description: The customer service was top-notch, and I'll be returning!” “I've been a loyal customer for over five years now, and the entire team at harmony hotel Addis ababa never fails to impress. The attention to detail and the exceptional service I receive each time keeps me coming back.”

user_reviews.Name: Seraj Almarzouq
user_reviews.Description: Nice place in the heart of Bole Street — safe and secure with good facilities and friendly staff. However, the cleanliness needs improvement , the air-conditioning was not working well and furniture need to be modified.

user_reviews.Name: Bob White
user_reviews.Description: We were put up here on a stopover. Although they knew we were coming there was no hot food just cold leftovers from earlier. Looked like some of them were still there the following morning, but at least they had a chef cooking eggs for breakfast

user_reviews.Name: Suraphel Assefa
user_reviews.Description: I have had a wonderful experience at Harmony hotel. I enjoyed the local dishes and some soft drinks. The location is also 10 mins walk from Bole international airport.

user_reviews.Name: Sam Hussein
user_reviews.Description:
Harmony Hotel: Consistently Excellent

Having stayed here several years ago, I recently returned to Harmony Hotel and was blown away all over again. From the moment I arrived—starting with the airport shuttle pickup and the friendly porter—the hospitality was top-notch. The front desk staff made check-in smooth and welcoming, and that warm, professional service continued throughout my stay.

My room was on the 5th floor at the newly added tower, the room was quite spacious around 484 sq ft, with a city view, comfortable and spotless, with everything I needed. The housekeeping was consistently excellent. The breakfast buffet was Absolutely delicious and fresh, varied, and beautifully presented. Whether you're a local or international guest; the spread has something for everyone.

I’ve stayed at many luxury-brand hotels, but Harmony Hotel still wins for me. It offers superior comfort, exceptional service, and excellent value in a perfect location. If you’re heading to Addis Ababa, look no further than Harmony Hotel. It's more than just a place to stay, it’s a home away from home.

user_reviews.Name: RAHEL ADEFRIS
user_reviews.Description: I know this hotel years before. Let me tell you my two days experience on May 7 and 8, 2025: we organized a meeting with >300 attendees. They organized everything much beyond the contract. The overall staff engagement, cooperation, and fucus surprised me. Many like service providers will take lessons from them. Thank you all staffs, banquet, and pastry team for your unreserved support. I advise, all should try them.

title: Best Western Plus Addis Ababa
address: Cameroon St, Addis Ababa 1065, Ethiopia
description: Unfussy rooms in a refined hotel featuring a restaurant, a cafe/bar & a spa, plus free breakfast.

user_reviews.Name: aadil siddiqui
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Outstanding Stay & Exceptional Service!

I had an absolutely amazing experience at Best Western Plus Addis Ababa, conveniently located next to Bole Medhanealem Mall. From the moment I arrived, everything was smooth, professional, and welcoming.

A very special thank you to the reception team, especially Bety G. and Bety A. They were incredibly polite, warm, and professional, always ready to help with a smile. Their hospitality truly made me feel valued and comfortable throughout my stay.

I would also like to highly appreciate Nafsi, the massage therapist. Her service was outstanding — extremely professional, relaxing, and perfectly done. It was one of the best massage experiences I’ve ever had and helped me completely unwind after a long day.

The hotel itself is clean, modern, and well-maintained, with excellent facilities and a peaceful atmosphere. The location is perfect, close to shopping, restaurants, and the airport.

I highly recommend Best Western Plus Addis Ababa to anyone visiting the city. Exceptional service, wonderful staff, and a truly memorable stay. I will definitely be coming back!

user_reviews.Name: Abdulaziz ibrahim
user_reviews.Description:
🌟 Best Massage Experience at Best Western – Bole (Edna Mall Branch) 🌟

I had an absolutely wonderful massage experience at the Best Western Spa in Bole near Edna Mall. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was calm, welcoming, and truly relaxing.

✨ Nafsi gave one of the best therapeutic massages I’ve ever had. Her technique was both professional and intuitive — she knew exactly how to ease tension and deliver deep, effective relief. She made sure I was comfortable throughout the session and checked in to tailor the pressure to my needs. Truly a skilled therapist.

✨ Bety G also provided an amazing massage. Her attention to detail and soothing touch helped melt away all the stress from a long day. She created a peaceful environment and used just the right combination of techniques for maximum relaxation. I left feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.

The spa itself is clean, serene, and beautifully maintained, and the staff are courteous and attentive. I highly recommend this spot to anyone in Addis Ababa looking for top-quality massage services — especially with therapists like Nafsi and Bety G, who make every visit exceptional.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

user_reviews.Name: DR WUBSHET METEKIA
user_reviews.Description:
Dear Best Western Plus Hotel Team,

Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

We would like to express our sincere gratitude for the outstanding service and warm hospitality we received during our stay. A special thank you goes to your remarkable staff, particularly Mr. Million, Mrs. Simiret, Hellen, and the entire team who made us feel right at home.

We wholeheartedly recommend BWP Addis Hotel to others, especially families with children. The attentive care and family-friendly approach truly enhance the experience for little ones.

Thank you once again for your exceptional service.

Best wishes,
Drs. Wubshet, Seble and son Nolawi

user_reviews.Name: Becky Abdissa Adugna
user_reviews.Description:
I recently stayed at the Best Western and had a wonderful experience from start to finish. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, and the overall atmosphere of the hotel was welcoming.

I especially want to highlight the exceptional service provided by Mr. Milion and Ms. Melesti. They were both incredibly helpful, attentive, and professional throughout my stay. Their warm attitude and willingness to assist with anything I needed truly made a difference and elevated my visit.

If you’re looking for a pleasant stay with great service, I highly recommend this Best Western location. I will definitely return!

user_reviews.Name: Daniel BCB
user_reviews.Description:
I had the pleasure of being served by [Waitress's Simiret] during my recent visit to [barr simert ],elbetel beftu and I couldn't have asked for a better experience. From the moment we were seated, she was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. She made excellent recommendations and was always quick to check in without being overbearing.
Her positive attitude really stood out – she was warm, welcoming, and seemed genuinely interested in making sure we had a great time. Not only was she efficient in taking our orders, but she also kept our drinks full and ensured that our meal was perfectly timed. She made us feel like valued guests, which really added to the overall dining experience.
It’s clear that [simiret] takes pride in her work, and her professionalism made our visit to [Restaurant fernsay barr] even more enjoyable. Thank you for such wonderful service, [Waitress's simiret]! I’ll definitely be returning and recommend best western plus adiss

user_reviews.Name: baa bbyyy66
user_reviews.Description: an amazing experience thanks to our waitress! SIMREtShe was warm, welcoming, and incredibly attentive without ever being intrusive. She knew the menu well, made great recommendations, and checked on us at just the right times. Our drinks stayed full, our food came out perfectly, and she made us feel genuinely taken care of. Excellent service from start to finish—she truly elevated our dining

user_reviews.Name: Dreamer46695626531
user_reviews.Description: Best Western Plus Addis Ababa Ethiopia||A Very Comfortable Stay||We stayed at the Best WesternPlius Addis Ababa Ethiopia before our month-long trip around Ethiopia. The staff was extremely friendly and went out of their way to make our stay a most enjoyable experience. The room was very spacious and comfortable. The restaurant has a very nice menu with lots of good choices. The staff - concierge was able to get us an excellent driver for the day. We used a private driver to create a site-seeing plan of Addis Ababa for the day.  The hotel is located across from a mall that had a bank to exchange money. There is also a kiosk outside the mall with excellent ice cream. We would certainly recommend this hotel.

user_reviews.Name: John Gbadegesin
user_reviews.Description:
The Best Western Plus Hotel provides exquisite experience for its customers. The staff are welcoming and enterprising providing guests with a great experience, of home away from home.
I have to mention, in particular, my experience at the Restuarant. Seble Mila Tigerada Yeabsiry Serkadis is ever present to make your choice food the best. With her friendly tone, she always ready to meet your satisfaction. Should you be in Addis Ababa on your next business or vacation, Best Western Plus is the place to be.

title: The Grand Palace Hotel
address: Guinea Conakry St, Addis Ababa 5710, Ethiopia
description: Elegant rooms & suites, some with kitchenettes, in a high-end hotel with a restaurant & a spa.

user_reviews.Name: Sabine Russek
user_reviews.Description:
We stayed at Grand Palace Hotel twice during our trip around Ethiopia.

It was a nice place to land and get used to the city. It has a very elegant reception and the kitchen is open 24/7! The breakfast menu is delicious. The staff is really friendly too.

We left our big suitcases there while we went up north and south and it worked perfectly. The only problem are the rooms.

We got the family room, which was great and exactly what we needed but we think it needed more objects, specially the bathrooms: no floor mat, no hand towels, no hand soap holders, the extra duvets in the cupboard to use when it gets cold ( and it does!) dont even have a duvet cover.

They also said we had a safe box and we didnt. So they had to bring one.

When the manager asked me about feedback I told them all of this but when we stayed there after our two weeks trip, the issues were still not fixed. They are easy to fix things so I encourage the hotel to do it soon!!!

user_reviews.Name: AbuDhabiSwithers
user_reviews.Description: Booking.com lists the Grand Palace as a five star hotel, but it was suspiciously cheap compared to other five star hotels in Addis Ababa.||My suspicions were confirmed when my airport pick-up didn't turn up, some of the staff weren't very helpful and my room felt very dated and lacked basic things like a fridge, curtains that are as wide as the window etc.||On the plus side, the location is excellent with lots of good restaurants and bars nearby, and the breakfast was great. ||So set your expectations for "good three star" and you'll be fine. If you really want five star then accept that you'll need to pay three times the price and go to the Hyatt just down the road.

user_reviews.Name: L C
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I stayed here twice during my trip to Ethiopia, and it truly felt like a calm, elegant base in Addis. The rooms are clean and spacious, with great showers and very comfortable beds. The staff are professional, warm, and helpful, they even kept my main suitcase safely while I was in Lalibela.

The location is perfect: you can walk almost everywhere, and there are great spots nearby like Little China and Mezzeh Salad Bar, both super convenient for quick meals. Everything about this hotel made my stay easy and pleasant. I love it, and will definitely be back here during my future stays in Addis!

user_reviews.Name: E. Arthur Phillips
user_reviews.Description: The staff are very polite and helpful. The breakfast was fresh with good variety and flavour. Electricity went off at least once per day but usually for less than 3 minutes at a time. I stayed in a single room and the place was simple clean but the bathroom finish was a bit rough in terms of the shower and the sink. There was no air conditioning or heating in the room. Fortunately it was cool to chilly rather than hot. The usual expected bathrokm amenities were present. The foyer and dining area are well appointed. There no parking or disabled access with frequent vehicular congestion on the street outside. The service, the food and the price commend my experience here.

user_reviews.Name: T6598SYhassana
user_reviews.Description: Grand Palace has excellent customer service. People are very friendly, and the food is always delicious. The breakfast buffet is superb, with a large variety to select from. I would recommend this to all types of travellers, including business and holiday travellers. Enjoy your next stay.

user_reviews.Name: 924dinahn
user_reviews.Description: The hot shower is amazing , the rooms are well maintained and big in size . The view at the balcony is breathtaking and the staff services are amazing. The food is delicious and the location access to banks , parks and museums is quite impressive. I would definitely recommend

user_reviews.Name: Derek Braun
user_reviews.Description: Great location, beatiful lobby and entryway.  The service was excellent.  A minor miscommunication with our room assignment but everything was made right.  Rooms/ bathrooms were clean and comfortable.  The breakfast food menu needs a complete revision. Transportation to the airport.  Overall, great experience, will be staying here again!

user_reviews.Name: sabrie539
user_reviews.Description: Very nice experience in Ethiopia and in the Grand Palace hotel, which is in the a very modern district. A few shops arpund. Very friendly staff at the hotel that do their best to make you comfortable.

title: Hayes Hotel Addis Ababa
address: Lex Plaza, Mickey Leland St, to Signal Road, Addis Ababa 1000, Ethiopia
description: Down-to-earth rooms & suites, some with city views, in a casual hotel offering a restaurant.

user_reviews.Name: Mengistu Tibebu
user_reviews.Description:
Highly Recommended – Hayes Hotel, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia

My wife and I had the pleasure of staying at Hayes Hotel in Addis Ababa, and our experience was truly outstanding. From the moment we arrived, the entire team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, including the receptionists, front office manager, waiters, and front door security personnel. Everyone was courteous, attentive, and genuinely committed to providing excellent service.

The management team deserves special recognition for being extremely helpful, responsive, and customer-focused. They truly make life easier for customers and ensure that every need is handled with care and efficiency. We felt welcomed, respected, and valued throughout our stay.

The hotel is very clean, well-kept, and well-organized, with a warm and peaceful atmosphere that made us feel at home. The rooms are comfortable, and the overall service quality exceeded our expectations.

We highly recommend Hayes Hotel to both international and local guests visiting Addis Ababa. It is an excellent choice for anyone seeking outstanding hospitality, comfort, safety, and professionalism.

user_reviews.Name: Eng M N
user_reviews.Description: Nice hotel, clean rooms. Beautiful views especially on the higher floors. A little noisy from dogs 🤣 the only concern is language barrier which delayed some service.

user_reviews.Name: Bruno “BrunoAuberson” Auberson
user_reviews.Description:
Great, the location isn’t the best as taxis usually don’t know where it is.
But other then that it’s a very good hotel.

user_reviews.Name: meharin2018
user_reviews.Description: Review of Hayes Hotel – Great Stay with Some Room for Improvement||Our family had a wonderful stay at Hayes Hotel. The hotel offers a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere, and the staff truly make a difference. A special mention to Thibebe, who went above and beyond to assist us multiple times, including booking taxis and offering helpful recommendations.||While the hotel excels in service and comfort, the breakfast and overall menu could use some improvement. The selection felt somewhat limited, and a greater variety would enhance the experience.||One important thing to note is that this hotel is not the best choice if you prefer to be within walking distance of restaurants and other dining options. However, if you’re looking for a peaceful stay with excellent service, Hayes Hotel is a great choice.

user_reviews.Name: Dure Mulatu
user_reviews.Description:

user_reviews.Name: Cittolin Sander
user_reviews.Description:
I’m in Addis Ababa for an 11-night stay, and so far this experience has been completely unacceptable. I arrived on December 2, and from day one the room had obvious issues: half of the lights didn’t work (I let that go), but the shower was not working, which is not something you can “ignore” in a hotel.

The next morning at 8:00 AM, I went to reception and reported the shower problem. I was told it would be fixed. After a full day of work, I came back around 7:00 PM and nothing had been done. I went back to reception again, and only then they spent about 45 minutes trying to “find a solution,” finally deciding to move me to another room. But honestly, it’s outrageous that I notify you at 8:00 AM and I’m only switching rooms around 8:00 PM. No compensation, no upgrade, no gesture at all, which is standard in hospitality when the hotel fails to provide basic services. I work in hospitality myself, so I know what good service looks like. This wasn’t it.

And tonight was the final straw: it is currently 1AM and an alarm has been ringing for over an hour. I called reception once and was told it would be handled. 20 minutes later, still nothing, so I called again to ask when it would stop. The receptionist told me, “Can you come down?”,  meaning go down 10 floors at 12.30 AM. Absolutely not. Then she hung up on me. I needed to call them AGAIN 10mn later.

Also, on Booking it says there is a fitness center, but it’s half under work/upgrade, which should be clearly communicated before booking....

The only positive thing I can say is that the F&B team is excellent: welcoming, warm, smiling, and professional. Unfortunately, that’s the only department that seems to care. ps : the rooftop is beautiful.

I stayed here several times, of which one time, the Wifi didn't work for 2 weeks which was very unfortunate. All other times there were no internet issues though.

user_reviews.Name: Marianne-Loic
user_reviews.Description: We wouldn't recommend the hotel as we had a terrible experience all the way apart from when the manager took the matters into his own hands. The staff is absolutely unfriendly: when we checked in we were barely told where our room was, we had to carry the luggage all the way to the third floor (which is alright but you wouldn't expect that from a 3 star hotel). The room didn't have towels, paper toilet and the room door wouldn't close and open properly. We had to ask several times for the staff to move us to another room, after they had a few laughs they finally moved us to another one. In the morning they have a poor breakfast buffet thus we asked for eggs for breakfast. When they arrived uncooked and we requested to have them cooked longer the waiter raised his eyes and was rude to us. Finally when we requested cabs, the reception arranged us rides that 2 times out of three ended up terribly. 2 didn't know their way so we had to direct them around, 2 surcharged us, and the cherry on the cake : one had a cockroach on the passenger seats and bumped his car. You would expect from a hotel to have minimum customer service, friendly staff and reliable recommendation in terms of transportation. We were supposed to stay 6 days, we immediately changed hotel the next day.
